e caminhou em direção ao Distrito da Estação de Transmissão.

column3:
でも――覚者さまだからお話ししましたけど
できればそっとしてあげてくださいね
column4:
No entanto,
eu mencionei isso porque você é Arisen,
mas, se puder, mantenha isso em segredo.

column3:
息抜きというか、一人になりたいというか
そんなご気分になられたんだと思うんです
column4:
Parecia que ela queria fazer uma pausa,
ou apenas ficar sozinha por um tempo.

column3: あなたは――？
column4: E quem poderia ser você――?

column3:
謁見の間を抜けだしたこと
やはり気づかれてしまったようですね
column4:
Parece que perceberam que eu escapei
da Sala de Audiências, afinal.

column3:
こんな時だとは分かっていたのですが
勝手をしてしまったこと、許してください
column4:
Eu sabia que não era um momento ideal,
mas peço que perdoe meu comportamento.

column3:
――でも、来てくれたのがあなたで良かった
少しだけわたしのわがままに付き合って
くれませんか？
column4:
--Mas estou feliz que tenha sido você quem me encontrou.
Você me daria um pouco de atenção?

column3:
覚者であるあなたに護衛を依頼している――
そう思ってくれてかまいません
column4:
Você pode pensar que estou solicitando
sua proteção como Arisen—
isso está perfeitamente bem.

column3:
用が終われば謁見の間に戻ると約束します
ジョゼフにはわたしから話しておきますので
column4:
Eu prometo retornar à Sala de Audiências
assim que terminar com isso.
Eu mesma falarei com Joseph.

column3: やはりずっと前の話になりますが――
column4: De fato, esta é uma história de muito tempo atrás—

column3:
恋人らしき殿方に装飾品をねだって
いる女性をこのバザーで見たことがあります
column4:
Eu testemunhei uma mulher neste bazar
pedindo a um homem que parecia ser seu amante
por algumas joias.

column3:
心の中で応援したのですが
残念ながら彼女の望みはかないませんでした
column4:
Eu a incentivei em meu coração.
Infelizmente, ela não conseguiu realizar seu desejo.

column3: それでも、なぜか楽しそうでしたけどね
column4:
Ainda assim, por alguma razão,
parecia que eles estavam se divertindo.

column3:
時々、普通の十七歳の女の子だったら
どうだったのだろう――と思います
column4:
Às vezes, eu penso em como teria sido
se eu fosse uma garota normal de dezessete anos.

column3:
普通の女の子だったら
わたしは何を嬉しいと思うのだろう――
column4:
Se eu fosse uma garota normal,
o que me deixaria feliz...?

column3: 何を見て笑うのだろう――
column4: O que eles veem que os faz rir--

column3: そんなことを考えるのも楽しいものです
column4: É divertido ponderar essas coisas.

column3:
わたしも殿方に装飾品をねだるのかも
しれませんね
column4:
Eu também poderia ser o tipo de mulher
que pede enfeites a um cavalheiro.

column3: あら？
column4: Oh?

column3:
白竜様は今、夢を見ているようです
ええ、感じるのです
column4:
Lorde Dragão Branco está sonhando agora.
Sim, eu posso sentir isso.

column3:
空を飛んでいる夢です
この上を大きく旋回する夢――
column4:
É um sonho de voar no céu,
uma visão de circular graciosamente acima—

column3:
夢の中の人々は――
道行く人は誰も空を見上げようとはしません
白竜様はまったく気にしていないけれど
わたしは――悲しくてたまりません
column4:
As pessoas nos meus sonhos—
nenhum dos transeuntes olha para o céu.
Lorde Dragão Branco não se importa nem um pouco,
mas eu—não consigo deixar de me sentir tão triste.

column3:
わたしは空にいる白竜様を見た記憶があります
現実の記憶なのか想像した風景なのか
判然としないのですが――
column4:
Eu tenho uma memória de Lorde Dragão Branco voando alto
pelo céu. Não está claro se essa memória
é da realidade ou se é uma cena que eu conjurei—
Não consigo dizer com certeza.

column3:
その記憶の中でも、やはり人々は
空を見上げたりはしませんでした
column4:
Mesmo nessa memória,
as pessoas ainda não olhavam para o céu!

column3:
でも、それが自然なのです
その頃の白竜様は特別な存在ではなくて
風や雲と同じでしたから

それなのに今、わたしはどうして
誰も空を見上げないことを悲しく思うのか――
column4:
Mesmo assim, agora, eu me pergunto,
por que sinto tanta tristeza
que ninguém olha para o céu?

column3:
もしかしたら、人々はもう白竜様を
必要としていないのかもしれない――
そんなことを思ってしまうからでしょうか
column4:
Talvez as pessoas não precisem mais de Lorde Dragão Branco.
Não posso deixar de pensar nesses pensamentos às vezes.

column3:
人々は白竜様のために戦うのではなく
純粋に自分の幸福のために戦う――
いえ、戦う必要すらないのかもしれない
column4:
As pessoas não lutam por Lorde Dragão Branco,
mas sim por sua própria felicidade.
Talvez eles nem precisem lutar.

column3: 世界はそれでもいいんじゃないか――と
column4: Não seria bom para o mundo dessa forma--

column3:
む――どうしたことだ
こんな時だというのに
彼女の姿が見当たらぬが――
column4:
O que está acontecendo?
Mesmo em um momento como este,
não consigo encontrá-la em lugar nenhum.

column3:
ああ、お前か
少し気がかりなことがあってな
column4:
Ah, é você.
Estou um pouco preocupado com algo.

column3:
いや、今はいいのだ
事によっては後でおまえの力を
借りることになるかもしれんが――
column4:
Não, está tudo bem agora.
Dependendo de como as coisas se desenrolarem,
talvez eu precise da sua ajuda mais tarde.

column3:
作戦の目的が若干修正された
気になるようならジョゼフに訊いておけ
column4:
O objetivo da operação foi
ligeiramente ajustado. Se quiser saber,
pergunte a Joseph para mais detalhes.

column3:
では、準備ができたら出発してくれ
アークで会おう
column4:
Então, quando estiver pronto, parta.
Nós nos encontraremos na Arca.

column3: 言いたいことはたくさんあるさ――
column4: Há muito que eu quero dizer—

column3:
でも、白竜様が天を舞う姿を見たいのは
僕だって同じなんだ
column4:
Ainda assim, eu também desejo ver
Lorde Dragão Branco voar pelo céu.

column3: 信じてほしいから、今は方針に従うよ
column4:
Eu quero que você acredite em mim,
então eu seguirei o plano agora.

column3:
白竜様と神殿は騎士団に任せてくれ
メイリーフ嬢の警備も強化する
column4:
Confie Lorde Dragão Branco e o Templo
à Ordem dos Cavaleiros. Eu fortalecerei
os detalhes de segurança para Lady Mayleaf também.

column3:
実地調査報告と古文書より
アーク外壁の破壊は困難との結論に達した
column4:
Com base no relatório de estudo de campo
e textos antigos, concluímos
que a destruição da parede externa da Arca
é uma tarefa desafiadora.

column3:
だが、外壁が強固なぶん、内部は
それほどでもないようだ
column4:
Mas para toda a força das paredes externas,
o interior não parece tão ruim.

column3:
内部に巣くった魔物どもを掃討して
奥底に設置された装置を破壊する
column4:
Elimine os monstros que se aninham dentro
e destrua o dispositivo que está colocado nas profundezas.

column3:
アークの排除はできないが
存在意義を奪うことにはなるだろう
column4:
A Arca não pode ser destruída,
mas vamos privá-la de sua razão de ser.

column3:
どうかお気をつけて
白竜様とここでお待ちしています
column4:
Por favor, tome cuidado.
Eu estarei esperando aqui
com Lorde Dragão Branco.

column3:
パメラとここにいるから心配しないでね
もう迷惑かけたりしないから
column4:
Não precisa se preocupar,
Pamela e eu estamos aqui.
Eu não serei um incômodo
de agora em diante.

column3:
先ほど騎士団の方が来て
警備強化に関する説明を受けました
column4:
Um membro da ordem dos cavaleiros veio
há pouco para nos informar sobre o reforço da segurança.

column3:
頼もしいと思う気持ちにうそはありませんけど
また危険が迫っているのかと思うと
落ち着きませんね
column4:
Não há mentira no meu sentimento de confiança,
mas não me sinto à vontade pensando que
o perigo está se aproximando novamente.

column3: メイリーフ嬢の警護は任せてくれ
column4: Deixe a proteção de Lady Mayleaf comigo.

column3:
知ってのとおりオークどもは
長年の拘りをあっさりと棄てて――
column4:
Como você sabe, os Orcs facilmente deixaram de lado
seus ressentimentos de longa data—

column3:
この砦を迂回し、ダウ渓谷から
ハイデル平原に出入りするようになった
column4:
Eles começaram a contornar esta fortaleza,
agora entrando e saindo das Planícies de Hidell
através do Vale Dowe.

column3:
立場上誤解を招く発言になるが――
以前のオークは愚直だが勇猛果敢だった
ズールと手を組む前の奴らが懐かしい
column4:
Esta é uma declaração enganosa da minha posição,
mas os Orcs do passado eram tolos, mas bravos.
Eu anseio pelo tempo antes de eles juntarem forças
com aquele chamado Zuhl.

column3:
ディアマンテスめ――
こんな奴と手を組んでいるとはな
column4:
Diamantes―
Pensar que eles uniriam forças
com alguém como este.

column3: 慌てるな！　そう、それでいい
column4: Não entre em pânico! Sim, é isso. Continue.

column3: くそっ――厄介な奴だな――
column4: Droga — esse é um filho da mãe complicado—

column3: ちがうな――やはり覚者はちがう！
column4: Não, está errado—o Arisen realmente se destaca!

column3: こーい！　もっとこーい！
column4: Venha! Mais, me dê mais!

column3: かゆいかゆい！
column4: Ooh, isso faz cócegas!

column3: おいおい――
column4: Ei, ei—

column3: オマイら――オマイら！？
column4: Vocês — vocês !?

column3:
おれは不死身だろうに！？
ディアマンテス――騙したのか！
column4:
Eu deveria ser imortal, não é!?
Diamantes - você me enganou!

column3: なんと！　ズールを倒したのか！？
column4: O quê!? Você derrubou Zuhl!?

column3:
素晴らしい――素晴らしい戦果だ
これで以前のオーク軍団に戻るかもな
column4:
Incrível — que conquista esplêndida!
Isso pode significar um retorno
ao antigo exército orc.

column3:
大変です、海側から現れた魔物に気を取られて
その間に――
column4:
Isto é ruim; estamos distraídos pelos
monstros que apareceram do mar,
e nesse meio tempo—

column3:
いいえ、メイリーフは無事です
白竜様のおそばにいるはずです

――すまない
魔物に侵入されてしまって――
column4:
Eu peço desculpas; fomos
invadidos por monstros—

column3:
ザコだったが、騒ぎになってその隙に――
正直、想定外だった
column4:
Eles eram fracos, mas a comoção
criou uma abertura—
Francamente, eu não esperava isso.

column3:
ああ、命の器を持ち帰ったんだね
でも、大変なことが起こってね
column4:
Ah, você trouxe de volta o Vaso da Vida.
Mas um evento terrível aconteceu.

column3:
君たちが留守の間に敵の別働隊が――
別働隊って言うか､彼女が――
column4:
Enquanto vocês estavam fora, um destacamento inimigo—
ou melhor dizendo, ela—

column3: あのね、あのね――ミシアル様が――
column4: Escute, veja bem— Lady Mysial—

column3: 面目ない――貴殿らに合わせる顔がないわ
column4: Eu estou envergonhado - eu não posso encarar vocês.

column3: いいな？　誰も責めてはいかんぞ
column4: Entendido? Ninguém te culpa.

column3:
ズールの、あの魔物の命か
命の用途――
column4:
É a vida daquele monstro, Zuhl?
O propósito dessa vida――

column3:
いや、何でもない
忘れてくれ
column4:
Não, não é nada —
Esqueça.

column4:
Há tantas coisas que quero fazer com você,
coisas sobre as quais quero conversar com você--
tanto que quero pedir sua ajuda.

column3:
【ヒント：第二のアーク再侵入について】
第二のアークに新たな敵の脅威が高まってます
パーティー編成や装備、戦技などを見直して向かいましょう
column4:
【Dica: Sobre Reentrar na Segunda Arca】
Uma nova ameaça inimiga está aumentando na segunda Arca.
Avalie a composição do seu grupo,
equipamento e habilidades de combate antes de ir.

column3:

準備ができたら教えてくれ
待っているぞ――
column4:
Eu não posso prosseguir sem você.
Me avise quando estiver pronto.

column3: おまえとガルドリンには別命がある
column4: Você e Gurdolin têm uma tarefa diferente.

column3:
ブリア海岸に巨大な魔物の死骸が
打ち上げられたそうだ
column4:
Parece que a carcaça de um monstro gigante
apareceu na Praia Breya.

column3: おそらく嵐が運んできたのだろうが問題は――
column4:
A tempestade provavelmente a trouxe,
mas o problema é—

column3:
――どうにも奇妙な話なのだが――
その魔物、これまでに一度も目撃されたことが
ないらしいのだ
column4:
É uma história estranha,
mas essa criatura nunca foi vista antes.

column3:
古参の騎士や、早耳の覚者ばかりか
近隣の古老も初めて見る死骸に首を捻るばかり
column4:
Cavaleiros veteranos e Arisen de ouvidos atentos,
assim como anciãos locais, ficam perplexos
com este cadáver que nunca viram antes.

column3:
そこで、魔物との対戦経験豊富なおまえたちに
詳しい検分を依頼したい
column4:
Então, quero solicitar uma inspeção detalhada
de vocês que têm vasta experiência
sobre uma grande quantidade de monstros.

column3:
本当に未知の魔物であれば
改めて、本格的な調査隊を組織することになる
column4:
Caso seja uma criatura verdadeiramente desconhecida,
montarei uma equipe de pesquisa dedicada.

column3:
魔物の検分はもちろんだが

うまくやってくれよ？
column4:
Embora inspecionar o monstro seja importante,
há significado em trabalhar com
Gurdolin também. Trabalhem bem juntos, ok?

column3:
誰も知らない魔物――
レスタニアにまだそんなものがいたとはね
column4:
Um monstro desconhecido por todos—
Quem diria que ainda haveria
tais seres em Lestania?

column3:
ああ、お察しの通りさ
僕はワクワクしているよ
column4:
Ah, como você adivinhou,
estou animado para vê-lo.

column3:

column4:
A Força Dracônica circulante

column3: 心して行くがよい

column4:

column3:
未知の魔物なんているもんか
大方、育ちすぎか何かよ
俺はそっちに賭けるぜ
column4:
Não há como haver monstros desconhecidos.
É provavelmente algo estranhamente crescido demais
ou algo assim. Minhas apostas estão nisso.

column3:
噂を聞いて、ジッとしていられなくてね――
たまらないな、この腐臭
column4:
Depois de ouvir os boatos,
eu não conseguia ficar parado—
esse odor fétido é insuportável.

column3:
で、どう？
あの魔物は、どこかで見たことがある奴かい？
ほら、もっと近くで見てくるといい
column4:
Bem, o que você acha?
Esse monstro é um que você reconhece?
Vá em frente, dê uma olhada mais de perto.

column3:
もっと近くへ行けよ
意見を聞かせてくれ
column4:
Chegue mais perto.
Me diga o que você acha.

column3: 残念ながら力尽きたのは魔物だけではない
column4:
Infelizmente, não são apenas os monstros
que ficaram sem forças.

column3:
嵐の中、魔物の犠牲になった村人たちもいる
我々騎士団があらかた見つけ出したはずだが――
column4:
Em meio à tempestade, há aldeões
que se tornaram vítimas dos monstros.
Nossa Ordem dos Cavaleiros deveria ter encontrado
a maioria deles agora—

column3: 貴殿も、もし気づいたら、教えてくれ
column4:
Se você notar alguma coisa,
por favor, me avise também.

column3:
ひどい嵐だったな――
気のせいだろうが、悪意さえ感じたよ
column4:
Que tempestade terrível foi essa—
Eu posso estar imaginando, mas parecia maliciosa.

column3:
この臭いに比べればオークどもの臭いなど
まるで香水だぜ
column4:
Comparado com esta imundície,
o cheiro dos orcs é como um perfume doce.

column3:
海岸の小娘が光って――あたりが真っ白になって
気づいたらここにいた――この流れで合ってるよな？
column4:
A garota da praia começou a brilhar,
e a área ficou completamente branca.
Quando percebi, eu me encontrei aqui.
Foi assim que aconteceu, certo?

column3: となると、ここはどこだって話だ
column4: Então, onde estamos?

column3:
が、その前に――
俺はひどく背中を打って、どうやらすぐには
動き出せねえらしい
column4:
Mas antes disso,
eu bati minhas costas com força...
Parece que não vou conseguir me mover por um tempo.

column3:
おまえが一緒で良かったぜ
そのあたりを見てこいよ
ここがどこかわからねえと、帰り道もわからねえ
column4:
Ainda bem que tenho você comigo.
Dê uma olhada ao redor.
Se não soubermos onde estamos,
não encontraremos o caminho para casa.

column3:
ま、あの空の不気味な光も気になるが――
イテテテ――とりあえず、おまえに任せるわ
column4:
Bem, aquela luz estranha no céu também é preocupante,
mas—ai, ai, ai! Por enquanto, eu confio isso a você.

column3:
とにかく、ここが――イテテテ
ここがどこなのか――それを調べろ
column4:
Anyway, this place—ouch! 
Where is this place?—You must find that out.

column3: 謁見の間はやっぱり緊張しちゃうね
column4:
Indeed, it's hard to relax
in the Audience Chamber.

column3:
でも、これからはそうも言ってられないから
なるべく顔を出すようにしなくちゃ
column4:
Still, from now on, I can't say that anymore.
I must try to show my face as much as I can.

column3:
ふたりで牽引して、この隊を
最強の覚者隊にしましょう！
column4:
Let's work together to make this squad 
the mightiest Arisen Corps!

column3:
こんなことは君にしか話せないんだけどさ――
レオのことを少し気にかけていて欲しいんだ
column4:
I can only share this with you,
but I'd like you to look out for Leo.

column3:
一緒にディアマンテスに立ち向かった時のことを
覚えているだろう？
あのレオが神殿を離れる理由なんて
ないと思うんだよね
column4:
You recall when we confronted 
Diamantes together, right? 
I really don't think Leo has any reason 
to leave the temple.

column3:
覚者よ――
鍛え、強さを求め、備えるのだ
column4:
O Arisen――
Forge thyself, seek strength, 
and prepare thine heart.

column3:
たとえ風が止まり、雨があがっても
嵐はすぐそこにある
column4:
Though the gales be stilled 
and the rain doth fade, 
the storm is still at the horizon.

column3:
例の島――
おまえとガルドリンが瞬時に到着したという
あの島はどこにあるのか――
column4:
About that island— 
the one where you and Gurdolin 
arrived so suddenly—where is it?

column3:
ブリア海岸で死んでいた魔物は
どうやらその島から来たらしく
しかも、単独ではない
column4:
It appears the monster that died on Breya Coast
came from that island, and they are not alone.

column3: そして島で遭遇したという黒い鎧の騎士――
column4:
And the knight clad in black armor 
that was encountered on the island—

column3: 事態は単純な魔物退治では済まないのだろうな
column4:
The circumstances are likely more 
complicated than mere monster slaying.

column3:
認めたくはないが
またもやレスタニアに危機が訪れたということか
column4:
I regret to say it, but once again,
a threat looms over Lestania.

column3:
白竜の回復を見守る平穏な余生を
送るつもりだったが、瞬時に十年老いた気分だ
column4:
I had planned to live a tranquil life,
guarding the White Dragon's recovery,
yet I feel like I've aged ten years in an instant.

column3: おまえたち――頼りにしているぞ
column4: You guys--we're counting on you.

column3:
隊長！
ほら、隊長が海岸で見つけた女の子
column4:
Captain! Look over there,
it's the girl you found on the shore!

column3:
メイリーフの家にいるから様子を見てきたら？
意識はまだ戻らないみたいだけどね
column4:
Why not check on her at Mayleaf's house?
It seems she's still unconscious.

column3:
わたしもあとで見に行くつもりだけど
なかなかない雰囲気の美人だって評判みたい
column4:
I plan to visit later.
I've heard she's a stunning beauty
with an extraordinary presence.

column3:
例の島に現れた黒い鎧の騎士は
セシリーなる者を探していたのだとか
column4:
The knight in black armor that appeared 
on the island was searching for someone 
called Cecily.

column3:
メイリーフの家で眠る娘が
そのセシリーではないことを祈るよ
column4:
I hope that the girl resting at Mayleaf's 
is not that Cecily in question.

column3: メイリーフの家はもう行ったのかい？
column4: Have you been to Mayleaf's house yet?

column3:
眠り姫がいるという噂で野次馬が集まって
あのあたりは大変なことになったってね
騎士団が出動して追い払ったらしいよ
column4:
The talk of the town about a mysterious
sleeping princess attracted spectators,
causing a commotion in the area.
Apparently, the knights were dispatched
to chase them off.

column3:
用がないなら、俺はそのあたりを
ぶらついてくるぜ
column4:
If there's nothing else,
I'll just wander around the area for a bit.

column3: あの人、ここへ来てからずっとうなされているの
column4:
That person has been tossing and turning
ever since they came here.

column3:
怖い夢を見ているのかな――
そっとしておいた方がいいのか
起こした方がいいのか――どっちかな？
column4:
Are they having a scary dream?
Should I leave them alone,
or is it better to wake them up?
What should I do?

column3:
殿方の訪問が増えて、ええ、本音を言えば
迷惑しているんですよ
ゲルト騎士団長に相談するつもりです
column4:
The number of gentlemen visitors has risen, 
and to speak frankly, it's quite annoying. 
I plan to discuss this with Commander Gerd.

column3: うう――
column4: Ugh...

column3:
こんなつらそうに眠る人を見たことがありません
起こした方がいいと思うんですけど――
隊長、どうします？
column4:
I haven't seen anyone sleep so restlessly before.
I feel we should wake them, but— Captain,
what do you think is the best course of action?

column3:
お願いです
わたしがいた場所へ連れていってください
column4:
I beg of you, please guide me back
to the place I was before.

column3:
もう少し休んだ方がいいなんて勧めても
きっと聞きいれてくれないですよ
column4:
I doubt they'll heed my advice to rest 
a little more, even if I suggest it.

column3:
俺、わかるんです
それなりに痛い目にあってますから
column4: I get it; I've had my fair share of hardships.

column3:
あの人、セシリーっていうんだね
仲良くなれるといいなあ
column4:
That person is named Cecily, huh?
I hope we can become friends.

column3: 隊長、厄介なことになってます
column4:
Captain, it seems we've landed ourselves
in a difficult situation.

column3: ズールを覚えてます？　魔物のズール
column4: Do you recall Zhul? That demon?

column3:
あいつは以前、隊長に倒されたはずなのに
復活したようなんです
column4:
That creature was surely slain by the Captain,
but it looks like he's been revived.

column3:
それに、若い女を探していて
それがセシリーらしいんです
column4:
Moreover, they are looking for a young woman,
one called Cecily...

column3:
差し出さないと村を焼き尽くしてやると
息巻いていて――
column4:
They threaten to set the village ablaze 
if we don't surrender her to them――

column3: 今は海岸をうろついているみたいです
column4:
It seems they are currently roaming along
the coastline.

column3:
ズールが戻るかもしれないので
俺はここで警戒してます
見つけたら、海岸まで村の誰かを走らせます
column4:
Zhul might come back, so I will keep watch here.
If I find him, I will send someone
from the village to the shore.

column3:
わたしを探している魔物のせいで
村に被害が出ているそうです
column4:
They say a monster searching for me 
is causing damage to the village.

column3:
力を貸してください
村を助けなくてはなりません！
column4:
I beg you for your aid; 
we must help the village!

column3:
わたしを探している魔物の名は
ズールだと聞きました
でも、まったく心当たりがないのです
column4:
I was told the monster after me is named Zuhl,
but I have no idea who that is.

column3: オマイだ！　オマイが嫌いだ！
column4: It's you! I can't stand you!

column3: 邪魔だ！　どけい！
column4: Move aside! You're a nuisance!

column3: 女の気配がするぞ！　女はどこだ！
column4: I sense that woman nearby! Where is she?

column3: オマイら、逆らってもいいことないぞ！？
column4: You lot, it's no use resisting!

column3: おらおらおら！
column4: Whoa whoa whoa!

column3: オレの怖さ、忘れたか～？
column4: Did you forget how terrifying I am?

column3: 容赦はしないぞ？　知ってるんだろ？
column4: I will show no mercy, you know that, right?

column3: オマイ、まだまだ弱いぞ～！
column4: You are still weak, aren't you?

column3: オレは厄災――そう簡単には消えないぞぉ
column4: I am the calamity—I'm not so easily erased.

column3: オマイ――女を隠しているな――
column4: You—you're hiding a woman, aren't you?

column3: 女は――どこだ――
column4: The girl-- where is she?

column3: 黒騎士よ――どうか力を――
column4: Black Knight—grant me your power, come to me—

column3:
聞きましたよ！
ズールをさっさと追い払ったんですよね
さすが隊長！
column4:
I heard! You drove off Zuhl quickly, didn't you? 
As expected of the Captain!

column3:
ああ――
どうすればご迷惑をかけた方々に
お詫びをすることができるでしょう
column4:
Ahh— 
What can I do to make amends to those
I've caused so much trouble?

column3:
さあ、神殿に戻りましょう
セシリーの顔色が良くありません
column4:
Come, we should head back to the Temple. 
Cecily doesn't look well.

column3:
頭の中が闇に覆われて――
闇の奥にいろいろな風景があって――
column4:
My mind is shrouded in darkness— 
Within the darkness,
there are all sorts of scenery—

column3:
人もいて――それがわかるのに――
わかるのに、やっぱりすべてが闇の中で――
column4:
I can sense others around—and still, I know— 
I know, yet everything remains
shrouded in darkness—

column3:
セシリーを追い出せと言われるんじゃないかと
内心ビクビクしてましたけど
俺、白竜様のお言葉で安心しましたよ
column4:
I feared I might be told to expel Cecily, 
but the words of Lord White Dragon calmed me.

column3:
白竜様、そして皆さんのお気持ちには
深く感謝しています
column4:
I sincerely appreciate the kindness
from Lord White Dragon and all of you.

column3:
でも、甘えるわけにはいきません
一刻も早く、頭の中の深い霧を晴らせるように
努力しますね
column4:
However, I can't afford to be complacent. 
I will strive to clear the deep fog
in my mind as soon as possible.

column3:
エリオットの奴、すっかりセシリーの
保護者気取りだね
column4:
That Elliot has completely taken on the role
of Cecily's protector.

column3:
セシリーには人を惹きつける不思議な魅力があるから
気持はわかるけど
column4:
Cecily has a mysterious charm
that draws people to her, so I understand.

column3: 若い娘の世話係なんて俺はごめんだぜ
column4:
I'm not interested in being a caretaker
for a young lady, you know.

column3:
親しい君にだけは告白するけどね――
この成り行き――
好奇心がはち切れそうだよ
column4:
I'll reveal this only to you, my friend— 
this turn of events—my curiosity feels like 
it will explode.

column3:
ズールは黒騎士のポーンで
奴らの狙いはセシリー――
column4:
Zuhl is the Black Knight's Pawn, 
and their aim is Cecily...

column3:
その理由は、どうやらセシリーの
失われた記憶の中――というわけか
column4:
The reason, apparently,
is in Cecily's lost memory...

column3:
なるほど、あの子の言うとおりにするしか
道は開けんのかもしれんな
column4:
I see, we may have no choice but to follow
her word to find a way through this.

column3:
おまえとガルドリンが行った例の島で
セシリーの忘れ物を見つけなくては――
column4:
We need to locate Cecily's forgotten belongings
on that island you and Gurdolin visited.

column3:
ズールは黒騎士のポーン――
すなわち、黒騎士は覚者ということ――
はて、いかなる竜の覚者か――うーむ――
column4:
Zuhl serves the Black Knight as a Pawn— 
Thus, the Black Knight is an Arisen— 
But what sort of Dragon's Arisen...? Hmm—

column3:
この世界には白竜様の他にも竜がいる――
鳥肌ものの話だよね？
column4:
There are Dragons in this world
aside from Lord White Dragon—
It's quite the hair-raising story, huh?

column3:
それに黒騎士
とんでもない強敵なんだろう？
column4:
Also, the Black Knight must be
a formidable opponent, right?

column3: もちろん、謎の少女セシリーも――
column4:
And, of course, 
there's the mysterious girl, Cecily--

column3:
ああ、興味あるなあ
でも、僕は当面、その黒騎士が現れたという
島探しだ
column4:
Ah, I'm quite interested, 
but for now, I need to search for the island
where the Black Knight appeared.

column3: 早く良い報せを届けられるようにせいぜい頑張るよ
column4: I'll do my best to bring you good news soon.

column3:
隊長、リンウッドのあたり、魔物がわんさか増えて
大変なことになってるみたいですよ
column4:
Captain, it appears that the area around Lynwood
is swarming with monsters, 
and it's become a serious problem.

column3: 騎士団から、応援要請がありました
column4: The Knights have requested our support.

column3:
引き受けるかどうかは別にして
話だけは聞いてくださいよ
騎士団本部で副団長が待ってます
column4:
Whether or not you accept, 
please at least listen to what they have to say.
The deputy commander awaits you
at the knight's headquarters.

column3:
少し前までの騎士団と覚者の対立は
俺に言わせればくだらない話ですよ
column4:
The recent conflict between the Knights
and the Arisen was a bunch of crap if you ask me.

column3:
そもそもの立場が違いますからね
どっちが上か下かなんて話は意味がありません
column4:
Our positions are fundamentally different, 
the matter of who is superior or inferior
is just meaningless to argue.

column3:
組織力では騎士団だが、戦闘力となると
やはり覚者だ
快く力を貸してやってくれ
column4:
The Knight's Order may excel in organization, 
but in terms of combat power, 
it is indeed the Arisen who stand out. 
Please lend your strength readily.

column3:
島探しは騎士団と冒険心に富んだ
船乗りたちが中心の予定だったけど
侵食魔退治に騎士達を取られてね――
column4:
The island search was meant to be 
centered around the Knights and 
adventurous sailors, but with 
the knights drawn away to combat 
the encroaching monsters, plans 
have shifted.

column3: 正直、広大無辺な海で困惑しているところさ
column4:
To be honest, I am perplexed in this vast,
endless sea.

column3:
隊長、騎士団員たちの間で人望あるよね
騎士団長に気に入られてるんでしょ？
それって、すごいことだよね
column4:
Captain, you're well-liked among the 
knights, right? You've caught the 
commander's eye. That's really something.

column3:
リンウッドというのは遠いのですか？
人は大勢住んでいるのですか？
早く行った方がいいですよね？
column4:
Is Lynwood distant? Do many people 
reside there? We ought to head there 
quickly, right?

column3:
おお、あんたが来てくれるなら心強い
まず、状況を説明させてくれ
column4:
Ah, it's encouraging to have you here. 
First, let me explain the situation.

column3:
"侵食魔"はわかるか？
あの嵐の夜以来出没するようになった
正体不明の魔物だ
column4:
Are you familiar with the "Corruption Demons"? 
They started showing up after that stormy night. 
Its true nature remains unknown.

column3:
毒に身体を侵食されたような見た目だから
いつの間にか"侵食魔"と呼ばれるようになった
column4:
It looks like a creature whose body is
corrupted by poison, which is why it has
come to be known as the "Corruption Demon."

column3:
そいつらの影響で、昔からレスタニアに棲む
魔物も何かに侵食されているようだ
これもまとめて"侵食魔"と呼んでいる
column4:
It seems that the creatures native to
Lestania have also been affected by
something due to their influence.
They are also collectively known as the 
"Corruption Demons."

column3:
目下、この"侵食魔"どもが、各地で暴れて
我々騎士団は対応に追われているというわけだ
column4:
At present, these "Corruption Demons" are 
running rampant across the land, and 
we knights are scrambling to respond 
to the situation.

column3:
さて"侵食魔"は
あんたとガルドリンが見てきた島から
渡ってきたという説が有力だ
column4:
Now, the prevailing theory is that 
the "Corruption Demons" crossed over 
from the island that you and 
Gurdolin have visited.

column3:
黒騎士が操っているという者もいるが
真偽の程はまだわかっていない
column4:
Some say the Black Knight is the one
controlling them, but the truth of it
remains unknown.

column3: その答えも例の島にあるらしいが、しかし――
column4:
That answer seems to lie on that island,
but still――

column3:
"侵食魔"討伐に追われる我が騎士団は
例の島探しに人手を割けずにいる
な？　これは由々しい問題だろう？
column4:
The knights of my order, pressed with the 
slaying of "Corruption Demons," cannot 
afford to allocate manpower for the 
search of that island. Is this not 
a serious matter?

column3:
取り引きを迫るわけではないが
我々もほとほと困っている
リンウッドへ行ってゲルト騎士団長の部隊を
手助けしてほしいのだ
column4:
I don't mean to press for a deal, but 
we are in dire straits. Please head 
to Lynwood and help Commander Gerd's 
knight order with their tasks.

column3:
あのあたりの"侵食魔"退治が終われば
我々は島探しの人員を確保できるようになる
――考えてみてくれ
column4:
When we finish slaying the "Corruption Demons" 
nearby, we will be able to 
gather forces for the island search. 
Please give it some thought.

column3:
交換条件を出したようで気が引けるが――
何しろ、侵食魔が多すぎるのだ
悪く思わないでくれ
column4:
I hesitate to present this as a 
condition, but there are far too 
many Corruption Demons around. 
Please don't take offense.

column3:
あんたらに礼を欠く物言いをしたことが
あったかもしれないが忘れてほしい
俺も忘れようとしているところだ――懸命にな
column4:
I might have expressed myself 
without the proper respect 
before, so I hope you can 
overlook it. I am also trying 
to forget it—I'm doing my 
best.

column3:
わたしの親友もリンウッドの魔物退治に
参戦しているのだ
column4:
My close friend is also participating in the 
monster hunt in Lynwood.

column3:
おまえが応援に駆け付ければ
彼らも心強いだろうよ
column4:
If you rush to support them,
they will feel more confident.

column3: おお、援軍か？
column4: Oh, reinforcements?

column3:
"侵食魔"の強さが桁違いでな
村人を避難させようとしていたところだ
column4:
I was attempting to shelter
the villagers from the overwhelming strength
of the "Corruption Demon."

column3:
しかし、貴殿の加勢があれば百人力！
もうひと押しだけしてみるか
column4:
But with your support, 
we would have the strength of a hundred men!
Let's give it one more push.

column3: さあ、敵は、あっちだ
column4: Come on, the enemy is over there.

column3:
貴殿はまた腕を上げたという評判だ
見せてもらおうか！
column4:
I've heard that you've further honed your skills.
Let me see them in action!

column3: 魔物よ、鎮まれ！
column4: You monsters, be still!

column3: 騎士たちよ！　我に続け！
column4: Knights! Follow me!

column3: 覚者よ！　存分に戦え！
column4: Arisen! Battle with all your might!

column3: いいぞ、いいぞ！
column4: Good, good!

column3: 押せ押せ～！
column4: Onwards~!

column3: 気迫で攻めろ～！
column4: Attack with your heart~!

column3: ひるむな！
column4: Don't falter!

column3: 前へ！　前へ！
column4: Forward! Onwards!

column3: とどめを刺して名をあげよ！
column4: Finish them off and earn your renown!

column3: 白竜の騎士、ここにあり！
column4: The Knights of the White Dragon stand at the ready!

column3: 怯むな～！
column4: Don't be scared~!

column3: 団長！　俺を見てますか～！
column4: Commander! Are you watching me~?

column3: おらー！
column4: Hey nowー!

column3: こっち見ろ、こっち！
column4: Look this way, over here!

column3: 騎士団を舐めるなあ～！
column4: Don't underestimate the knights!

column3: 統率の右腕と共闘とは光栄至極！
column4:
Fighting alongside the leader's right hand is 
an incredible honor!

column3: この戦い、一生忘れまじ
column4:
This fight is one I will never forget 
for all my days.

column3: 我が人生、戦場に見つけたり！
column4:
I discovered my life's calling on the 
field of battle!

column3: 救援、感謝する
column4: Thank you for the rescue.

column3:
さあ、神殿に戻ろうではないか
次の任務が我々を待っているはずだ
column4:
Now, let us head back to the temple; 
our next task should be waiting for us.

column3:
頼みを聞いてくれて感謝している
むろん、約束は守るよ
島探し担当の増員は期待してくれ
column4:
Thank you for heeding my request. 
Naturally, I will keep my promise. 
Expect an increase in personnel for 
the island search efforts.

column3:
礼をいうよ
さすが覚者だ
column4:
I thank you for this.
Truly, as expected of the Arisen.

column3:
どうやら、わたしを苛つかせる覚者は
ガルドリンだけだということがはっきりした
原因がわかれば、あとひと息だ
column4:
It's becoming clear to me that Gurdolin
is the only Arisen who irritates me so.
Once I figure out the reason, it will abate.

column3:
ごくろうだったな
向こうでの活躍は聞いている
column4:
You've done well.
I've heard about your feats over there.

column3:
おそらく魔物退治はこれ一度で終わりでは
ないだろう――その時はよろしく頼むぞ
column4:
This monster hunting
will likely not end with
just this one time—when
that time comes, I'll count
on you.

column3:
隊長が騎士団をどうこう言わない人で
良かったですよ
column4:
The Captain is someone who doesn't
disparage the knights, I'm glad.

column3:
問題は覚者同士の対立ですよね
たとえばガルドリンと俺とか――
column4:
The problem lies in the rivalry among 
Arisen, like Gurdolin and me――

column3:
いやいや、俺、抑えてますから大丈夫！
ええ、大丈夫ですとも
column4:
No, no, I'm keeping it in check, so 
everything's fine! Yes, I'm perfectly fine.

column3:
ご苦労だった
時に、ゲルトの、おまえへの信頼は本物だな
一時はどうなることかと肝を冷やしたものだが――
column4:
Great work.
Gerd's faith in you isn't misplaced, it seems.
There was a moment when I feared
what might become of us――

column3:
おつかれさま
島探し部隊が大幅に増員されることを
期待しようか
column4:
Thanks for your hard work.
I hope the island search unit 
will see a major boost in personnel.

column3:
いい機会だから話しておこう
今後についての提案だ
column4:
Given this opportunity, I want to discuss 
something. It's a proposal for the future.

column3:
現在、騎士団は侵食魔をレスタニアから
駆逐するために東へ西へと部隊を展開している
村々を拠点とした警備網を作るのが当面の目標だ
column4:
Right now, the knights are mobilizing troops 
east and west to eliminate the encroaching 
monsters from Lestania. The immediate aim 
is to set up a security system centered 
around the villages.

column3:
しかし、侵食魔の排除は
あくまでも対症療法にすぎない
column4:
However, the elimination of the encroaching
monsters is merely a symptomatic treatment.

column3:
痛みは和らげることはできるだろうが
病巣を排除することはできないだろう
column4:
While the pain can be eased, the root of the
illness cannot be eliminated.

column3:
提案というのは他でもない
各地に跋扈する侵食魔の退治は
我々騎士団に任せてくれ
column4:
The idea is to have the knights take on the 
task of eliminating the encroaching monsters 
that plague the regions.

column3:
貴殿ら覚者は、このレスタニアを
あの嵐の夜以前の状態に
戻す道を見つけてほしい
column4:
You Arisen are tasked with discovering 
the way to return Lestania to how it was 
before that stormy night.

column3:
そもそも、侵食魔とはなんだ？
そこからして、まだわかっていないのだ
column4:
What exactly are the Corruption Demons, 
to start with? We still do not know enough 
about them.

column3:
手分けをして――時に協力し合って
レスタニアを危機から救い出そうではないか
column4:
Let us divide our efforts and, at times, work
together to save Lestania from its crisis.

column3:
我々が信頼と友情で結ばれていれば
レスタニアは安泰だ
column4:
As long as we are united by trust and 
friendship, Lestania will be safe.

column3:
騎士と覚者はレスタニアを乗せた荷車の両輪
どちらが速くても、遅くても、真っ直ぐに進めない
column4:
The Knights and the Arisen are the two wheels 
of the cart that bears Lestania. If either 
is too fast or too slow, we cannot move 
forward steadily.

column3:
ディアマンテスを巡る一連の戦いで
共闘したことが、騎士と覚者を分かつ溝を
埋めたのだとすれば――
column4:
If the series of battles surrounding
Diamantes has filled the rift
between the Knights and Arisen, then—

column3:
死んだ者、残された者の無念も
幾分か、報われるだろうよ
column4:
The grievances of the dead and the
sorrow of those left behind will,
in some measure, be fulfilled.

column3:
セシリーに勝手を許すな
いいな？
column4:
Do not allow Cecily to have her way.
Understood?

column3:
ああ、もどかしい――
せめて、記憶が戻れば――
column4:
Ah, this is exasperating―― 
At least if my memories would come back――

column3:
セシリーの焦り――
よく耐えていると思いますよ
なんとかしてあげたいですよね――
column4:
Cecily's frustration―― 
I believe she is managing well. 
We wish to help her in any way――

column3:
古来より、人が記憶を無くすことは
まま、あることだ
column4:
Since ancient times, it has been common for
humans to lose their memories.

column3:
しかし、そんな者たちが記憶を取り戻した
方法となると、千差万別でな――
column4:
Yet, when it comes to the ways those 
individuals recover their memories, they 
are countless and diverse.

column3:
白竜の言うことに間違いはねえんだろうよ
セシリーには酷な話かもしれねえが
あれこれ我慢してもらわねえとな
column4:
There's no doubt in the White Dragon's 
words, though it may be hard for Cecily. 
She will have much to put up with.

column3:
わたしたちにできるのは
セシリーを守ってあげることくらいかな
他にも何かあればいいけど――
column4:
All we can do is protect Cecily.
It would be great if there were more, 
but this is about all we can offer.

column3: 朗報朗報！
column4: Good news, good news!

column3:
島が見つかったよ！
もちろん、君たちが黒騎士を見たあの島さ
column4:
We found an island!
Sure enough, it's the island 
where you saw the Black Knight.

column3:
騎士団、調査船の船長ゼルキンをはじめ
関係者の苦労が、やっと実ったというわけ
column4:
The Knight's Order and Zerkin, captain of the 
investigation ship, along with others, 
have at last seen their hard work pay off.

column3:
彼らはあの島を"魔赤島（マセキトウ）"
と呼んでいる
column4: The place is called "Bloodbane Isle."

column3:
既に幾ばくかの先発隊が、島に駐屯地を
築くべく港を出発しているんだ
column4:
Some advance teams have already left the port to
build a garrison on the island.

column3:
君達も、港のゼルキンに話しかければ
乗船できるように手配済みだ
column4:
Talk to Zerkin at the harbor; 
he's arranged for you to board soon.

column3:
さあ、行きなよ！
神殿の地下の港から船が出るよ
column4:
Now, off you go!
The ship departs from the harbor
under the Temple.

column3:
待ちきれません！
早く行きましょう
column4:
I can't wait!
Let's go!

column3:
セシリーは俺が港に案内するんで
隊長はどうぞお先に
column4:
I will take Cecily to the port, 
so, Captain, please go ahead.

column3: 先に船に乗ってるぜ
column4: I'll board the ship first.

column3:
船旅は苦手なんだけど
そんなこと言ってられないよね
うん、がんばるよ
column4:
I dislike traveling by sea, 
but I can't complain about it now. 
Yeah, I'll push through.

column3: よう、いよいよあんたの出番って訳だな
column4: Well, it's finally your turn now.

column3:
あの時の嵐と魔物どもがやってくる方角を頼りに
ついに"魔赤島（マセキトウ）"を見つけだして
やったのよ
column4:
Following the direction of the storm and 
monsters from that time, we at last found 
the "Bloodbane Isle." We did it!

column3:
さあさあ、早く乗ってくれ
あんたが乗り次第、出港だ！
column4:
Come on, get on quickly! 
As soon as you're on board, we'll set sail!

column3:
さーて、隊長さんよ
まずは、先発隊の築いている
駐屯地とやらへ向かうとしようぜ
column4:
Alright, Captain, 
first, we'll go to the 
encampment the advance 
team is establishing.

column3:
"侵食魔"どもは相変わらずこの島から
ひゅーひゅー飛んで行きやがる
column4:
The gall of these Corruption Demons,
blowing over from this island.

column3:
どっからわいてくるんだか――
その源を見つけて、はやくぶっ叩いてやりたいぜ
column4:
I want to quickly find the source of where
they're coming from―― and smash it!

column3: な？　この島に間違いないだろう？
column4:
Right? This island is definitely the one,
isn't it?

column3:
ここに侵食魔の巣窟があるわけ？
緊張するなあ
column4:
Is this where the invaders' lair is? 
I feel so tense.

column3:
もしかして、あの黒騎士もいますかね？
侵食魔だけじゃないですよね
column4:
Maybe that Black Knight is here too? 
It's not just the Corruption Demons, correct?

column3: この島は――はい、わかります――
column4: This island is―― yes, I understand――

column3:
わたしはこの島をよく知っている――
記憶が戻るかもしれません！
column4:
I am quite familiar with this island―― 
my memories could come back!

column3: よく来たな
column4: I'm glad you're here.

column3:
さあ、話の前にまずは
拠点の礎を解放、登録するといい
column4:
Now, before we begin the discussion,
it's best to unlock and attune to the Portcrystal.

column3:
いい？　ここでは何が起きても不思議じゃない
慢心してたらあっという間に命を落とすわよ
column4:
Got it? Anything can happen over here, 
and if you're overconfident,
you could lose your life in an instant.

column3:
ああ、必要な物資があったら言ってくれ
この島で困らないよう、できる限り
手を尽くすからよ
column4:
Ah, if you need any supplies, just let me know.
I'll do everything I can to ensure you
won't have any troubles on this island.

column3:
自分はロルフと言います――
旅の同伴者を求める際には、自分にお声掛け下さい
column4:
I go by Rolf―― 
should you need a companion for your 
journey, just give me a shout.

column3:
白衛騎士団員のスヴェンだ
覚者の手に負えないことがあったら
何でも相談に乗るよ
column4:
I am Sven of the White Guard.
If there is anything beyond the
Arisen's ability, feel free to consult
with me about anything.

column3:
俺はしがない騎士団員かも知れんが
役立つところを見せるつもりさ
column4:
I may be a humble knight of the Order,
but I intend to display my worth.

column3:
想像より、ちゃんとした駐屯地だぜ
なかなか、気が利いていやがる
column4:
This garrison is more respectable
than I had imagined.
They're really well put together.

column3:
ああ――
もう少し探索を続けさせて下さい
column4:
Ah― 
I would like to explore a little longer.

column3: 思ったより、出来てるじゃない――！？
column4: You've turned out to be quite capable―!?

column3:
どうします？
さっそく探索に行きますか？
拠点を確保したとはいえ、敵陣ですからね
なるべく動いた方がいいと思いますよ
column4:
What will you do? 
Shall we start exploring right away? 
Although we've secured the base, 
we are still in enemy territory. 
I think it's best to keep moving.

column3:
俺はこの調査隊駐屯地を預かる
エリアマスターのベルトランだ
column4:
I am Bertrand, the Area Master
in charge of this Expedition Garrison.

column3: お互いとんでもない場所にやって来たもんだな
column4: We've ended up in quite an unbelievable place.

column3:
空にかかる異様な赤い光――
そして、見たことも無い化け物どもが
そこらじゅうに溢れかえっている
column4:
A bizarre red light shines in the sky―― 
And there are monsters I have never seen 
swarming all around us.

column3:
島の調査は始まったばかりだ
ここが完全に機能するまで、少しの時間を頂こう
column4:
The exploration of the island has just begun. 
Please allow us a bit of time until this 
place is fully functional.

column3: 今はお前たちの判断で探索を進めてくれ
column4:
For now, proceed with the exploration
based on your own judgment.

column3: ま、そういうことなら提案だがよ
column4:
Well, in that regard,
I do have a suggestion.

column3:
近くのいわくありげな洞窟から
ぶっ叩くってのはどうだ？
column4:
How about we raid
that suspicious cave nearby?

column3:
おまえも帰れよ
状況が変わったから、白竜がなんか言うかも
しれねえぞ
column4:
You should return as well. Since the 
situation has changed, the White Dragon 
might have something to say.

column3:
セシリーの過去は霧に覆われ見えぬだけ――
無くしたわけではない
column4:
Cecily's history is covered in fog— 
it is not lost, merely hidden.

column3:
霧は濃く、漆黒かもしれぬが、いつか晴れる
それまでは、力を使わせるな――いいな？
column4:
The fog is heavy, maybe even dark as night, 
but it will clear someday. Until then, 
do not compel her to use her 
strength—understand?

column3:
いやいやいや、たまらないね
発見された島が、大陸の一部だったとは！
ごめん、ちょっと興奮しちゃって――
column4:
No, no, no, this is incredible!
The discovered island is part of a
continent! Sorry, I'm just a bit excited—

column3: フィンダム大陸か――
column4: The continent of Phindym--

column3:
その大陸の一部が、レスタニアの沖合に浮かぶ
孤島として出現したわけだな
column4:
So, part of that continent has appeared as a
lonely island floating off the coast of
Lestania, isn't that so?

column3:
不可思議ではあるが、先例がないわけではない
ふむ――
column4:
It is indeed strange, but it is not without
precedent. Hmm―

column3:
そして、島から飛来する"侵食魔"の正体は
フィンダムの魔物だったというわけか――
column4:
So then, the true nature of the 
"Corruption Demons" coming from the 
island is the beasts of Phindym―

column3:
いやいや、待てよ？
フィンダムの魔物だとして、あの異様な状態は
なんとする？
あの"侵食"は、何故起こったのか――
column4:
Wait, wait, hold on? If it's the
monsters of Phindym, what then is the
cause of that strange state? Why
has that "infection" occurred―

column3:
魔物がかかる病だろうか――
それとも何者かの仕業か――
例の黒騎士が関係しているのだろうか――
column4:
Could it be a sickness plaguing 
the monsters― or is it 
the doing of someone? Might 
that Black Knight have a hand 
in this―

column3:
ふむ――
全てが偶然に起こったとは考えにくいな
column4:
Hmm― it's unlikely that 
everything occurred by mere 
coincidence.

column3:
魔赤島のエリアマスター機能が解放されました
調査隊駐屯地にいるベルトランに話しかけてみましょう
column4:
Area Master for Bloodbane Isle has been unlocked.
Talk to Bertrand at the Expedition Garrison.

column3:
隊長、騎士団本部でハインツ副団長が
待ってますよ？
column4:
Captain, Vice Commander Heinz
is waiting at the knight
headquarters, you know?

column3: 侵食魔掃討作戦の件で相談があるとか
column4:
I have something to discuss 
regarding the Corruption Demon 
extermination operation.

column3:
掃討作戦なんて仰々しいこと言って――
何をするつもりなんでしょうね
column4:
Using such a grand term as 
extermination operation— 
what do they intend to 
actually accomplish?

column3:
騎士団が現状打破のための作戦を立てたらしい
ぜひ、ハインツの説明を聞いてくれ
column4:
It seems the Order has devised
a plan to break the current
deadlock. Please, listen to
Heinz's explanation.

column3:
島の調査は一時中断だね
ジョゼフ様の許可さえあれば
僕が行くんだけどなあ
column4:
The island survey is on hold 
for the time being. If I 
had Master Joseph's approval, 
I would go myself.

column3: まずは現状の報告だ
column4:
To start, I will provide a report 
on the current situation.

column3:
自画自賛になるが、騎士団の奮闘目覚ましく
主要な集落では侵食魔による被害は
ほとんど出ていない
column4:
It may sound like self-praise, but the
knights have shown remarkable efforts.
In the major settlements, damage from
the Corruption Demons has been nearly
nonexistent.

column3:
しかし、厄介な侵食魔がいてな
その攻略方法をずっと検討していたのだが
やっと作戦が練り上がった
column4:
However, there is a troublesome Corruption Demon.
I have been pondering ways to combat it, 
and I have finally developed a strategy.

column3:
我々は、その侵食魔を
ドリード城に誘い込んで倒すつもりだ
column4:
We intend to lure that demon
into Dreed Castle and defeat it there.

column3:
そこで君には、城内で迎えるであろう決戦の時に
助力してもらいたい
column4:
I ask for your aid when we face 
the decisive battle within the castle.

column3: あと一歩、あとひと息のために力を貸してくれ
column4:
Lend me your strength for that final step,
that last breath I need to take.

column3:
正直、君の顔を見ると、安心する騎士は多い
勝利のシンボルみたいに思っている奴もいる
column4:
To be honest, many knights feel at ease
when they see your face; some see you
as a sure sign of victory.

column3:
あんたにしてみれば手放しで
喜べることじゃないと思うが――
column4:
I believe you wouldn't see this as something 
to rejoice about unconditionally――

column3:
ガルドリンはすでにドリード城だ
そういうことであれば
わたしはここで待機させてもらうよ
column4:
Gurdolin is already at Dreed Castle. 
In that case, I will take position here.

column3:
わたしは元来現場を好む性分なのだが
ここの留守居を命じられてしまった
自由な覚者がうらやましいよ
column4:
I have always preferred being in the field, 
but I've been ordered to stay here. 
I envy the freedom of the Arisen.

column3:
おまえが来ると知ってから騎士団連中は
誰も討伐失敗に賭けねえ
column4:
Since you came, none of the knights have
bet against the success of the hunt.

column3:
おまえと組めば大儲けできると思っていたが
とんだ誤算だったぜ
column4:
I thought that joining forces with you 
would bring in a fortune, but I was 
gravely mistaken.

column3:
精鋭部隊がここに侵食魔を追い込む
そのあとに貴殿らの出番だ
column4:
The elite unit will force the 
corrupted into this area.
Afterward, it will be your moment, ser.

column3: 存分に腕を振るってくれ
column4: Wield your skills to your heart's content.

column3:
戦いに参加する人たちの勇気や熱意――
それが形になって目に見えるようです
column4:
The bravery and enthusiasm of those 
taking part in the fight――
Victory has become tangible before our eyes.

column3:
自分のことしか考えていなかったことが
とても恥ずかしいです
column4:
It is truly embarrassing that I only 
thought of myself.

column3: 空気がピリピリしてるね――
column4: The air is charged with excitement, isn't it?

column3:
前は苦手だったけど、最近は、この緊張感が好き
わたし、ついに心の底から覚者になれた気がするよ
column4:
I used to dislike this feeling, but recently, I
have come to enjoy this tension. I finally feel
from the bottom of my heart that I have become
an Arisen.

column3:
――レオに関しては釈然としないものが残るが
掃討作戦は成功した
後始末は我々に任せて貴殿は神殿に戻るといい
column4:
――There are still lingering doubts regarding
Leo, but the extermination operation was a
success. Leave the cleanup to us, and you
should return to the temple.

column3:
ありがとう
君の、勝利のシンボルとしての
地位はますます高まるだろう
column4:
Thank you. Your status as a symbol of victory
will only continue to rise.

column3: 少々、嫉妬するよ
column4: Though I must admit, I am a little jealous.

column3:
誰もガルドリンの賭けに乗らなかったらしいな
ふん、いい気味だ
column4:
Apparently, no one took Gurdolin's wager. 
Hmph, that's just desserts for him.

column3:
デュークを悪く思わないでくれ
以前、親しかった女性をガルドリンに――
column4:
Do not think ill of the Duke. 
A woman he was once close to
went to Gurdolin――

column3:
いや、やめておこう
ウワサ好きだと思われるのは不本意だ
column4:
No, I'd rather not get into it.
I don't want to be seen as a rumor-monger.

column3:
セシリーはレオに何か言われたんですか？
何か考え込んでいましたけど――
column4:
Did Cecily say something to Leo?
She seemed to be lost in thought
about something, though――

column3:
レオのことは聞いたよ
一緒に戻って来るかと期待したんだけど――
column4:
I heard about Leo.
I was hoping he would return with you,
but――

column3:
でも、まあ、この事実が、レオの気持ちってわけだ
相変わらずよく分からないけれど
知りたいって思いも、消えちゃったかな
column4:
But, well, this fact represents Leo's feelings. 
As always, I find it hard to understand, 
but perhaps the desire to know has vanished.

column3:
レオが現れたらしいな
まあ、今さら戻れと言う気はないが――
column4:
I hear that Leo has shown up. 
Well, I have no desire to say 
to return now, of all moments――

column3:
その、フィンダムから来たという男を使って
この事態に口を挟む気でいるのなら
一度、話し合う必要があろう
column4:
If that person supposedly hailing from Phindym
intends to interfere in this matter,
then we ought to discuss some things first.

column3:
結構ぶっ倒したってのに侵食魔どもは
まだまだ暴れていやがる
なのに、騎士団連中は救援要請に応え切れてねえ
column4:
We've defeated a good number of them, 
but the encroaching fiends continue 
to wreak havoc. Still, the Knight's Order
hasn't fully answered the call for help.

column3:
騎士団からまた応援を依頼されるのも
時間の問題だろうよ
column4:
It won't be long before the knights 
ask for reinforcements again.

column3:
というわけで、だ――
俺が馴染みの覚者たちと一緒に
侵食魔退治を引き受けるから
column4:
So, it's settled—
I will take on the task of
defeating the encroaching fiends
with the Arisen I'm familiar with.

column3: おまえはセシリーの世話に専念してやれ
column4: You should concentrate on taking care of Cecily.

column3:
あの小娘が記憶を取り戻さねえと
らちがあかねえんだろ？
column4:
Unless that young lady gets her memories back, 
there's no telling how this will end, right?

column3: 若い娘が面倒だから逃げるわけじゃねえぞ
column4:
It's not that I'm avoiding the girl 
because she's a bother or anything.

column3:
セシリーの姿が見えないと不安になりますね
またひとりでどこかへ行ってしまったのかも
しれない――なんて
column4:
When Cecily is out of sight, it makes me 
worried. Maybe she's gone off somewhere 
by herself again—who can say?

column3:
僕は島の調査に行きたいんだよね
それなのにジョゼフ様が――
column4:
I wish to conduct an investigation
on the island, but Master Joseph refuses
to let me go anywhere near it—

column3: やっぱり、信用されてないのかな
column4: I guess they don't trust me after all.

column3:
面目ない――
わたしの監督不行き届きだ
column4:
Fie, I'm so embarrassed— 
I've been careless about managing myself.

column3: メイリーフの家からセシリーが姿を消した
column4: Cecily has disappeared from Mayleaf's place!

column3:
なんでも、レオの使いが現れて
フロックヴァルト大橋に来るよう、告げたらしい
column4:
Apparently, Leo's messenger has come 
to say to gather at the Flocwald Bridge.

column3:
例の、ロイグという男と会わせてやるという
ことだろうな
それを考えると、セシリーを責めるのは
酷というもの――
column4:
It seems they will arrange for you
to meet that man named Loeg.
Thinking about that, it would be cruel
to blame Cecily for this.

column3:
ともあれ、事態を知ったリズが後を追っている
が、ひとりでは心許ない
おまえも行ってくれんか？
column4:
Nonetheless, Lise is currently in pursuit
after learning of the situation,
but she feels insecure on her own.
Will you go accompany her?

column3:
セシリーは、フロックヴァルト大橋に向かっている
レオに主導権を渡すわけにはいかんぞ
column4:
Cecily is making her way to Flocwald Bridge.
We cannot let Leo take the reins of the situation.

column3: オマイに用はない！
column4: I have no use for you!

column3: 邪魔くさい奴らめ！
column4: These annoying pests!

column3: 病んだ竜の覚者など、ひとひねり！
column4: Arisen of that stricken dragon, get twisted!

column3: 女出せ～！　何度でも言うぞ～！
column4:
Bring out the woman～!
I'll say it over and over ～!

column3: 手加減してるうちに、言うこと聞け～！
column4: I'm being lenient, but you'd better listen!

column3: おぉ～、楽しくなってきたわ！
column4: Oh, things are starting to get exciting!

column3: 女～！　こっち来～い！
column4: O Lady～! Come here～!

column3: あぁ――面倒くさくなってきた
column4: Ah――This is getting tedious.

column3: 本気出すぞコノヤロウらめ！
column4: I'm about to get serious, you bastards!

column3: どうしてその女にこだわる――
column4: Why do you need her so bad―

column3: オマイらは――わからん
column4: You lot just don't get it―

column3: 怖れろ――逃げ出せ――舐めるな――
column4:
Tremble― Flee before me―
Do not take me lightly―

column3:
セシリー、かわいそうだね
わたしたちに相談もせずに飛び出したのに
望みは叶わなかったんだもの――
column4:
Poor Cecily.
She dashed off without telling us,
she couldn't get what she wanted...

column3:
もはやレスタニアに安寧はない――
あんなことを言わせてしまって――
column4:
There is no peace left in Lestania――
For her to say such things――

column3:
わたしが不甲斐ないばかりに――
口惜しいです
column4:
Because of my own inadequacy―― 
it is frustrating.

column3:
侵食魔退治は順調と言えば順調だが
やっぱり、キリがねえぞ
column4:
The eradication of the encroaching demons
is going well, but there is still no end in sight.

column3:
巣窟を見つけ出してぶっ叩くとか
しねえとよ
column4:
We need to find the lair and smash it,
or else we won't survive.

column3:
まだ問題は残っているけど
あのズールを倒したわけですから
もうちょっと祝勝気分になりたかったですねえ
column4:
While there are still issues to tackle, 
we have taken down Zuhl. 
I had hoped to indulge in celebrating
that victory a bit more, honestly.

column3: 一連の出来事の黒幕は黒騎士――
column4:
The orchestrator of this chain of events
is the Black Knight himself――

column3:
セシリーには悪いけど彼女の問題はさておいて
黒騎士によるレスタニアへの侵略と見なして
戦いの準備を進めた方がいいかもしれないよ
column4:
I feel bad for Cecily, but her issues aside,
it might be better for us to prepare for battle
against the Black Knight's invasion of Lestania.

column3: ふむ――事の次第をまとめると――
column4: Hmm... to sum things up――

column3:
侵食魔を我がレスタニアに
送りこんだのは黒騎士で――
目的はセシリーの居場所の特定か
column4:
The one who sent the Corruption Demons to Lestania
was the Black Knight— was their aim to find Cecily?

column3:
なるほど、セシリーなら、必ず魔物の前に
立つだろうからな
column4:
I understand. 
If it's Cecily, she will undoubtedly 
face the monsters head-on.

column3:
うーむ――
黒騎士は侵食魔どもを操ることができる――
column4:
Hmm— 
The Dark Knight has the power
to command the encroaching monsters—

column3:
となれば――
オークどもとの戦争など比較にならない
苦難が待ち受けているのかもしれん
column4:
If that is so— 
The conflict with the Orcs is nothing
compared to the difficulties that lie ahead.

column3:
いやいやいや――そうはさせるか！
させてなるものか！
column4:
No, no, no—
I won't allow that!
I absolutely won't let that happen!

column3:
我々騎士団は要衝の守備を固める
神殿と砦はまかせてくれ
column4:
We, the Knights, shall fortify
the defenses of the stronghold.
Leave the Temple and fortress to us.

column3:
侵食魔の出現情報が混乱しているようだな
噂に惑わされないよう、気をつけるのだぞ
column4:
It seems the information given about the
emergence of the Corrupted isn't reliable.
Do not let yourself be misled by rumors; take care.

column3:
新興の侵食魔を放っておくと
居場所を失った、昔からいる魔物達が
人里になだれ込む可能性もあるんだ
column4:
If we leave the newly emerging 
Corruption Demons unchecked, 
the monsters that have lived here for ages
may lose their habitats and be forced
to storm into human settlements.

column3: もしかしたら、もう始まっているかもしれない！
column4: Maybe that process has already started!

column3:
隊長さん、わたしもひとりの部下として
扱ってください
よろしくお願いします！
column4:
Captain, please treat me
as one of your subordinates.
I look forward to your guidance!

column3:
少数の精鋭による遊撃部隊――
隊長、燃える割り当てですね！
column4:
A small elite strike force―― 
Captain, we have an exciting task, don't we!

column3:
北の方へ行こうと思ってるんだ
もちろん隊長に従うけど、一応希望を
言ってみただけ
column4:
I'm thinking of going north.
I will definitely obey, Captain,
but I wanted to voice my preference.

column3:
こりゃ忙しくなるぞ
今のうちに腹一杯喰っておくか
column4:
Things are about to get hectic.
I'd better eat my fill while I have the chance!

column3:
神殿は我々が守る
心おきなく、遠征に出てくれ
column4:
The Temple will be safeguarded by us.
Embark on your expedition without hesitation!

column3:
そうは見えないかもしれないが
わたしはあんたに一目置いているんだ
column4:
It may not appear so,
but I have great respect for you.

column3:
わたしの目は確かだってことを
証明して見せてくれ
column4: Show me that my judgment is sound.

column3:
わたしはここで、おまえたちの武運が尽きることなく
長久であることを祈ろう
column4:
I shall pray that your fortunes of war
remain ever-flowing as you continue
to do battle for our sakes.

column3:
お、おう――酔いが覚めたら、参戦するつもりさ
まったく、間が悪い――
column4:
Ah, well—once I'm sober,
I plan to join in the fight.
Truly, what terrible timing—

column3:
ここはわたしと部下達でじゅうぶん！
騎士団といい、おまえといい
わたしを引退させたいのか！？
column4:
My men and I are more than enough here!
The Knights are good, you are good...
You think I'm ever going to quit?!

column3:
貴殿の戦いぶり、すでに聞こえているぞ
あっぱれ、あっぱれ！
column4:
I have already heard of your fighting prowess. 
Impressive, truly impressive!

column3:
ゆっくり休んでくれと言いたいところだが
状況がそれを許さないのだ
いましばらく、侵食魔の相手を頼む
column4:
I would like to say to take a good rest, 
but the situation does not allow it. 
For now, please handle the Corruption Demons.

column3:
侵食魔の出現情報が次から次へと！
こりゃまだまだ落ち着けませんよ！
column4:
Reports of the Corruption Demons keep coming 
in waves! We can't settle down just yet!

column3: メルゴダは任せるぞ！
column4: I'll leave Mergoda to you!

column3:
ふん――わたしに言わせれば
距離を置きたがっているのは
メルゴダの錬金術師たちの方だ
column4:
Hmph――if you ask me,
it's the alchemists of Mergoda
who want to keep their distance.

column3: 干渉されたくないのだろうよ
column4:
It appears they would prefer 
not to be disturbed.

column3:
レスタニアの歴史を考えると
錬金術師たちが忌み嫌われるのも
仕方のないことだよね
column4:
Considering the history of Lestania,
it's no wonder that the alchemists are so reviled.

column3:
ジョゼフ様の頭が特別に固いというわけでもないのさ
それはわかってるんだけど――
ああ、もどかしいよ
column4:
It's not that Master Joseph
has a particularly stubborn mind. 
I know that, but―― 
Ah, it's exasperating!

column3: 隊長はメルゴダの長と親しいのだとか
column4:
I've heard that the Captain is close 
with the head of Mergoda.

column3:
きっと、喜ばれますよ
さあ、行ってあげてください！
column4:
I'm certain they will be delighted. 
Now, please go and assist them!

column3: おお、君が来てくれたのか！
column4: Oh, you're here!

column3: 今も魔物どもはメルゴダ各所を襲撃中だ
column4:
The monsters are still raiding 
various areas of Mergoda.

column3:
異形の魔物の突然の襲撃に
備えのない我々は成す術が無く
多くの仲間が負傷してしまった
column4:
Caught off guard by the sudden attack 
of the monstrous beings, we had no means 
to defend ourselves, resulting in many 
of our comrades getting injured.

column3:
君が救援に来てくれて本当に心強いよ
いや、ありがとう――
column4:
Your arrival assures us greatly.
No, thank you――

column3:
メルゴダがどうなろうと救援など来ないのだろうと
我々は思っていた
column4:
Nós pensamos que, não importa o que acontecesse
com Mergoda, o socorro nunca viria.

column3:
自衛のための道を模索すべきだという提案を
するか否か、迷っていたところだ
column4:
Eu estava apenas me perguntando se deveria ou não sugerir
que deveríamos buscar caminhos para a autodefesa.

column3:
黒騎士はどこの何者だ？
あの鎧はレスタニアのものではないぞ？
column4:
Quem é o Cavaleiro Negro
e de onde ele vem?
Aquela armadura não é de Lestania, é?

column3:
興味深い――
いつか破片だけでも手に入らないだろうか――
column4:
Que interessante――
Será que algum dia eu conseguiria colocar minhas mãos em
até mesmo um pequeno fragmento daquilo――

column3:
活躍は聞いてるぞ
さすがだな
column4:
Eu tenho ouvido falar de suas realizações.
Realmente notável, como eu pensava.

column3:
まだ戦場の顔だな
深呼吸しろ
column4:
Você ainda parece estar no campo de batalha.
Respire fundo.

column3:
ここには敵はいない
みんなあんたの友達だ
column4:
Não há inimigos presentes aqui.
Todos são seus aliados.

column3:
ふむ――祈りは届いたようだな
白竜様の竜力が運んでくださったのだろう
ちゃんと礼をしておくんだな
column4:
Bem―parece que nossas orações foram atendidas.
Certamente o poder de Lorde Dragão Branco
os entregou a nós.
Teremos certeza de mostrar nossa gratidão.

column3:
ごくろう
おまえの配下たちも無事のようだぞ
column4:
Bem feito.
Seus subordinados parecem estar seguros também.

column3:
おかえり
テオドールはどんな様子だった？
column4: Bem-vindo de volta. Como estava Theodor?

column3:
まあ、錬金術の処遇は気になるけど
気持ちを切り替えて
目下の黒騎士問題に対処しないとね
column4:
Embora o estado da alquimia me preocupe,
precisamos mudar o foco e
abordar a questão do Cavaleiro Negro.

column3:
ガルドリンを頼む
失えば大きな損失であることはもちろん
あの男にもしものことがあれば――
column4:
Eu confio Gurdolin a você.
Não só sua perda seria grave,
mas se algo acontecesse com aquele homem―

column3: エリオットも生涯苦しむことになるだろう
column4:
Elliot viverá em tormento
pelo resto de seus dias.

column3:
ガルドリンとエリオットは、僕の提案で
島の海岸沿いを調査していたはずなんだ
column4:
Gurdolin e Elliot, conforme minha sugestão,
deveriam estar investigando a costa da ilha.

column3:
僕からもお願いだ――
一刻も早くガルドリンの元へ駆けつけ
助けてあげてくれないか
column4:
Eu também imploro――
Corra para Gurdolin o mais rápido possível
e ajude-o.

column3:
それとリズとセシリーを見つけたら
すぐに君の後を追わせるよ
column4:
E quando eu encontrar Lise e Cecily,
Eu os mandarei atrás de você o mais rápido possível.

column3:
なんだか慌ただしいな
急ぐなら、さあ、乗った乗った
column4:
Parece um pouco agitado.
Se você está com pressa, vamos, embarque!

column3:
力が抜けちゃいました
良かったぁ
column4:
Estou completamente exausto.
Ainda bem que acabou.

column3:
おかえり――
ガルドリンが無事で本当に良かったよ
column4:
Bem-vindo de volta――
Estou realmente feliz que Gurdolin esteja seguro.

column3:
島の状況は一進一退というところかな
そろそろ、半歩でいいから前に進みたいね
column4:
A situação na ilha
é uma luta de vai e vem.
Já está na hora de darmos nem que seja meio passo à frente.

column3:
エリオットとガルドリン
なかなかイイ組み合わせだったのかな？
この部隊の人選って、深いかも――
column4:
Elliot e Gurdolin,
parecem uma boa combinação, não acha?
A escolha dos membros que compõem esta unidade
é bastante significativa―

column3:
全員で帰ってこられて良かったですね！
絆も、強くなったようですし
column4:
Que bom que todos voltaram em segurança!
Parece que nossos laços ficaram mais fortes também.

column3:
なるほど――
黒騎士の影響により、これまでの侵食魔を超える
魔物まで呼び込まれているのであれば――
column4:
Entendo――
Se, devido à influência do Cavaleiro Negro, até mesmo monstros que superam
o poder dos Demônios da Corrupção estão sendo convocados――

column3:
黒騎士を倒さない限り、この戦いに
終わりは来ないというわけだ
column4:
A menos que derrotemos o Cavaleiro Negro,
esta batalha nunca terminará.

column3: 黒騎士を倒す方策を探し出し、実行する――
column4:
Buscar um método para derrotar
o Cavaleiro Negro e executá-lo――

column3: これはおまえたちに任せるより他はない
column4:
I have no choice but to leave this 
in your hands, Arisen.

column3:
その代わりというわけではないが
セシリーの記憶を取り返す方法を考えたのだ
column4:
While it doesn't exactly make up for it, 
I've come up with a method to restore 
Cecily's memories.

column3:
ロイグとセシリーのふたりに記憶合わせを
させるのはどうだ？
column4:
What if we have Loeg and Cecily
join together to recall their memories?

column3:
どちらかの記憶が種となり
豆のツルをたぐり寄せるように次々と――
column4:
If one memory can serve as the seed,
it might sprout, drawing others in,
like a vine entwining――

column3: 試す価値があると思わんか？
column4: Don't you think it's worth a shot?

column3:
レオにはレオの思惑があるのだろうが
道理を説き、納得させるしかない
column4:
Leo likely has his own designs, 
yet we must explain the logic 
and make him see reason.

column3:
ダウ渓谷を根城にしていると聞いている
訪ねて、こちらの意向を伝えてくれ
column4:
I've heard they have made their stronghold 
in the Dowe Valley. Please visit them and 
convey our intentions.

column3:
ダウ渓谷へ行ったら、それとなく様子を
探ってくれ
column4:
When you arrive in the Dowe Valley, 
kindly check the situation discreetly.

column3:
アジトの規模、同調者の有無――
敵意や悪意――いろいろとな
column4:
The scale of the hideout, presence of 
sympathizers――hostility and malice―― 
there are many factors at play.

column3:
ロイグもセシリーのように、何か特別な
力を持っているのだろうか――
column4:
If Loeg possesses some special power 
like Cecily's――

column3:
レオはどこまで気づいているのか――
あるいは知っているのか――
column4:
How much is Leo aware of―― 
Or does he know anything at all――

column3: 注意深く、観察する必要がありそうだね
column4: I think we must be careful and observe.

column3:
じいさん、なんだかんだ言って
レオに帰ってきて欲しいんだぜ？
年寄りは変化を嫌うからな
column4:
Gramps, no matter what he says, 
he just wants Leo to return, you see? 
Old folks tend to resist change.

column3:
レオはダウ渓谷にいる――
ジョゼフったら、ちゃんと情報を仕入れて
いたんだね
column4:
Leo is in the Dowe Valley―― 
Joseph managed to get his facts straight,
it seems.

column3:
レオの思惑って、なんでしょうね？
セシリーの身を案じていたとか聞きましたけど
本心だと思いますか？
column4:
I wonder what Leo's plans are, truly? 
I heard he has concern for Cecily,
but do you think that's genuine?

column3:
ここにいるとホッとするんです
だからついつい来てしまって――
column4:
I feel a sense of relief when I'm here. 
That's why I can't help but return—

column3:
レオのアジトはこの中――
ずっと深いところらしいぜ
column4:
Leo's hideout is within here— 
it seems to be much deeper inside.

column3: あんたが先行して潜ってくれ
column4: You go ahead and dive in first.

column3:
ひよっこどもを挟んで、俺はしんがりを引き受ける
黒騎士が虎視眈々と狙っているだろうからな
column4:
I'll take up the rear with the greenhorns 
in front, for the Black Knight is likely 
stalking us closely.

column3:
レオって、こんなところに潜んでいても
落ちぶれた感じがしないのが不思議だよね
column4:
It's curious how Leo doesn't feel degraded,
despite lurking in a place like this.

column3: だから、危険人物なのかもしれないけど
column4: He just might be a dangerous figure.

column3: 隊長？
column4: Captain?

column3: セシリーとロイグ――
column4: Cecily and Loeg ――

column3:
フィンダムから来たふたりが都合良く記憶を
無くしてるなんて、出来すぎじゃありませんか？
column4:
Isn't it a bit too convenient that the two 
who came from Phindym both lost their memories?

column3:
セシリーはまるっと忘れてるみたいだけど
ロイグは、なんだか中途半端で――
column4:
Cecily seems to have forgotten all about it,
but Loeg is kind of halfway--

column3: ハッキリいって、おれ、疑ってます
column4: For the record, I'm skeptical.

column3:
ここに来たのはジョゼフの発案か？
ならば、伝えてくれ
column4:
Did Joseph suggest coming here?
If so, please tell me.

column3:
俺の方に敵意はない
将来的には、そっち次第だが、と
column4:
I bear no ill will towards you. Ultimately, 
though, it will be up to you in the end.

column3:
ええと――
ロイグの症状、わたし、知ってるかもしれないの
ずっと、ずっと前には当たり前だった病気――
column4:
Well then―― I might be familiar with Loeg's 
condition. It was an ordinary illness ages ago.

column3:
ああでも、思い出せない
誰か知らないかなあ
column4:
Ah, but I can't seem to remember.
Is there anyone who might know?

column3: ロイグの看病は任せてくださいね！
column4: Please leave Loeg's care up to me!

column3: わたしの自覚症状は――
column4: The symptoms I am aware of are――

column3:
発熱、悪寒、皮膚の普通ではない赤み――
加えて――めまい、たまの過呼吸――
column4:
Fever, chills, abnormal redness of the skin―― 
Along with――dizziness, 
occasional hyperventilation――

column3:
同時に体験するのは――初めてだ
いったい何が起こって――いるのだろう――
column4:
Experiencing this simultaneously is―― 
my first time. What in the world is going――

column3:
ジョゼフ様に任されてパメラは張り切ってるけど
やっぱり心許ないから
わたしも一緒にこの人の面倒を見るね
column4:
While Pamela is eager after being put in 
charge by Master Joseph, I still feel anxious, 
so I will assist in taking care of him as well.

column3: もちろん、あれやこれや、探りを入れるつもり
column4:
Of course, I will be probing into this and 
that, trying to uncover information.

column3:
ロイグは良くなるでしょうか？
治す手立てはあるのでしょうか？
column4:
Will Loeg get better?
Is there a way to fix it?

column3:
ロイグか――
その男は黒騎士に狙われているわけじゃ
ないんだよね？
いったい、何者なんだろうな
column4:
Loeg, huh― 
that man isn't being hunted 
by the Black Knight, is he? 
I wonder what he truly is.

column3:
ごくろうだったな
ロイグはメイリーフの家に滞在してもらう
column4:
Well done. 
Loeg will be taking 
lodgings at Mayleaf's.

column3:
パメラに世話を任せて――記憶合わせは
体調が戻ってからでも遅くはなかろう
column4:
Entrust his care to 
Pamela—comparing memories 
can wait until he 
recovers his strength.

column3:
ところで――レオは何やらおかしな考えに
取り憑かれているようだな
column4:
By the way—Leo seems to be 
possessed by some strange ideas.

column3:
ずいぶん長く同じ時を過ごしたつもりでいたが
覚者はやはりわたしの理解を越えているようだ
column4:
I felt as though we had spent quite a 
long time together, but it seems the 
Arisen are still beyond my understanding.

column3: こんにちは隊長さん
column4: Hello there, Captain.

column3:
リズが、ロイグの治療のことで
相談したいって言ってるの
column4:
Lise said she wants to talk about 
Loeg's treatment.

column3:
病気を治すための、いい話だと思う
だから、わたしの家へ、お願いね
column4:
I think it's a good story to heal the 
sick. So, please come to my home.

column3:
わたしの家へ行って、リズと話してね
ロイグの治療の話だって
column4:
Head to my home and speak with Lise.
It's about Loeg's treatment.

column3:
漏れ聞こえるロイグの症状は
わたしが子供の頃にかかった病気と
似ているが――
column4:
From what I've heard,
Loeg's symptoms are akin to an illness
I'd once suffered from in my childhood―

column3: いやいや、素人判断はやめておこう
column4:
Let's not jump to conclusions without 
proper knowledge.

column3:
ロイグの病気がフィンダム固有のもので――
かつ、伝染する性質のものなら
面倒なことになるよ
最初に僕が気づくべきだったんだ
column4:
If Loeg's illness is unique to Phindym, 
and it is contagious, it could get 
troublesome. I should have realized 
it from the very beginning.

column3:
クラウスと話したか？
ロイグの病気が伝染病なら
俺たちどうなるよ？
column4:
Have you spoken to Klaus about this?
If Loeg's illness is contagious,
what will happen to us?

column3:
ガルドリンがちょっとビビってますよ
あんな人でも、病気は恐いんですね
column4:
Gurdolin is quite nervous. It seems 
that even he is afraid of disease.

column3: リズがよくやってくれて助かりますよ
column4: Lise has done a great job and is very helpful.

column3: ロイグ、つらそうだよね
column4: Loeg, I know it's hard.

column3:
ロイグはわたしのことを知っているのに
わたしは彼のことを知らないんです
申し訳なくて――
column4:
Loeg knows about me, 
but I have no knowledge of him. 
I find it quite unfortunate――

column3: はぁ――はぁ――
column4: Haa―― haa――

column3:
ポーン郷のカミュから、赤色症のことを
教えてもらってきて欲しいの
column4:
I want you to ask Camus from the 
Catedral de Peões about the scarlet sickness.

column3:
病は過去の行いに対する報いだと
ロイグが言うんです
故郷のフィンダムでは皆そう考えると
column4:
Loeg claims that sickness is a 
punishment for past actions. 
In Phindym, his homeland, 
everyone shares this belief.

column3:
そう言われると納得している
自分がいるんですけど
認めたくない気持ちもあって――
column4:
Hearing that, I find it hard to disagree,
but I also have feelings I don't want to
admit to――

column3: どっちが本当のわたしなんでしょうね
column4: Which one of these is the true me, I wonder?

column3:
わたしは――ここで――
死ぬのだろうか――
column4: Am I... going to... die... here?

column3:
最近、部下を得て隊長としてご活躍とのこと
風の便りで聞いております
さて、今日は――
column4:
So, you've recently gained subordinates
and are thriving as a captain. I've heard this
through the grapevine. Now, about today――

column3: ほう――赤色症とはまた珍しいですね
column4: Oh—scarlet sickness is quite a rarity, isn't it?

column3:
病の原因となる花粉をばらまいていた花は
オークたちに食べられてほとんど絶滅――
column4:
The flowers that released the pollen which
causes the illness have almost gone extinct,
devoured by the orcs――

column3:
仮に残っていたとしても、人を病気にするほど
花粉を出すこともないでしょう
column4:
Hypothetically, even if they were still
around, they wouldn't emit enough pollen
to cause illness in people.

column3:
不思議ですね――
その患者は、病気に対し、よほど無垢な身体を
持っているに違いありません
どのような人なのですか？
column4:
It's quite mysterious――
The patient must surely have a
remarkably low resistance to the disease.
What kind of person are they?

column3: ――そうですか、言えませんか
column4: ――I see, you cannot speak of it?

column3:
いいでしょう
貴方にも事情がおありでしょうからね
私に芽生えた好奇心は
私のやり方で満たさせて頂きますよ
column4:
Understood.
You must have your own circumstances,
so my burgeoning curiosity
will be fulfilled by my own methods.

column3:
いいえ、気を悪くしたわけではありません
もちろん、赤色症の特効薬は任せてください
column4:
Not at all, I'm not upset.
Rest assured, I will handle
the antidote for the scarlet sickness.

column3:
ただし、調剤には素材といいますか
材料となる薬草が必要になりますよ？
column4:
However, for the preparation,
I will need the necessary herbs
as ingredients, won't I?

column3:
調剤に必要な薬草の場所はアルヴァーが
詳しかったはずです
column4:
Alvar should know the
locations of the herbs needed
for the preparation.

column3:
調剤に必要な薬草が手に入りましたら
私の元へお持ち下さい
column4:
Once you obtain the herbs required,
bring them to me.

column3:
赤色症に効く、草花が自生する場所は
古くからこう歌われている
column4:
This is an old folk song about the place
where the plants that cure
the scarlet sickness naturally grow.

column3:
太陽と星の下で風はようようと歌い
鳥達は囀り、水が岩にせせらぐ地
column4:
Under the sun and stars, the wind softly sings, 
birds chirp, 
and water murmurs on the rocks.

column3:
切り立つ腕に守られて、草木の寝どこで
密やかに咲く――と
column4:
Protected by the towering arms,
sleeping t'ween grass and trees,
There, there it grows――
That's how the song goes.

column3: ――薬草が見つかったようですね
column4: ――It looks like you've found the medicinal herbs.

column3:
では、さっそく赤色症の特効薬を
調合しましょう
column4:
Well then, let's quickly brew the 
antidote for the scarlet sickness.

column3:
久しぶりなので、はて、どれほど
時間が掛かるか――
先に神殿に帰ってお待ちください
column4:
It's been a while, so,
I don't remember how long it will take――
Please return to the Temple and wait there.

column3: ごくろうさまでしたね
column4: I appreciate your efforts.

column3:
ああ、おかえりなさい
ポーン郷のカミュはどんな感じだった？
column4:
Ah, it's good to see you again. 
How did Camus fare at the Catedral de Peões?

column3:
おかえりなさい
ロイグは落ち着いているようです
column4:
Welcome home. 
Loeg appears to be at ease.

column3: このひどい悪寒さえ治まってくれれば――
column4: If only this dreadful chill would pass――

column3:
病気はなんとかなりそうだから
あとは記憶だね
column4:
It looks like the sickness can be handled, 
so now it's a matter of the amnesia.

column3:
ロイグの体調が戻ったら
じっくり話し合うつもりです
column4:
Once Loeg's health is restored,
I plan to discuss things thoroughly.

column3: この礼は――
column4: This gratitude is――

column3:
わかっているよ
セシリーの記憶を取り戻す助けになることが
何よりの恩返しなんだろう？
column4:
I understand. Helping to restore Cecily's 
memories must be the best way to repay that, 
right?

column3:
ふむ――
ロイグが健康を取り戻し、その結果
セシリーが事の次第を思い出す
そうなることを願おう
column4:
Well... Let us wish that Loeg regains his 
health, which in turn would help Cecily 
to recall what transpired.

column3:
結局、ロイグは赤色症だったわけか
未知の伝染病じゃなくて良かったよ
これ以上の侵食はかんべんして欲しいからね
column4:
So, Loeg was suffering from scarlet sickness. 
It's a relief it wasn't an unknown disease. 
I really don't want any further spread.

column3:
赤色症は尻まで真っ赤になるんだよな
おまえも罹ったことあるか？
column4:
Scarlet sickness makes everything turn bright red, 
even down to the buttocks. Have you had it too?

column3:
赤色症って、俺が生まれた頃には
根絶済みのはずです
column4:
Scarlet sickness was supposed to be eradicated 
by the time I was born, or so I thought.

column3:
それなのにロイグが罹るというのは――
やっぱり耐性が低いということですかね
column4:
That being the case, Loeg falling ill means— 
he likely has low resistance, I suppose.

column3: ロイグは治るんだね！
column4: Loeg can be cured!

column3:
あー、良かった！
あたし、白竜様と少し話したら帰るね
column4:
Oh, thank goodness! 
I'll speak with Lord White Dragon for a bit 
and then head back home.

column3:
白竜様は、警告はされましたが
行くなとはおっしゃいませんでした
隊長――お願いします
column4:
Though Lord White Dragon warned us, 
they did not command us not to go. 
Captain――I implore you.

column3:
もうあの島では助けてはやれぬ
それを知った上で、己の心に従え
column4:
There is no longer help to be found on that 
island. With this knowledge, heed your heart.

column3:
わたしは、君たちが知らない
あの島の光に近い、上陸場所を知っている
column4:
I know of a landing location that is near the 
island's light, one you are not familiar with.

column3: 病気治療の礼もある、喜んで案内させて貰うよ
column4:
I also owe thanks for your treatment, 
so I'll gladly guide you.

column3:
隊長、ガルドリンの言うとおりだよ？
絶対黒騎士がいるよ
どうするつもり？
column4:
Captain, Gurdolin is correct, isn't he? 
The Black Knight is definitely here. 
What are you planning to do?

column3: 隊長、行くだけ、行きませんか？
column4: Captain, if we're to leave, then let's go?

column3:
様子見というか偵察というか――
進むより、退くことを考えながら行くんです
column4:
It's more like observing or scouting— 
while considering retreat rather than 
advancing.

column3:
あの光に近付くことは
大きな危険を伴う賭けでしかない――
column4:
Getting nearer to that light 
is a high-risk gamble 
that brings great danger—

column3: どうも嫌な予感がするぞ
column4: I have a bad feeling about this.

column3:
もし島へ行くことになったら
不思議な光というか光源というか――
それをよく見てきてくれないか？
column4:
If we decide to go to the island, 
could you take a good look at that 
strange light, or whatever it is—?

column3:
セシリーの顔は、ありゃあ覚悟を決めた顔
止めても聞く耳持たねえぞ？
――行くしかねえな
column4:
Cecily's face tells me she's made her 
decision; she'll ignore me if I 
try to stop her, right?—Looks like we 
have no option but to go.

column3:
もし死んだら、セシリーの使命とやらは
その程度ってことなんだろうよ
column4:
If she dies, then Cecily's mission, 
or whatever this is...
I guess that'll be the extent of it.

column3: 生き延びる方に賭けてやる
column4: I'll place my wager on living through this.

column3:
ロイグに案内させれば
状況も変わるかもしれない
column4:
Having Loeg lead the way
might alter the situation.

column3: 港の船に集合でいいな？
column4: Shall we gather at the ship in the harbor?

column3:
新たにロイグから聞いた上陸場所は
島の裏手にある絶崖の真下だ
さあ、乗った乗った！
column4:
According to what I just heard from Loeg, 
the landing area is directly under the sheer cliffs
at the back of the island. 
Now, let's board!

column3: なるほど、このあたりは初めてだな
column4: I see, this area is new to me.

column3:
よし、ここから島の中心を目指すぞ
あの、うすら明るい場所が目標だ
column4:
Alright, we will head toward the island's center 
from here. That pale light is our destination.

column3:
ロイグと一緒に隊長の後を行きます
よろしくお願いします
column4:
I will follow the Captain along with Loeg. 
I appreciate your assistance.

column3:
くれぐれも気をつけて
このあたりはフィンダムの辺境だ
column4:
Take care, for this place 
is the borderlands of Phindym.

column3: わたしも馴染みのある場所ではないからね
column4:
This is not a place I am familiar with 
either, after all.

column3:
黒騎士、来ますかね？
来ますよね？
column4:
The Black Knight is coming, right?
Surely, he will appear?

column3:
セシリーたちはわたしにまかせて
隊長は、どんどん先行っちゃって！
column4:
Leave it to me, Cecily and the others.
Captain, please go ahead without me!

column3:
ああ、こんな事になるなんて――
隊長、セシリー、大丈夫ですよね！？
column4:
I can't believe it has come to this―― 
Captain, Cecily, are you both okay!?

column3:
きっと助かりますよね！？　
ねえ、そう言って下さい、隊長！！
column4:
I'm sure it will help!?
Hey, please say so, Captain!

column3:
セシリーのことはわたしに任せて
隊長さんは、今後のことを考えてくださいな
column4:
I'll handle Cecily. 
Captain, focus on what comes next.

column3:
セシリーは大丈夫だよ――
ねえ、そう言って？
column4:
Cecily will be fine―
Please, can you say that?

column3:
わたしは幸い軽傷だから心配はいらないよ
しかしセシリーは――
column4:
I am lucky to have just a light injury, 
so there's no need to fret about me. 
But Cecily is――

column3: ああ、わたしのせいかもしれないな
column4: Ah, I might be the one to blame.

column3:
こうなってみると――
島への訪問は軽率だったということに
なるかもしれませんね
column4:
When I think about it this way―― 
it seems visiting the island
may have been a rash decision.

column3: 隊長――
column4: Captain...

column3:
黒騎士を倒すのはやっぱり
今のわたしたちじゃ無理だよ
column4:
Taking down the Black Knight 
is definitely out of our 
reach at this point.

column3: （弱々しい呼吸の音が聞こえる）
column4: (sounds of labored breathing)

column3:
反省はほどほどにしておかねえと
何もできなくなるぜ
column4:
If we dwell on our mistakes too much,
we won't be able to do anything at all.

column3: 僕たちはセシリーを失ったわけじゃない
column4: We're not losing Cecily.

column3:
――そうだろ？
回復後のこと、次のことを考えなくちゃ
column4:
Right? We must consider 
what comes after recovery 
and what to do next.

column3: 黒き騎士とて不死身ではない
column4: Even the Black Knight is not invulnerable.

column3:
セシリーの容態は楽観できないそうだ
しかし――
column4:
Cecily's condition is not optimistic.
But--

column3:
これで黒騎士が目的を果たしたのなら
我々には平穏が訪れるのではないか――
column4:
If this means the Black Knight
has accomplished their aims,
then maybe we will be graced with peace――

column3:
レスタニアの安全が叶うのではないかと
思わずにはいられないのだ
column4:
I can't help but wonder if Lestania's
safety might be achievable.

column3: すまない――我ながら嘆かわしい限りだ
column4:
I am sorry ― I find it utterly deplorable,
even for myself.

column3:
セシリーが島へ行きたいと言い出した時――
なんとも言えず嫌な予感がしたのに
わたしは止めようともしなかった
column4:
When Cecily expressed her desire
to go to the island ― I felt an awful premonition,
but I did nothing to prevent it.

column3:
心のどこかに、今の状況を望む気持ちが
あったのだろう
いやはや、我ながら浅ましいわ
column4:
In some corner of my heart, I suppose
I willed strongly for the way things are now.
My, it truly is shameful, even for me.

column3:
なあ――
眠るセシリーを守ってやってくれ
彼女に害を為す者、事があらば
全て追い払ってほしい
column4:
Listen ― watch over Cecily while she sleeps.
If anyone tries to harm her, I want you to
drive them all away.

column3:
わたしからの頼み――
セシリーへの贖罪だ
column4:
This is my request ―
an act of atonement for Cecily.

column3:
セシリーを見守ってやってほしい
目覚めた時におまえがいれば安心だろう
column4:
I want you to watch over Cecily.
It would be best if you were there
when she wakes up.

column3:
黒騎士の動向は不明だけど
セシリーのこの状態を知ったらどうするだろうね
column4:
The movements of the Black Knight are unknown,
but I wonder what he would do if he knew
about Cecily's current condition.

column3:
騎士団には声をかけておいたけど
もしもの時は、やっぱり君が頼りだ
用心だけはしておいてよ？
column4:
I've reached out to the Knights,
but in case of an emergency,
I still rely on you. Please be cautious, alright?

column3:
おい、黒騎士野郎に仕返しだ
さっさと動かねえと
白竜の覚者は腰抜けだと思われるぜ？
column4:
Oy, it's time to settle the score with
that Black Knight. If we don't get moving,
the White Dragon's Arisen will be seen
as cowards, got it?

column3:
セシリーのところへ行きました？
あんなことになっちゃって――
俺、悔しいですよ――悔しいです！
column4:
Did you visit Cecily?
With everything that's gone on――
I'm so frustrated―― incredibly frustrated!

column3: セシリーの呼吸が深すぎて不安になるでしょう？
column4:
You find Cecily's deep breathing
worrisome, don't you?

column3:
でも、回数――つまり呼吸の間隔は安定しているの
良い兆候だと思うわ
column4:
Yet, if we count them—
her breath intervals are stable.
I believe this is a good indication.

column3:
ロイグのお薬を作ってくれたカミュさんに
診てもらったの
column4:
Camus, the one who made Loeg's medicine,
thoroughly examined her condition.

column3: そうしたら、できることは何もないって――
column4:
And then they said there was 
nothing they could do--

column3: なあ、レオを頼ってみないか？
column4: Hey, why don't we seek Leo's help with this?

column3:
新たな――さらなる力を探しているという
レオの話を覚えているだろう？
column4:
You remember Leo speaking of
searching for a new—greater power?

column3:
その力があれば、君たちは黒騎士に
勝てるはずだ
column4:
With that power, you should be
able to defeat the Black Knight.

column3:
もちろん、レオとの間に
わだかまりがあることは知っている
column4:
Of course, I know there are
some issues between you and Leo.

column3:
――さしでがましいようだが
わたしに和解の仲立ちをさせてくれ
column4:
―I know this may seem intrusive,
but allow me mediate your reconciliation.

column3:
禊の神殿で会えるように手配しておいた
レオは、きっと来るはずだ
column4:
I've organized a meeting at
the Temple of Purification.
Leo is sure to come.

column3:
"禊の神殿"で会いたい――
ダウ渓谷へ行く騎士団の人たちに
レオへの親書を預けたんだ
column4:
I want to meet at the "Temple of Purification." 
I entrusted a letter for Leo to the Knights
traveling to Dowe Valley.

column3:
セシリーはまだあきらめてない
ねえ隊長、わたし絶対にあきらめないから！
column4:
Even Cecily hasn't given up hope. 
Captain, I promise I will never give up!

column3: （弱々しい呼吸の音が聞こえる）
column4: (sounds of labored breathing)

column3: ――冴えない顔だな
column4: ――You have quite a gloomy face.

column3: 竜力の淀みに立ち入るには特別な道具が必要だ
column4:
To delve into the stagnant depths
of Dragon Force, you'll need special tools.

column3:
ポーン郷にある異界の狭間の深層に入り
"竜の泪"と呼ばれるオーブの欠片を
探し集めてくれ
column4:
Go deep into the gap between worlds
in the Catedral de Peões and search for fragments
of an orb called "Dragon's Tears."

column3: わたしはセシリーのところへ帰るよ
column4: I'm going back to Cecily.

column3:
レオの話をよく聞いて
必要とあらば折り合いをつけてくれ
セシリーのためだ
column4:
Listen carefully to Leo's words,
and if necessary, come to an
agreement for Cecily's sake.

column3:
異界の狭間、深層への入り口は
既に開かれている――
column4:
The entrance to the depths of the
Rift is already open――

column3: 心迷わぬように進むといい
column4: Advance with clarity of mind.

column3: 早かったな
column4: How swift.

column3: では、竜の泪は預からせてもらう
column4: Now, give to me the Dragon Tear.

column3:
そんな顔をするな
持ち逃げなどしない
古文書で調べることが、まだある
column4:
Don't make that face.
I won't run off with it.
There are still things to look up
in the ancient texts.

column3:
ジョゼフやクラウスに預ければ手際よく調べる
だろうがこれは自分自身で学び、理解したい
column4:
If I entrusted it to Joseph or Klaus,
they would handle the research efficiently,
but I wish to learn and comprehend this myself.

column3:
おまえたちの割り込みを受け入れてやるんだ
それくらいの勝手は認めろ
column4:
I'll accommodate your interruptions.
That's the least you deserve.

column3:
持ち逃げなど姑息な真似はしない
俺を信じろ
column4:
I won't resort to any cowardly acts
like absconding away with it. Trust me.

column3: ちゃんと話はつけたんだろうね？
column4: You've resolved the matter properly, haven't you?

column3:
レオには訊きたいこと――
言いたいことが色々あるけど
今は我慢するよ
column4:
I have things to ask Leo――
There are many things I want to say,
but for now, I will hold back.

column3: セシリーのためだもの！
column4: For Cecily's sake!

column3:
レオの野郎を見張ってなくて大丈夫か？
俺が行っとくか？
column4:
Is it alright that we aren't keeping tabs
on that Leo guy? Should I go?

column3:
レオからの連絡が待ち遠しいですね
ええ、必ず連絡をくれると信じてます
column4:
I'm eagerly awaiting word from Leo.
Yes, I believe he will definitely reach out.

column3:
竜の泪か――
俄然興味が沸いてくるね
column4:
Dragon Tears, huh―
Suddenly, I'm intrigued.

column3:
セシリーの容態は一進一退と言ったところだ
そっちの首尾は？
column4:
Cecily's state is fluctuating, it seems.
How goes things on your side?

column3:
ふむ――業腹だが、レオが約束を違えぬと
期待するしかないだろうな
column4:
Hmm― it's annoying, but I suppose all we can do
is trust that Leo will uphold his promise.

column3: レオの使いを名乗る者が来た
column4:
A person who claims to be a messenger
for Leo has come.

column3:
準備を整えたレオが待っているから
来てくれとのことだ
column4:
They said Leo is ready,
and waiting for you to arrive.

column3:
場所は禊の神殿だ
勝手知ったる場所だろうが用心は怠るな？
column4:
The location is the Temple of Purification.
I know you're familiar with the place,
but be on your guard, okay?

column3:
黒騎士の魔手からセシリーを
守る力が得られるのであれば
レオに関してはもう何も言うまい

大急ぎで調べたんだけど、竜の泪のことは
手掛かりすら掴めない――
column4:
I quickly investigated, but I couldn't grasp 
even a hint about the Dragon's Tears――

column3:
ああ！　完全にお手上げだ！
いやいや待て待て――
column4:
Ah! I give up!
No, no, wait――

column3:
今、どんな状況？
レオからの連絡はあったの？
column4:
What's the situation now?
Have you heard from Leo?

column3: レオは必ずやってくれると信じてますよ、俺
column4: I believe that Leo will definitely come through.

column3:
あなたがセシリーを助けてくれるって
言う人が大勢いるの
column4:
There are a lot of people who say
that you can help Cecily.

column3:
実はわたしもそのひとり
期待が重たいかもしれないけど――
頑張ってね
column4:
Actually, I'm one of them.
I know the expectations weigh heavily--
Good luck to you!

column3:
いつもお願いばかりでごめんなさい
でも、やっぱり、お願いするしかないの
column4:
I'm sorry to always ask things of you.
Nevertheless, as expected, all I can do is ask.

column3: セシリーを助けてあげて！
column4: Please help Cecily!

column3:
これでダメならもう他に方法が――
いや、良い結果だけを考えることにするよ
column4:
Although, if there is no way to...
No, I will only hope for the best.

column3:
レオの言うとおり、力が手に入るのかもしれんが
わけのわからん力で身を滅ぼすなよ？
column4:
Leo may be right, you could gain strength, 
but don't let strange power lead to your ruin.

column3: （呼吸がひときわ深くなったようだ）
column4:
(Their breathing seems to have become noticeably
deeper.)

column3: 気が急くか？　ああ、俺もだ
column4: In a hurry, are you? Ah, so am I.

column3: 俺達の望む力はこの先だ
column4: The power we seek is just ahead of us.

column3:
ああ――この時を俺は待ちわびていた
さあ、共に戦い手に入れよう
column4:
Ah—this is the moment I've been waiting for.
Now, let us fight as one.

column3:
欲にまみれた愚か者め――
身の程を知るがよい――
column4:
O foolish one, engulfed by desire— 
Know your place and understand your limits—

column3: 怯むな――これは白竜ではない！
column4: Do not hesitate...This is not the White Dragon!

column3: ふん、ずいぶん腕を上げたな
column4: Hmph, you've certainly improved your skills.

column3: おい、少しは遠慮しろ
column4: Hey, show a little restraint.

column3: ほう――見違えたな
column4:
Oh―― 
You've changed quite a bit.

column3: まだまだ負けないさ
column4: I won't lose just yet.

column3: おまえの初陣、思い出したぞ
column4: I remember your first battle.

column3: さあ、竜力を切り取ってやろうではないか！
column4: Now, let us take that dragon's power!

column3: 竜力の継承は覚者の正当なる権利だ！
column4:
The inheritance of a dragon's power 
is the Arisen's rightful claim!

column3: 竜から得た力で、竜の敵を倒すのだ！
column4:
With power obtained from the dragon,
slay its enemies!

column3: くっ――オレは思い上がっていたのか？
column4: Ugh—was I being arrogant?

column3: 強い――とてつもなく強いぞ――
