The northern bandits are motivated, aren't they?
I told them it's okay to reevaluate their 
home turf in the bandit business.

column3:
あたしにゃ大きな譲歩だけど
アッカーシェランがなくなるよりはマシさ
column4:
It's a big concession for me, 
but it's better than losing Acre Selund.

column3: まっ黒野郎――ったく、どこにいやがる
column4:
That pitch-black bastard―damn it, 
where the hell is he hiding?

column3: ネド王子とメイロワ将軍は凄いよ
column4: Prince Nedo and General Meirova are amazing.

column3:
隠れていた人たちを、名前だけで
奮い立たせちゃうんだもの
column4:
Their name alone is enough to inspire those 
who have been hiding.

column3: 一度レスタニアへ帰りましょう
column4: Let's go back to Lestania.

column3:
あっちの方がよく休める気がしませんか？
やっぱり大地に満ちる竜力が違うんでしょうね
column4:
Don't you feel like you can rest better there?
I guess the Dragon Force that 
fills the land is different.

column3:
隊長、ジリアン
生き残りの兵たちを、よくぞ集めてくれた――
column4:
Captain, Gillian, you've done a great job of 
gathering the surviving soldiers--

column3:
ベルタは北の盗賊を連れて戻ってきた
どう説得したのか知らんが
北の盗賊たちめ、やけに士気が高い
column4:
Bertha returned with the northern bandits, 
and I don't know how she convinced them, 
but their morale is awfully high.

column3:
さて、わしは王子とともに部隊の編制に入る
おぬしらは一度休まれるといい
column4:
Now, I will go with the prince to organize the 
troops, and you can take a rest.

column3:
次はいよいよメガド突入――正念場だ
おぬしたちは戦の中軸に組み込ませてもらうぞ
それまではゆっくり休んでおいてくれ
column4:
Next, we're entering Megado - the moment of truth.
You will be part of the core of the conflict.
Until then, get some rest.

column3:
次はいよいよメガド突入――正念場だ
おぬしたちは戦の中軸に組み込ませてもらうぞ
column4:
Next, we're entering Megado - the moment of truth.
You will be part of the core of the conflict.

column3: それまではゆっくり休んでおいてくれ
column4: Until then, please take a good rest.

column3: 黒い鎧の騎士、未だ姿を見せず――だね
column4:
The Knight in black armor 
hasn't shown up―― yet.

column3:
これは策略かもしれないよ？
だって、姿が見えないことで
僕たちの不安は膨らむばかりだからね
column4:
This could be a scheme, don't you think? 
The more he's unseen, the more 
our worries keep increasing.

column3:
ふむ――
王都メガド突入目前というわけだな
column4:
Hmm...
So, you're on the verge of entering Megado, 
the capital of the kingdom.

column3:
とすれば、噂の、黒い騎士の登場も
近いと予想されるわけだが――
column4:
If this is the case, then you can expect the 
rumored black knight to 
make an appearance soon...

column3:
気を取られて、悪しき竜を忘れては
いかんぞ
column4:
Do not be so distracted that you 
forget the Evil Dragon.

column3:
展望城に続き、王都メガドも
悪しき竜討伐への通過点に過ぎんのだからな
column4:
After the Lookout Castle, 
the Royal Capital Megado is just a stepping 
stone on the way to defeating the Evil Dragon.

column3:
アッカーシェランの解放軍とともに
戦う一方で――
column4:
While fighting alongside 
Acre Selund's Liberation Army--

column3:
やはりおまえたちには黒い鎧の騎士を
気にしてもらわねばならない
column4:
After all, you must be concerned about 
your knight in black armor.

column3:
我々の知るあの黒騎士か――
それとも、似て非なる敵か――
せめてそれだけでも知りたい
column4:
Is that the Black Knight we know――
or is it a similar and different enemy――
I want to know at least that.

column3:
いずれにしても王都メガドに攻め込めば
否応なく対峙することになるのだろう

その鎧の中身、しかと見極めよ
いいな？
column4:
You're going to find out what's in that armor.
Okay?

column3:
あの黒騎士が蘇ったというのであれば――
レオも、もしや――
そう思わずにはいられない
column4:
If that Black Knight has been revived ――
What if Leo ――
I can't help but think so.

column3:
黒騎士のことはもちろん気になるけど
メガドを巡る攻防は戦略の大きな節目
column4:
I'm concerned about the black knight, 
of course, but the attack on Megado is a major 
strategic milestone.

column3: この神殿から勝利を祈っているよ
column4: I'm praying for your victory from this temple.

column3:
こっちの準備はできているよ
詳しいことはメイロワに聞いておくれ
column4:
We're ready for you.
You'll have to ask Meirova for the details.

column3:
メガドを落とした黒い騎士の姿を
あれ以来見ていないことが気がかりだが――
column4:
I'm concerned that we haven't seen 
the black knight who conquered Megado since...

column3: 見てよ、この士気の高さ！
column4: Look at this high level of morale!

column3:
戦闘の前の静けさ――
何度体験しても身が引き締まりますね
column4:
The calm before the battle--
No matter how many times you experience it, 
it's always sobering.

column3:
どう立ち回ればいいんだ？
まだなら将軍に聞いてこいよ
column4:
How should we proceed? 
If you don't know yet, go ask the general.

column3:
メガドの敵はオークが中心だけど
結構魔物も入り込んでいるって
column4:
Megado's enemies are mainly orcs, 
but there's a fair amount of monsters 
in the mix as well.

column3:
ついにこの時が来ました
皆さん、よろしくお願いします
column4:
The time has finally come, 
ladies and gentlemen.

column3:
皆集まったな――
では、メガド奪回作戦の概要を話そう
column4:
Well, now that we're all here - 
let's talk about the mission to retake Megado.

column3:
元メガド守護兵を中心とする部隊は
メガド周辺の小塔を襲撃する
column4:
Troops, led by former Megado defenders, will
raid small towers around Megado.

column3:
もちろんこれは陽動作戦だ
騒ぎを大きくして、可能な限り多くの
オークどもを引きつけてもらう
column4:
This is a diversion, of course, 
to create more noise and attract as 
many orcs as possible.

column3:
そしてベルタ率いる盗賊団を加えた本隊は
陽動部隊の動きに呼応して城内へと突入
column4:
Then, the main body, 
including the bandits led by Berta, 
storms into the castle as a response to the 
diversionary force's movement.

column3:
レスタニアの覚者たちも
城内へと進む戦力の要として加わって頂く
column4:
The Arisen of Lestania will also be a key part of 
the forces advancing on the castle.

column3:
個々の力量、裁量が頼りとなる
決死戦となるだろう
column4:
It will be a deadly battle that will rely on 
individual competence and discretion.

column3:
それでは作戦を遂行する
必ずみな生きて再会しよう――
column4:
Now let's carry out the operation,
and make sure we all live and meet again ――

column3: もう何も言わぬ
column4: I won't say another word.

column3:
おぬしたちなら、為すべきことを
知っているだろうからな
column4: You know what to do.

column3:
乱戦になるから同士討ちには
注意してくれよ
column4:
It's going to be a melee, 
so be careful not to hit each other.

column3:
北から来ている盗賊連中は
利害が一致して参戦しているだけだ
column4:
The bandits from the north are only entering the 
war because of a mutual interest.

column3:
誤解されるようなことが起これば
お互い不幸になるよ
column4:
If something happens that could be 
misinterpreted...
We'll both be in a bad situation.

column3: 頼りにしているよ、異国の方々
column4: I'm counting on you, Arisen.

column3: メガドに入ったら思う存分暴れてね
column4:
When you get into Megado, 
go as wild as you want.

column3:
何しろ、どれだけの敵が街の中に
潜んでいるのか見当がつかないの
column4:
After all, we have no idea how many 
enemies are hiding in the city.

column3:
来てます――来てますよ
俺、武者震い来てます！
column4:
It's here―I can feel it! 
The warrior's thrill is hitting me!

column3:
正体はともかく、まっ黒い鎧で
格好つけてるような奴は
大嫌いだぜ！
column4:
I hate those who dress up in black armor, 
regardless of who they are!

column3: き、緊張してきた！
column4: Hey, I'm getting nervous!

column3: たったいま伝令が来ました！
column4: A messenger has just arrived!

column3:
メガド居住層への進入路を
確保したとのことです
column4:
They have cleared an entry route into 
the Residential Level.

column3:
皆さん、よろしくお願いします！
僕はここでイェルハルドの部隊を迎えます
column4:
Everyone, I appreciate your assistance! 
I will be welcoming Gerhard's troops here.

column3:
皆さんはメガド居住層へ！
僕はイェルハルドを待ちます！
column4:
You all go to the Residential Level! 
I'll wait for Gerhard!

column3:
この先の水路の中に、メガドへの進入路を
確保した
column4:
In the channel ahead of you, 
you will find the entryway to Megado.

column3: さあ、行ってくれ――俺たちも続く
column4: Now go on-- we'll follow.

column3:
負ければ何も残らない
これはそういう戦いだ
column4:
If we lose, we have nothing left.
That's what this fight is about.

column3:
さあ、あんたが最後だよ
こっから入って、大暴れしてやりな！
column4:
Come on, you're the last one.
Get in here and go on a rampage!

column3:
ベルタがおまえたちを信頼するその理由――
見せてもらおうか！
column4:
Let's see why Bertha trusts you――
Show us!

column3:
隊長、レスタニアから人が来ています
隊長さんを探しています
column4:
Captain, there are people from Lestania 
looking for you, Ser.

column3:
それから！
メガドで何が起こったんですか！？
column4: After that! What occurred in Megado!?

column3: 将軍とジリアンがしんがりを引き継いだ
column4:
The General and Gillian have taken command of 
the rear guard.

column3:
あいつらのことだ
首尾良く撤退してくるだろうが――
くそっ！　いったい何が起こってるんだ？
column4:
They're gonna make a successful retreat, but...
Shit!　What the hell is going on?

column3: 隊長、ファビオが来てる！
column4: Captain, Fabio is here!

column3:
きっとレスタニアで――痛ッ！
あ、頭が痛い！？
column4:
I'm sure it's in Lestania ―― Ow!
Ah, my head hurts!?

column3:
隊長、具合はどうです？
つらいってほどじゃないけど
この感じは――初めてです
column4:
Captain, how are you feeling? 
It's not bad, but I've never felt this way before.

column3: 話している時間が惜しい、一緒に戻ってくれ！
column4:
I don't have time to talk, 
just come back with me!

column3: 白竜神殿に敵襲だ、黒騎士が現れた！
column4:
It's an enemy attack on the White Dragon Temple, 
the Black Knight has appeared!

column3:
おい、早く戻るぞ！
黒騎士は白竜神殿だ！
column4:
Come on, let's get back to it!
The Black Knight is in the White Dragon Temple!

column3:
隊長、急がないと！
この胸騒ぎ――
column4:
Captain, we must hurry!
The feeling in my chest--

column3:
急いでレスタニアへ帰りましょう！
白竜様の――いえ、レスタニアの一大事です！
column4:
Let's hurry back to Lestania!
It's a serious matter for the White Dragon - 
no, it's a crucial matter for Lestania!

column3:
隊長さん！
ここは僕らに任せて行ってください！
column4:
Captain!
Please leave this up to us!

column3:
神殿で好き勝手にされて――
逃げられて――ああ、最悪だ！
column4:
They did what they wanted in the temple―― 
they got away with it―― 
oh, that's the worst!

column3: おい、白竜の容態は！？
column4: Hey, what's White Dragon's condition!?

column3: どうしよう――どうしよう隊長！
column4: What should I do―― what should I do, Captain!

column3:
咄嗟にあんたを呼びに行ったけど
おれも残って戦うべきだったのか――
column4:
I ran for you as soon as I could, 
but I don't know if I should have 
stayed and fought--

column3:
そうすれば白竜はこんなことにならずに――
くっ、判断を誤ったのか！？
column4:
Then the White Dragon wouldn't have had to--
Damn, I must have misjudged!

column3:
さあ、急ごう！
まず、白竜様の容態を確認するんだ
そして、何ができるか考えよう！
column4:
Come on, let's hurry!
First, let's check on Lord White Dragon's condition 
and see what we can do!

column3:
白竜よ、いったいどうすれば――
我々にできることはありますか？
column4:
White Dragon, what should we do―― 
Is there something we can do for you?

column3: 不覚――
column4: Alas――

column3:
この傷――如何ほどの痛手か――
竜力の流出――計り知れぬ――
column4:
This wound――
what a painful toll it dost extract――
The flow of dragon force――
untold and vast――

column3:
黒騎士め――
あやつの狙いは我にあったとは――
column4:
That dark knight―― 
His designs were set upon my self――

column3: すべてはこのためであったか――
column4: Is it all for this end that it hath been――

column3:
白竜の傷は深く、深刻な状況だ
竜力の流出はなはだしく
自然治癒はおそらく難しい
column4:
The White Dragon's wounds are deep and serious, 
and the drain of Dragon Force is so great that 
natural healing will likely be difficult.

column3:
しかも、巡る竜力が消えてしまえば
大地は枯れ果て――
column4:
Além disso,
se a Força Dracônica circulante desaparecer...
A terra vai murchar e morrer.

column3:
いや、それよりも先に、おまえたち覚者に
影響が及ぶはずだ
覚者と白竜の絆は竜力によるもの
だからな
column4:
Não, antes disso,
isso deve ter um efeito em vocês, Arisen.
O vínculo entre o Arisen e
o Dragão Branco é baseado na Força Dracônica.

column3:
ともあれ、急ぎ、その擬竜を探して
竜力を白竜の元へと持ち帰ってくれ
column4:
De qualquer forma, apresse-se e encontre aquele pseudodragão e
traga a Força Dracônica de volta para o Dragão Branco.

column3:
擬竜を探して、竜力を調達し
白竜の傷ついた身体に注ぐのだ
column4:
Encontre o pseudodragão, procure a Força Dracônica
e derrame-a no corpo ferido do Dragão Branco.

column3: 効果に期待しようではないか
column4: Vamos esperar que funcione.

column3:
君たち覚者の力は白竜あってのもの
優先すべきは白竜様の回復だよ？
column4:
O poder de vocês, Arisen, só é possível por causa
do Dragão Branco, então sua prioridade deve ser
a recuperação do Lorde Dragão Branco, certo?

column3: ごめん、言うまでもないよね
column4: Desculpe, eu não preciso te dizer.

column3: ――この傷は――深い――
column4: ――Esta ferida――corta fundo――

column3: 我が身――滅する明日も――あり得る――
column4:
Pode acontecer――
que eu pereça amanhã――

column3:
擬竜んところ行くんだろ？
だったら、禊の神殿だな？
column4:
Você está indo para o local do
pseudo dragão, certo?
Se sim, é o Templo da Purificação, certo?

column3: 隊長、わたし、思ったより辛いかも――
column4:
Capitão,
eu acho que estou tendo um momento mais difícil do que eu pensava――

column3: 頭が――痛くて――重くて――
column4: Minha cabeça... dói... está pesada――

column3: 急ぎましょう隊長
column4: Vamos nos apressar, Capitão.

column3:
俺たちまで動けなくなったら
レスタニアは大変なことになります
column4:
Se até nós ficarmos imobilizados,
Lestania estará em apuros.

column3:
ブラッドオーブ探しはもちろんだが
騎士団は大勢いる
column4:
Há muitos Cavaleiros, é claro,
procurando por Bolas Obscuras de Sangue.

column3:
できそうなことがあれば言ってくれ
なんでもする用意がある
column4:
Se houver alguma coisa que eu possa fazer, me avise,
e eu estou pronto para fazer o que for preciso.

column3:
俺が――もっとうまく立ち回っていれば
白竜様は――くそっ
column4:
Se eu――se eu tivesse lutado melhor...
Lorde Dragão Branco――droga...

column3: 白竜様、大丈夫だよね？　よくなるよね？
column4:
Lorde Dragão Branco, você está bem, certo?
Vai melhorar, certo?

column3:
よその大陸から来た騎士が神殿まで
入ってくるなんて
column4:
Eu não acredito que um cavaleiro de outro continente
pôde invadir o templo.

column3: なんて怖ろしい時代なのかしらね
column4: Que tempos assustadores em que vivemos.

column3:
俺たちも戻りましょう
ここには何もありません
column4:
Nós também deveríamos voltar.
Não há nada aqui.

column3:
リズは任せて――
胸を張ってそう言えたらいいのだけれど――
column4:
Eu vou cuidar de Lise――
Eu gostaria de poder dizer isso com todo meu coração――

column3: リズ、頑張れ――頑張れ！
column4: Lise, aguente firme -- aguente firme!

column3:
もう地味にブラッドオーブを
探すしかねえのかね――
column4:
Eu acho que teremos que ser realistas e procurar
Bolas Obscuras de Sangue agora――

column3:
リズはいつも明るいから
こうなると余計に――はぁ
column4:
Lise está sempre alegre, então quando isso acontece,
torna tudo ainda mais--haha.

column3: 隊長さん、お願い
column4: Capitão, por favor.

column3:
リズやガルドリン――覚者さんたちみんなが
良くなる方法を探して
急いで探して！
column4:
Lise, Gurdolin e o resto dos Arisen
estão todos tentando encontrar uma cura.
Por favor, apresse-se e ajude-os a encontrar uma solução!

column3:
ガルドリンは意識を取り戻しましたが
そのまま診療所に預けてきました
column4:
Gurdolin recuperou a consciência,
mas o deixamos na enfermaria.

column3: 隊長と俺でなんとかするしかありませんよ
column4: O capitão e eu teremos que nos virar.

column3:
リズはまるで深い眠りの中にいるみたい
話しかけても揺らしても目覚めないの
column4:
É como se Liz estivesse em um sono profundo,
e não importa o quanto eu fale com ela ou a sacuda,
ela simplesmente não acorda.

column3:
黒騎士がアッカーシェランに現れたのは
君たちを引きつけるためだろうね
column4:
Eu acho que o Cavaleiro Negro apareceu em
Acre Selund para atrair todos vocês para longe.

column3:
悪しき竜の思惑が先か、黒騎士が先か
なんとも言えないけど――
column4:
É difícil dizer se as intenções do Dragão Maligno
vieram primeiro ou o Cavaleiro Negro.

column3:
幸いブラッドオーブは次々と
運び込まれている
column4: Felizmente, as Bolas Obscuras de Sangue continuam chegando.

column3:
しかし、効果はさほどでもないようだ
なんとも歯がゆいぞ！
column4:
No entanto, o impacto parece ser mínimo.
Como isso é irritante!

column3:
まだ――竜力は巡っているか？
今のうちに――ぞんぶんに――
column4:
Ainda...
a Força Dracônica ainda corre pela terra?
Enquanto ela flui――você deve usá-la――

column3:
かつて白竜が、黄金竜との戦いで
傷ついた時――
column4:
No passado, quando o Dragão Branco foi ferido
em batalha com o Dragão Dourado--

column3:
白竜の力は衰え
その結果、悪しき魔物が力をつけた
column4:
O poder do Dragão Branco diminuiu,
e, como resultado, o demônio maligno ganhou força.

column3:
幸いにして覚者、騎士団の献身により
白竜は命を繋ぎ、事なきを得たが――
column4:
Felizmente, graças à dedicação do
Arisen e dos Cavaleiros, o Dragão Branco
sobreviveu e foi trazido de volta à vida.

column3:
はて、今回はどうであろうな
覚者が次々と倒れているという報告が
舞い込んできている
column4:
Mas, e desta vez?
Estão chegando relatórios de que os Arisen
estão desmaiando um por um.

column3:
竜が死に、力が継承されなければ
世界は滅ぶと考えられているが――
column4:
Acredita-se que, se o Dragão morrer e seu
poder não for transmitido, o mundo perecerá――

column3:
ああしかし、これが狙いだったとは！
悔しい――不覚だ！
column4:
Ah, mas eu não sabia que esse era o objetivo deles!
É frustrante--eu estava tão desatento!

column3:
相談がある
実はな、フィンダムからの使者が来て
族長ガラダからの伝言を置いていった
column4:
Preciso conversar com você.
Na verdade, um mensageiro de Phindym veio e deixou
uma mensagem do Chefe Gearóid.

column3:
なんでも、精霊竜セシリーに
目覚めの予兆があるというのだ
column4: O Dragão Espiritual Cecily está mostrando sinais de despertar.

column3:
白竜が危うい状態が続いており
覚者達の力も下がる一方――
こんな状態でよその竜など構っては
いられない――
column4:
O Dragão Branco continua em perigo,
e o poder dos Arisen está diminuindo...
Não podemos nos dar ao luxo de nos preocupar com outros Dragões em
uma situação como esta...

column3:
そう思い、黙殺していたのだが
白竜の危機に呼応するように
精霊竜が目覚めることに意味があるやもしれず
――そこに気づくべきだったと思い至ってな
column4:
Eu pensei assim, e fiquei quieto sobre isso,
mas então percebi que o despertar do
Dragão Espiritual pode ser em resposta à crise
do Dragão Branco,
e que eu deveria ter percebido isso.

column3:
動ける者を連れてフィンダムへ
渡ってくれんか？
column4:
Você poderia cruzar para Phindym com qualquer um
que seja capaz de se mover?

column3:
精霊竜の目覚めに立ち会い
白竜の窮状を訴えてくれ
column4:
Witness the awakening of the Spirit Dragon, 
and speak of the plight of the White Dragon.

column3:
エリオットは元気そうだったぞ
フィンダムに連れて行ってくれ
column4: Elliot looked fine, take him to Phindym.

column3: ミシアル――ミシアル――
column4: Mysial―― Mysial――

column3:
ジョゼフ様がやっと考えを変えてくれたよ
僕は最初から進言していたんだ
column4:
Master Joseph has finally changed his mind. 
I've been telling him from the very beginning.

column3:
白竜様が危機的な状況の時に
竜になったセシリーが目覚めるだなんて
偶然だとしたら出来すぎだろう？
column4:
Wouldn't it be too much of a coincidence that 
Cecily, in dragon form, would awaken at a time 
when Lord White Dragon is in dire straits?

column3: いや、偶然と考える方がどうかしているよね
column4: No, it's crazy to think it's a coincidence.

column3:
吉兆、凶兆、どちらかはわからないけど
セシリーと君たちの結びつきを考えると
良い報せだと、僕は信じるよ
column4:
I don't know if it's a good omen or a bad omen, 
but given your connection to Cecily, 
I believe it's good news.

column3:
隊長、フィンダムへ行きましょう
黒騎士や悪しき竜が何をしたって
これ以上悪いことにはなりませんよ？
column4:
Captain, let's go to Phindym. 
Whatever the Black Knight or that vile Dragon 
may try, it can't get worse than this, can it?

column3:
ああ、セシリーが目を覚ますらしいってのに
俺もいつまでも寝てられねえぜ
column4:
Yeah, I thought Cecily might wake up.
I can't sleep forever either.

column3:
身体はまだまだだが
――まあなんとかなるだろうよ
column4:
My body's not quite up to snuff yet, but...
--I'm sure we'll manage.

column3: リズはまだ眠っているよ
column4: Lise is still sleeping.

column3:
色々な薬を試したのだけど
全然効果がなくて――
column4:
I tried all kinds of medicines, 
but they didn't work at all――

column3:
よく来てくれた――
精霊竜は、芯なる樹から力を授る間
長き眠りにつくならわしなのだが――
column4:
Welcome--
It is customary for a Spirit Dragon to lie 
dormant for a long time while the 
Core Tree gives it power...

column3:
驚いたことに
セシリーに目覚めの兆しが現れたのだ
column4:
Surprisingly,
Cecily already showed signs of waking up.

column3:
しかし、それっきり状況は変わらない
セシリーはまだ目を閉じたままだ
column4:
But things didn't change again. 
Cecily's eyes are still closed.

column3:
おそらく、常ならぬ目覚めに必要な
あと少しの竜力が足りないのであろう
column4:
Possibly, for this abnormal awakening, 
what's missing is a bit more dragon force.

column3:
フィンダム大陸にいにしえより存在する塔――
その中には長い歳月を経て溜めこまれた
竜力が存在する
column4:
A tower that has existed on the continent of 
Phindym since time immemorial-- 
inside it exists Dragon Force that has been 
accumulated over many years.

column3:
アデルドナハの元を訪ね、その竜力の解放に
どうか力を貸してもらえないだろうか
column4:
Please visit Adair Donnchadh and help him to 
release this Dragon Force.

column3:
こんなつもりで来てもらったのでは
なかったのだが――
column4:
This was not what I had intended for 
you to come to me for--

column3:
アデルドナハの元を訪ね、その竜力の解放に
どうか力を貸してもらえないだろうか
column4:
Please visit Adair Donnchadh and help him to 
release this Dragon Force.

column3: また力を借りることになるとは面目ない
column4: I'm sorry to have to ask for your help again.

column3:
ガラダから話は聞いた
セシリーの目覚めのために
平原の塔の竜力を解放するらしいな
column4:
Gearóid told me about it.
I heard you're going to release the Dragon Force 
in the tower on the plain to awaken Cecily.

column3:
塔の入口は解放されているが
中の様子は分からない
じゅうぶんに気をつけるがいい
column4:
The entrance to the tower is open, 
but we don't know what's inside. 
Be very careful.

column3:
塔の入口は解放してある
中に入る時は気をつけてくれ
column4:
The entrance to the tower is open. 
Be careful.

column3:
レスタニアの白竜に大変なことが
起こったと聞いている
column4:
I've heard that something terrible has happened 
to the White Dragon in Lestania.

column3:
そして呼応するようなセシリーの目覚めの兆し
無関係とは思えんな
column4:
And the corresponding signs of Cecily's 
awakening, I don't think they're unrelated.

column3:
セシリーの、この目覚め――
フィンダムの未来に禍根を残さぬようにと
祈るしかないな
column4:
This awakening of Cecily's--
I can only hope that it won't be a blight 
on the future of Phindym.

column3:
ふむ――
塔の竜力は解放されたようだな
column4:
Hmmm-- 
it seems the Dragon Force in the tower 
has been released.

column3:
しかしまだ目覚めないということは
竜力が足りていないのであろう
column4:
But if she hasn't woken up yet, 
it's probably because she doesn't have 
enough Dragon Force.

column3:
実はな
そちらで魔赤島と呼ばれている孤島――
かつてフィンダムより切り離されたその地にも
塔は存在するのだ
column4:
As a matter of fact.
On the isolated island you call Bloodbane Isle...
There is also a tower on that island, 
which was once cut off from Phindym.

column3: すまぬが、その塔の竜力も解放してほしい
column4:
I'm sorry, but I want you to release that tower's 
Dragon Force too.

column3:
セシリーがこれほど早く、目覚めの兆しを
見せたことには何か特別な理由があるに違いない――
column4:
There must be some special reason for Cecily to 
show signs of awakening so early--
and it is a good thing that she did.

column3:
わたしの心に働きかけてあなたたちを呼ぶように
命じたのは、他でもないセシリーだ――とな
column4:
Cecily is the one who worked through my 
heart to command me to call you― 
 or so it seems.

column3: セシリーは今のままでは目覚めることができない
column4: Cecily can't wake up as she is now.

column3:
助けが必要だと気づいた時に
真っ先に思い浮かべたのはあなたの顔だった
column4:
Your face was the first thing I thought of when 
I realized I needed help.

column3: それはセシリーの意志かもしれないぞ？
column4: That might be Cecily's will, right?

column3:
あなたたちのおかげでフィンダムはずっと
落ち着いた日々が続いていた
column4:
Thanks to you and your friends, 
Phindym has remained calm all this time.

column3:
だから突然慌ただしくなっても
我々は右往左往するばかりだ
column4:
So when things suddenly grow chaotic, 
all we can do is run around in confusion.

column3: 隊長、案の定ですよ
column4: Captain, you get the idea.

column3:
ガルドリンが、ジッとしていられるかって――
結局、ここまで来ちゃいました
column4:
Gurdolin couldn't sit still― 
In the end, he came all the way here.

column3:
セシリーはまだ起きねえのか？
だったら、叩き起こしてやろうぜ
column4:
Cecily still ain't up yet?
Then let's give her a good wake-up call.

column3: ああ、早かったな
column4: Oh, that was fast.

column3:
フィンダムから連絡を受け
おおよその事情は把握している
column4:
Phindym contacted me, 
and I have a rough idea of what's going on.

column3:
目的とされる塔の入り口はこじ開けたが
中に入るのはお前が初めてだ
column4:
I've pried open the entrance to the tower you're 
supposed to be in, but you're the first to go inside.

column3:
心許ない話だが
内部がどうなっているか、手掛かりはない
十分注意してくれ
column4:
I know it's a bit disconcerting, 
but we don't have a clue what's going on inside, 
so be very careful.

column3:
塔の中に魔物が入り込んでいる痕跡があります
気をつけて下さい
column4:
There are traces of monsters entering the tower.
Please be careful.

column3:
この島でも、動ける覚者は半数にも
満たなくなりました
column4:
Even on this island, less than half of the 
Arisen population is able to move.

column3: もはや白竜様を救う手立てはないのでしょうか
column4:
Is there no longer any way to save 
Lord White Dragon?

column3:
首尾はどうだ？
精霊竜の目覚めが、レスタニアの破滅の回避に
うまくつながってくれればいいんだがな
column4:
Did it go well?
I hope the awakening of the Spirit Dragon 
will lead to the averting of Lestania's doom.

column3:
おお、首尾良く、問題を解決したようだな
私からも礼を申し上げたい
――本当に助かったよ
column4:
Well, it looks like you've successfully solved 
the problem, and I'd like to thank you for that.
--You've been a big help.

column3: あなたたちも感じることができるだろうか
column4: I wonder if you can feel it too.

column3:
この始まりの洞が力強く竜力を巡らせ――
いやいや、それどころではなかったな
column4:
Here at the Hollow of Beginnings, 
powerful Dragon Force now circulates...
Nay, it's truly has never been so.

column3:
さあ、わたしなんかよりもセシリーに
話しかけてやってくれ
column4: Go ahead, talk to Cecily instead of me.

column3:
隊長、さあ
セシリーの近くへ行きましょう
column4:
Captain, come on.
Let's get closer to Cecily.

column3:
ここはなんだ――おかしなもんだな
ちょっと調子がいいみたいだ
column4:
What is this place-- it's crazy.
I think I'm feeling a little better.

column3: ああ――澄んだ竜力を感じるぜ
column4: Yeah--I can feel the pure Dragon Force in the air.

column3:
セシリーはレスタニアとあなたたちのために
ひとときの竜力を使い――
巫女と巡り合わせたというわけか
column4:
Cecily used her Dragon Force for a moment to help 
Lestania and you...
Guiding you to the priestess.

column3:
時間がないようだから、早く行きなさい
この災難が落ち着いたら、ゆっくり話そう
column4:
Since you don't seem to have much time, 
you'd better get going, 
and when this mishap is over, 
we'll have a long talk.

column3: あなたたちの勝利を信じて待っているよ
column4: I believe in you and await your victory.

column3:
セシリーは再び眠りについたようだ
我々の竜は問いかけに答えることなく
眠り続けるばかり
column4:
Cecily seems to have fallen asleep again, 
and our Dragon continues to slumber without 
answering our prayers.

column3:
しかし、それでも穏やかな気持ちでいられるのは
このフィンダムから黒騎士を追い出してくれた
あなたたちのおかげだ
column4:
But still, I can't help but feel calm.
It is you and your friends who drove the 
Black Knight out of Phindym.

column3:
我々に何ができるのかわからないが――
いつでもあなたたちの味方だ
それだけは忘れないでほしい
column4:
I don't know what we can do for you.
But we'll always be on your side.
I just want you to remember that.

column3:
ありがとう、ミシアル
ありがとう、セシリー
column4:
Thank you, Mysial.
Thank you, Cecily.

column3:
さて隊長！
白竜様をお救いする方法はわかりました
column4:
Alright, Captain!
I know how to save Lord White Dragon.

column3:
一度レスタニアに戻って報告したら
事にあたりましょう
column4:
Once we report back to Lestania, 
we'll take care of it.

column3:
絶好調だな
なんなら、前よりいい感じだぜ
column4:
I'm doing great.
If anything, I'm doing better than ever.

column3:
また頼りにしてしまったと後ろめたかったが
我々も役に立てたようでうれしいよ
column4:
I felt guilty for relying on you again, 
but I am glad we were able to be of help.

column3:
聞いたよ
黒騎士の剣を奪い返すんだろ？
column4:
I've heard.
You're going to take the Black Knight's sword 
away from him, right?

column3:
相手が傷を負っているとはいえ
そう簡単なことではないよね
column4:
It's not that easy, 
even if the other guy is wounded.

column3:
わかっちゃいるけど――頼むよ
レスタニアの未来のためだ
column4:
I know, I know... but please.
It's for the future of Lestania.

column3:
我が命――あと少しでいい――
つないでくれ――
column4:
My breath――let it linger yet awhile――
Hold it fast――

column3:
無事に戻って何よりだ
良からぬ事が起こって足止めされるのではないかと
気が気ではなかったぞ
column4:
Glad you're back safe and sound.
I was afraid something bad would happen 
and you'd be stranded.

column3:
して、ミシアルが現れ、黒騎士から
剣を取り戻せと策をくれたのだろう？
column4:
Then, Mysial appeared and provided you with a 
plan to get the sword back from the 
Black Knight, did she not?

column3:
しかも黒騎士は傷を負い、動けないと
いうではないか
column4:
Moreover, the Black Knight is wounded 
and unable to move.

column3:
楽な戦いにも思えるが
その実、この機会を逃せばレスタニアは終わりだ
おお、事の重大さに身も震えるわ
column4:
It may seem like an easy fight, but the fact is, 
if we don't seize this opportunity, 
it will be the end of Lestania.

Oh, I shudder at the gravity of the situation.

column3:
それとな――
良い知らせがひとつある
column4: Oh, and――one piece of good news.

column3:
メイリーフのもとで寝込んでいたリズが
少しではあるが、力を取り戻したようだ
column4:
Lise, who was bedridden under Mayleaf's care, 
seems to have regained some of her strength, 
if only a little.

column3:
あらためて、おまえたちにレスタニアの未来を託すぞ
あの憎っくき黒騎士を打ち倒し
剣を持ち帰ってくれ
column4:
Once again, 
I entrust the future of Lestania to you. 
Defeat that hateful Black Knight 
and bring back the sword.

column3:
こういう言い方をすると、またクラウスが
何か言いそうだが――
column4:
If I put it like this, Klaus might 
have something to say again――

column3:
いいか、今は、黒騎士から
剣を取り戻すことが最優先だ
column4:
Look, right now, our priority is to get the sword 
away from the Black Knight.

column3:
敵は傷を負っているのだろう？
その傷を我々の味方にせねばならん
column4:
The enemy has wounds, does he not? 
We must make those wounds our allies.

column3: つまり、時間がない
column4: In other words, time is short.

column3:
アッカーシェランについたらネド王子に
事情を話して、黒騎士討伐に
協力させるのだ――いいな？
column4:
When you get to Acre Selund, you must tell 
Prince Nedo about the situation and get him to 
help you defeat the Black Knight--understood?

column3:
フィンダムからの加護がいつまで
持ってくれるのかは分からぬが
column4:
I don't know how long the blessing
from Phindym will last.

column3:
今はその力だけが頼みの綱
加護のあるうちに、迅速に――慎重に――
事を進めて欲しい
column4:
That power is our only hope now. 
While you have the blessing, 
I want you to proceed quickly--and carefully--
with the matter at hand.

column3:
油断するな――黒騎士は――
傷ついても尚――手強いぞ――
column4:
Be not lulled――
the Black Knight――
Though stricken, he is yet fierce――
A foe not easily felled――

column3:
メガド侵攻作戦の途中で戻って来たから
向こうは向こうで大変だろうね
column4:
You came back in the middle of the 
Megado invasion, so it's likely to be a lot 
more complicated over there.

column3:
いいかい？
メガド攻略の流れの中で黒騎士を探すといい
状況によっては、向こうから出てくるよ
column4:
Okay?
You can look for the Black Knight in the process 
of attacking Megado, and under the right 
circumstances, he'll come out in the open.

column3:
好機は何度も来ないから
焦ってし損じちゃダメ――いい？
column4:
Opportunities don't come around again and again, 
sodon't be in a hurry and miss out--okay?

column3:
わたしも行くからね――
隊長と一緒に――わたしも行くんだから
column4:
I'll be there--
with the Captain--I'll be there too!

column3: リズが出て行っちゃったの
column4: Lise left.

column3:
大丈夫かなあ
隊長さん、やさしくしてあげてね
column4:
I wonder if she's okay.
Be gentle with her, Captain.

column3:
リズに無理をさせないでくださいよ
本調子にはほど遠い状態ですからね
column4:
Don't push Lise too hard.
She's far from peak condition.

column3: 覚者さま、よくぞ戻って来て下さいました
column4: Good to have you back, Master Arisen.

column3:
我々解放軍はあれ以来、敵の攻勢にさらされ
メガド再攻略は難しい状況と
言わざるをえません
column4:
We, the Liberation Army, have been under enemy 
offensive since then, and I must say that it is 
becoming more and more difficult for us 
to retake Megado.

column3:
今も展望城周辺で、武装した敵隊列の
目撃を受け、主力軍は急遽展望城へ
引き返したところです
column4:
Even presently, the main army has just hurriedly 
retreated back to the Lookout Castle after the 
sighting of an enemy column in the vicinity.

column3:
どうか、覚者さまも展望城へ向かい
ネドさまと合流ください
column4:
Please, Master Arisen, 
head for the Lookout Castle and join Lord Nedo.

column3: 敵は我々を追い詰めつつあります
column4: The enemy is hunting us down.

column3:
どうか展望城へ向かい
我らに力をお貸しください
column4:
Please head to the Lookout Castle
and lend us your strength.

column3:
あの大軍、奴ら展望城を強襲するつもりです
ああ、急がないと大変なことに！
column4:
That big army, 
they're going to storm the Lookout Castle.

Ah, we're in trouble if we don't hurry!

column3:
あんたたち――
きっと帰ってくると信じていたよ
column4:
You guys...
I knew you'd come back.

column3:
さあ、俺にも出来ることがあれば
何でも言ってくれ
column4:
Now, if there's anything I can do to help, 
just tell me.

column3:
おお、レスタニアの勇者たちよ！
戻られたか！
column4:
Oh, the brave warriors of Lestania!
You're back!

column3: 急ぎ城内に避難指示を出したところだ
column4:
I've just issued an urgent evacuation 
order for the castle.

column3:
ほら、聞こえる？
いやーなオークの咆哮さ
column4:
See, can you hear it?
That's the roar of a loathsome orc.

column3:
ありがとうございます
レスタニアはどうでしたか？
column4:
Thank you.
How was Lestania?

column3:
戻ってくれて良かった
こっちは大変なことになっていてね
column4:
It's good to have you back. 
It's been a rough night over here.

column3: 聞かなくてもわかりますよね――
column4: No need to ask--you know what I mean.

column3: この、漂うオークの攻撃臭！
column4: The smell of an orc attack is in the air!

column3:
さっさとネドと話せよ
もう、どうするか決めてあんだろ
column4:
Just talk to Nedo and get on with it, we already 
decided what we're going to do about it.

column3:
なんでもいいから――
早くやっちゃおうよ――
column4:
Whatever it is...
Let's just get it over with――

column3:
この難局は必ずや乗り切らねばならん
この城を失うわけにはいかんのだ
column4:
We must get through this predicament, 
and we cannot afford to lose this castle.

column3:
リズは顔色が悪いね
まだ本調子じゃないのか
column4:
Liz doesn't look so good... 
like she hasn't recovered from 
her bout of lethargy.

column3:
ガルドリンも暗い顔して――
隊長、エリオット、ふたりの分まで頼むよ
column4:
And Gurdolin looks a bit gloomy―― 
Captain, Elliott, 
you'll need to cover for both of them.

column3:
攻め込まれちゃいるが
解放軍の士気はまだ高い
column4:
Though under attack, morale is still high 
among the Liberation Army forces.

column3:
この心意気が消えないうちに
なんとか終わらせるんだよ
column4:
We've got to get this thing done 
before this spirit dies out.

column3:
城内に逃げ遅れた人たちが出たようです
まずはその人たちの救助を急ぎましょう
column4:
It seems that some people have failed to 
escape into the castle.
Let's hurry to rescue them first!

column3:
レスタニアの問題は解決したのですよね？
だから戻って来てくれたのですよね？
本当にありがとうございます！
column4:
The problem in Lestania was solved, wasn't it?
That's why you came back, right?
Thank you so much!

column3:
隊長、ここをきれいにしないと
黒騎士討伐もままなりません
やるしかないですね
column4:
Captain, if we don't clean this place up, 
we won't be able to defeat the Black Knight. 
We have to do it.

column3:
黒騎士のところに行くには
解放軍の協力が不可欠だ
column4:
In order to get to the Black Knight, 
the cooperation of the
Liberation Army is essential.

column3:
さあ、盛大に恩を売って
がっぽり見返りをもらおうぜ
column4:
Come on, let's do them a grand favor 
and reap the rewards!

column3: 負けないぞ――わたしは負けない！
column4: I won't―― I won't lose!

column3:
ああ、また助けて頂きましたね
ありがとうございます
column4: Ah, you've helped us again. Thank you.

column3:
敵はこの階下の中層へも入り込んで来ています
どうか人々を、展望城をお救い下さい
column4:
The enemy has entered the middle level, 
below this floor.
Please save the people and the Lookout Castle.

column3:
も、もう敵はいないの？
もう、安全なの？
column4:
Are there no more enemies? 
Are we safe now?

column3: 覚者さん、ありがとう！
column4: Thank you, Ser Arisen!

column3:
敵の強襲部隊の将、戦の将が
城門広場に現れたとの情報です
column4:
We have information that the general of the enemy 
assault force, the War Master, 
has appeared at the Castle Gate Plaza.

column3:
この機を逃してはなりません
急ぎ城門広場へ向かいましょう！
column4:
Don't miss this opportunity. 
Hurry and head to the Castle Gate Plaza!

column3:
さあ！　戦況を変える千載一遇の機会です
戦の将を討ち果たしましょう！
column4:
Come on! This is a once-in-a-thousand opportunity 
to change the course of the war. 
Let's defeat the War Master!

column3:
あんたが来てくれて助かったよ
俺たちの希望は、ああ、消えちゃいなかった！
column4:
I'm glad you came. 
Our hope, ah, it hasn't vanished!

column3: 助力、誠に感謝します
column4: Thank you so much for your help.

column3:
すぐにでもメガドへ攻め込みたいが
防衛戦が終わったばかり
column4:
I'd love to attack Megado right away, 
but we just finished our defense.

column3:
守るも攻めるも編成の組み直しと
休息が必要だ
column4:
We need to reorganize and rest, 
both defensively and offensively.

column3:
戻り、アッカーシェランの心意気を
レスタニアのお歴々にお伝え願いたい
column4:
I hope you will return and convey the spirit of 
Acre Selund to the people of Lestania.

column3: ごめんなさい
column4: I'm sorry.

column3:
僕たちは自分のことばかり考えて――
本当にごめんなさい
column4:
We only think about ourselves――
I'm really I'm sorry.

column3:
――黒い鎧の騎士と戦う時は
これまでにあなたたちから受けた恩――
全部返す意気込みで頑張るよ
column4:
--When you fight the knight in black armor, 
I will do my best to repay all the favors you 
have done for us so far.

column3: それがアッカーシェランのためでもあるしね
column4: And it's in Acre Selund's best interest.

column3:
ごくろうだったね
すぐに黒騎士討伐に行きたいところだろうが
休息は大事だよ？　いいね
column4:
I know you're probably going to want to take 
down the Black Knight right away, 
but it's important to get some rest, okay? 
All right.

column3:
いつもなら、じれったいと思うでしょうが
この休止はありがたいですね
column4:
Normally, you'd think I'd be impatient, 
but I appreciate this pause.

column3:
リズもガルドリンも本調子とは
言い難いですから
column4: Lise and Gurdolin aren't exactly in top form.

column3: 仕方ねえ、休んでやるか
column4: No choice, I'll take a break.

column3: ちょっと――疲れたかな
column4: I'm a little--I'm a little tired.

column3:
リズだけじゃなくて
みんなもゆっくり休んでね
column4:
Not just Lise.
I hope you all get a good night's rest.

column3:
ご自由におくつろぎください
どうぞ、自分の家だと思って
column4: Please feel free to make yourself at home.

column3:
黒騎士の傷はいかほどだろうね
痛みに苛まれていればいいのに
column4:
I wonder how badly the Black Knight is hurt. 
I hope he's in a lot of pain.

column3: ――黒騎士を――逃がすな――
column4:
――Let not the Black Knight―― 
Escape from thy grasp――

column3: メイロワ殿の言葉は心強い限りだ
column4: Master Meirova's words are reassuring.

column3:
だが、わたしは、もう黒騎士と
一戦交えた頃だと思っていたぞ
column4:
But I figured it was time you had a fight with 
the Black Knight.

column3: 次は、いよいよということになろうが――
column4: Next, I wonder if it's finally――

column3: 頼むぞ、必ず剣を持ち帰ってくるのだ
column4: Please make sure to bring back his sword.

column3:
頼む！
白竜の衰弱が目に見えて進んでいる
column4: Please! The white dragon is visibly weakening.

column3:
一刻の猶予もなさそうだ
なんとしても黒騎士を打ち倒して
剣を持ち帰ってくれ
column4:
There's not a moment to lose, 
so do whatever you can to defeat the 
Black Knight and bring back the sword.

column3:
奴めが傷をいやして
どこぞの世界に姿を消すのかと思うと
夜も眠れんわ
column4:
I can't sleep at night knowing that he's going 
to heal his wounds and disappear into 
some other world.

column3: 向こうの連中と話し、早々に挑んでくれ
column4:
Talk to the guys over there and try to tackle 
it as soon as possible.

column3: 心苦しいが、ねぎらいの言葉が今は浮かばない
column4:
It pains me, but I cannot think of any 
words of encouragement at this moment.

column3:
宿命として受け入れ、必ずや白竜を傷つけた
剣を持ち帰ってくれ
column4:
Accept it as destiny and be sure to bring back the
sword that hurt the White Dragon.

column3: 最早――頼むと――願うばかり――
column4:
At this point―― 
I can but beseech――

column3:
一応報告しておこう
ブラッドオーブでは、もう、白竜様の
状況を押しとどめることもできない
column4:
In case you're wondering, 
I'm afraid I have to report that the Blood Orbs 
are no longer enough to stifle 
Lord White Dragon's condition.

column3: ここだけの話――オーブ収集は気休めさ
column4: Between you and me--collecting orbs is a comfort.

column3: ありったけのオーブを使ったが白竜様はよくならん
column4:
We spent all the orbs we had, 
but Lord White Dragon is not getting any better.

column3:
くっ――泣けてくるわ
もう、おまえたちにレスタニアの未来を
預けよう――それしか策はない
column4:
Damn-- it makes me weep.
I'll leave the future of Lestania in your hands
 now--that's all I can do.

column3:
川や池から腐臭が漂っていたという
報告があるんだ
column4:
There have been reports of a rotten smell 
wafting from rivers and ponds.

column3: 大地を巡る竜力があちこちで淀んでいるらしい
column4:
It seems that Dragon Force that circulates 
the land is already stagnating.

column3:
隊長さん、大丈夫？
休まなくていい？
column4:
Captain, are you okay? 
Do you need to rest?

column3:
白竜様が傷ついてから
覚者様たちの顔色がどんどん悪くなって
いるのです
column4:
Since Lord White Dragon's injury, 
the complexion of the Arisen has 
been getting worse and worse.

column3:
自覚があるかどうかわからないけど――
隊長さん、あなたもね
column4:
I don't know if you're aware of this, but-- 
Captain, you too.

column3:
敵側に動きありとの情報がはいり
あろうことかネド王子はジリアンを伴って
出撃してしまった
column4:
Prince Nedo, upon receiving word of movement on 
the enemy side, 
unexpectedly set out accompanied by Gillian.

column3:
おぬしたちも急ぎメガド居住層へ
向かってくれ
column4:
I need you all to hurry and head for the 
Megado Residential Level.

column3:
状況ははっきりとはわかっていない上に
あの黒騎士が潜む城塞だ
column4:
We don't know exactly what's going on, 
and it's a fortress with that 
Black Knight lurking in it.

column3:
用心して事に当たってくれ
わしもすぐに追いかける
column4:
Be careful what you do.
I'll be right behind you.

column3:
ネド王子が独断専行とは――
おぬしたちへの恩返しに取りつかれているようだ
column4:
Prince Nedo is acting on his own initiative... 
he seems to be obsessed with repaying the 
favor he owes you.

column3: 部隊編成を終えたらここを出よう
column4:
We'll leave here when we're done 
with the troop formation.

column3:
あんたたちの後に続く、勇猛な軍隊を
作ってやろうじゃないか
column4:
Let us build a valiant army to 
follow in your footsteps.

column3:
隊長、一度で決めたいですね
白竜様も覚者も限界に近い――
俺、そう感じています
column4:
Captain, I'd like to settle this once and for all.
Lord White Dragon and the Arisen are both 
nearing their limits-- that's how I feel.

column3:
さあ、行こうぜ
メガド居住層とやらへよ
column4:
Come on, let's go to this 
Megado Residential Level.

column3:
行こう、隊長――
黒騎士をやっつけて剣を取り戻そう――
column4:
Let's go, Captain--
Let's take out the Black Knight and get 
the sword back--

column3: はぁはぁ――
column4: Haah――

column3:
ふん――キツい戦いだな
勝利はそう簡単じゃないんだね
column4:
Hmph -- a tough fight.
I guess victory isn't that easy.

column3:
いつ黒騎士が来るかと思うと――
ああ、緊張するよ
column4:
I'm just wondering when the Black Knight is--
Oh, I'm getting tense.

column3:
黒騎士は手負いなんだろう？
だったら、きっと簡単さ
column4:
The Black Knight is wounded, right?
Then it should be easy.

column3:
黒騎士を見た者の話では
とてつもなく強いとのこと――
column4:
According to those who have seen the 
Black Knight, he is incredibly strong--

column3: まあ用心に越したことはないですね
column4: Well, you can never be too careful.

column3:
この戦闘が始まってから、黒騎士の姿を
見た者がいない
column4:
No one has seen the Black Knight at any 
time since this battle began.

column3:
レスタニアの竜に負わされた傷で
すでに死んだという噂も流れている
column4:
Rumor has it that he has already died from the 
wounds inflicted by the Lestanian Dragon.

column3: でも、竜を沈黙させるほどの力を持った相手
column4:
But, an opponent with enough power 
to silence a Dragon...

column3:
もし目の前に現れたら兵たちの士気が
どうなるか怪しい
column4:
I dread to think what would happen to the 
morale of the soldiers if he 
appeared before them.

column3: ねえ、隊長
column4: Hey, Captain.

column3:
もし、もしも、この地が敵の手に落ちるような
ことがあれば
column4:
If this land should ever fall into 
the hands of the enemy...

column3:
一人でも多くの民たちをレスタニアに
連れて行ってくれないか？
column4:
Would you take as many of our people 
as possible to Lestania?

column3: ありがとう――これで、心おきなく戦えるよ
column4: Thank you--now I can fight without worrying.

column3:
正直、こんなにいっぱいの感謝の気持ち――
未来への希望――どっちも初めてなの
column4:
I can honestly say that I've never felt so much 
gratitude - and hope for the future - either!

column3: こんな状況だけど、ああ、悪くはない気分だよ
column4:
I'm in this situation, but yeah, 
I'm not feeling too bad.

column3:
僕はベルタの部隊と合流して、メイロワ将軍に
続きます！
column4:
I joined Bertha's unit and followed 
General Meirova!

column3:
さあ、行きましょう
ここにいないなら、黒騎士はもっと奧に
いるはずですよ
column4:
Come on, let's go. 
If he's not here, the Black Knight must 
be further back.

column3:
黒騎士め――
どっかでぶっ倒れてるんじゃねえか？
column4:
The Black Knight――
he's probably collapsed somewhere, isn't he?

column3:
勝手に死なれちゃ困るぜ
最後は俺が見送ってやる
column4:
Don't let him die on his own.
I'll take care of him in the end.

column3:
早く行かないとメイロワ将軍たちが
孤立しちゃうよ
column4:
If we don't go soon, General Meirova and his men 
will be isolated.

column3:
やったぞ！　メガド回廊を制圧！
この勢いのままにメガド王宮に突入だ！
column4:
We did it! 
The Megado Corridor is ours! 
Let's keep this momentum going into 
the Royal Palace of Megado!

column3: なまじろき竜とともに死ぬがいい
column4:
It would be best for you to die with 
that dragon of yours.

column3: 弱者は滅ぶ、それが道理だ
column4: The weak will perish, that's the way it is.

column3: 理の呪縛に囚われ、闇に沈め！
column4:
Caught in the spell of order, 
sink into darkness!

column3: 力を付けたようだが――無駄なこと！
column4:
Seems to have gained strength――
but to no avail!

column3: 白竜から奪いし竜力は我が手にあるぞ
column4:
The Dragon Force that was taken from 
the white dragon is in my grasp.

column3: 渡さぬ――この力、誰にも渡すものか――
column4:
I will not surrender this power――
I will not yield it to anyone――

column3: 早くこの魔物をやっつけないと
column4:
We need to get rid of this monster 
as soon as possible.

column3: 黒騎士は、何がなんでもここで倒すよ！
column4:
I'll defeat the Black Knight here, 
no matter what it takes!

column3: 逃がすものか！
column4: I won't let you get away with it!

column3: くっ、睨まれると足がすくむ
column4:
Damn, I get a bit shaky on my feet 
when they glare at me.

column3: 黒騎士よ！　卑怯だぞ！　戦え！
column4:
Black Knight! 
Fight me, you coward! 
Fight!

column3: くそっ！　もどかしい！
column4: Damn! This is frustrating!

column3: さあさあさあ！
column4: Come on, come on!

column3: 今度こそ倒す！
column4: This time we'll beat them!

column3: 邪魔な魔物め！
column4: Get away, you bothersome fiend!

column3: 俺が相手だ！　かかってこい！
column4: I'm your opponent! Come on!

column3: 隊長、戦況が見えません！
column4: Captain, I can't see the battlefield!

column3: くっ――逃げられる！
column4: Damn―― they're getting away!

column3: エリオット、突っこめ！
column4: Elliot, push forward!

column3: こっち見るな！
column4: Don't look at me!

column3: 隊長、リズ、行け！
column4: Captain, Lise, go!

column3: ジリアン、回り込め！
column4: Gillian, go around!

column3: なんだってんだ！
column4: What the hell!

column3: くっ――手強いぜ
column4: Damn--that's a tough one.

column3: セシリー、力を貸してね
column4: Cecily, give me your strength.

column3: 大丈夫、結構動ける！
column4: It's okay, I can move quite a bit!

column3: ジリアン、気をつけて！
column4: Gillian, be careful!

column3: 竜力を返せ！
column4: Return the Dragon Force!

column3: 急がないと黒騎士が逃げちゃう！
column4: Hurry up or the Black Knight will escape!

column3: くっ――セシリー、もう少し――お願い――
column4: Damn... Cecily, just a little more―― please ――

column3: 女を追って来たか
column4: You came for the girl.

column3: 仲間など、見捨てれば良かろう
column4: Just abandon your comrades.

column3: この闇が気になるか
column4: Is this darkness bothering you?

column3: 我が闇の中で、おまえに勝機はない
column4: In my darkness, you stand no chance.

column3: 血が香るアッカーシェランはおまえに相応しい
column4: You deserve Acre Selund reeking of blood.

column3: 悪しき竜は戦いを望んでいる
column4: The Evil Dragon wants a fight.

column3: 戦い無きレスタニアにはおまえの居場所はない
column4:
There is no place for you in Lestania 
if you do not fight.

column3: おまえこそ、戦いを求めているのではないのか
column4: You're the one looking for a fight.

column3: 激情に身を投じろ――そして死ね
column4: Throw yourself into the fury―― and die.

column3: 白竜とともに滅ぶがいい
column4: May you perish with the white dragon.

column3: おまえはまだ、世界を知らぬ
column4: You still don't know the real world.

column3: 今こうしている間にも全ては変わりつつある――
column4:
Even now, while we do this, everything 
is beginning to change――

column3: 何も知らずに消えろ
column4: Fade away, ignorant of everything.

column3:
広大なメガドを守り切ることは、今のわしらでは
困難を極める
column4:
It would be extremely difficult for us to 
defend the vast area of Megado.

column3:
さあ、敵に気づかれないうちに
あたしたちも展望城へ帰ろうじゃないか
column4:
Now, let's get back to the Lookout Castle 
before the enemy notices us.

column3:
お急ぎください
白竜様が待っていらっしゃいますよ
column4:
Please hurry.
Lord White Dragon is waiting for you.

column3:
照れくさいけど――
思いを口にするのは気持ちがいいね
column4:
I know it's embarrassing, but... 
it feels good to say what's on my mind.

column3: ほら、早く剣を持ってレスタニアへ！
column4:
Here, quickly, 
take the sword and go to Lestania!

column3:
隊長、城はあとで見物しようぜ
今は――さあ、急ごう
column4:
Captain, we'll check the castle later.
For now - come on, let's hurry up.

column3: 早く～！　白竜様に剣を～！
column4:
Quickly~! 
Give the sword to Lord White Dragon~!

column3:
今のところ首尾良く物事が進んでいます
この勢いをレスタニアに持って帰りましょう
column4:
So far, things are going well. 
Let's bring this momentum back to Lestania.

column3: 白竜様に元気になってもらうんです
column4:
I'm trying to get 
Lord White Dragon to feel better.

column3: メイリーフは神殿にいるはずです
column4: Mayleaf should be in the temple.

column3: どうだった？
column4: How did it go?

column3:
ん？　エリオット――リズ――
その顔はやったのか！？
column4:
Hmm? Elliot— Lise――
What's with that look!?

column3:
隊長さん、おかえりなさい
でも白竜様が――急いで！
column4:
Welcome back, Captain. 
But Lord White Dragon―― Hurry!

column3: そ、それは――ほら、もっとよく見せてくれ
column4: Oh, that's--here, let me get a better look at it.

column3:
やってくれると思っていたよ
さあ、みんながお待ちかねだ
column4:
I knew you would do it.
Now, everyone's waiting for you.

column3: さすがだ！
column4: That's what I'm talking about!

column3:
期待にたがわず剣を持ち帰ってくれると
一瞬たりとも疑ったことはなかったぞ
column4:
I never doubted for a moment that you would bring 
back the sword, as expected.

column3: さあ、剣を白竜様へ
column4: Now, give the sword to Lord White Dragon.

column3: やはり――おま――え――だな
column4: Indeed―― it is―― thou――

column3: ネド王子に関する相談か――
column4: You're asking for advice about Prince Nedo--

column3:
大ごとでなければいいが
とにかく早く行ってあげなさい
column4:
I hope it's nothing serious. 
Regardless, go quickly!

column3:
時間を取らせてしまったな
もう大丈夫だ
column4:
Sorry to take up so much of your time. 
You're all set.

column3: アッカーシェランの力になってやるがいい
column4: Let Acre Selund help you.

column3:
ひと段落ではあるけれど――
黒騎士と悪しき竜がどこまで通じて
いたのかわからないよね
column4:
It's a break of sorts, but— 
I can't tell how deep the connection was between 
the Black Knight and the Evil Dragon.

column3:
それはこれからの悪しき竜の動きから
見極めるしかないかな
column4:
I guess we'll just have to wait and see what the 
Evil Dragon does from here on out.

column3: おお、おぬしか
column4: Oh, no.

column3:
ネド王子のことは聞いたな？
まだ、ここだけの話にしておいてくれ
column4:
You heard about Prince Nedo, right?
For now, let's keep it between us.

column3:
あれやこれやと王子に押しつけ
過ぎたのかねえ
column4:
I wonder if I pushed the prince too hard 
on this and that.

column3:
あたしも口で心配するほど
気づかいがなかったかもしれないね
column4:
Maybe I wasn't as thoughtful 
as I should have been.

column3:
たしかに王子はまだケツの青いガキだ
でも、重圧から逃げ出すようなやつじゃあ
なさそうだけどよ――
column4:
Yes, the prince is still a boy, but he doesn't 
seem to be the kind of man who would 
run away under pressure...

column3: まあ、わかんねえな
column4: Well, I don't know.

column3: 隊長！
column4: Captain!

column3:
ネド王子が行方不明なの
急いで探しに行かなくちゃ
column4:
Prince Nedo is missing. 
We have to hurry and find him.

column3:
王子はどこでしょうね――
行き先の見当くらい
つきそうなものですけど――
column4:
Where could the prince be―― 
We should at least have 
some notion of where he is――

column3:
皆さん、おそろいですね
さて、黒騎士との戦いの直後に姿を消した
王子ですが――
column4:
Well, I see you're all here now.
Now, the prince disappeared shortly after the 
battle with the Black Knight--

column3: メガド離宮で姿を見たという者を見つけました
column4:
I found someone who said he saw 
him at the Megado Detached Palace.

column3:
目撃者は王子と面識のある兵士ですし
離宮は、メガドに隣接する竜の神殿
となれば、ネド王子であることは確実でしょう
column4:
The witness is a soldier who knows the prince, 
and since the palace borders 
Megado's Dragon Temple, 
it is clear this must be Prince Nedo.

column3:
すでにジリアンが向かっていますが
皆さんもお急ぎください
column4:
Gillian is already on her way, 
but I urge you all to hurry.

column3: 王子にもしものことがあれば――終わりです
column4:
If something happens to the prince―― 
it's over.

column3: しかし、わからないのは王子の気持ちですね
column4:
But what I don't understand 
is how the prince feels.

column3:
無事に保護しても、それがわからなければ
また同じことが起こるでしょう
column4:
Even if you protect them safely, 
if you don't know that, it will happen again.

column3:
メイロワ将軍が何か知っているかも
しれませんが今のところ黙して語らずを
決め込んでいるようですね
column4:
General Meirova may know something, 
but so far he seems to have 
decided to remain silent.

column3:
メガドの離宮は竜の神殿さ
あんたの故郷にも神殿はあるんだろう？
column4:
Megado's Detached Palace is a dragon temple.
You have temples in your homeland, too, don't you?

column3:
今は、竜はいないってのに――
そんなところで王子は何をしているんだろうね
column4:
Now, even though there is no Dragon--
I wonder what the prince is doing 
in a place like that.

column3:
当然と言えば当然ですが、メイロワ将軍の
表情が冴えませんね
話を聞いてみたらどうです？
column4:
Not surprisingly, General Meirova's 
expression is a bit sullen.
Why don't you talk to him?

column3: 王子と覚者――
column4: The Prince and the Arisen--

column3:
両方ともしっかりやれってのは
荷が重いかもしれねえな
column4:
Doing a good job of both 
might be a heavy burden.

column3: 王子、どうしちゃったのかなあ
column4:
Prince, I wonder what's the 
matter with you.

column3: 分からん――
column4: I don't know--

column3:
体制が整い次第、次なる準備のために
神殿へ行くという話は
王子ともすでにしていたのだ
column4:
We had already discussed with the prince that 
as soon as we were ready, we would go to the 
temple to make the next preparations.

column3: それなのにひとりで行ってしまうとは――
column4: And yet, to go there alone--

column3:
とにかく、一刻も早く王子と会って
話を聞かなくてはな
column4:
Anyway, I must see the prince as soon as possible 
and hear what he has to say.

column3:
さあ、離宮へ行こうではないか
離宮へと繋がるメガド王宮層に
案内人を待たせている
column4:
Now, let's go to the Detached Palace. 
We have a guide waiting by the 
Megado Royal Palace that will lead you to it.

column3: それぞれ現地集合だ
column4: We'll each meet there.

column3:
面目ない
いよいよこれからと言うときに――
column4:
I am ashamed, 
just as things were about to truly begin――

column3: ここに来る途中でジリアンと会いましてね
column4: I met Gillian on the way here.

column3:
あの子は先に離宮に向かいました
向こうで合流できるでしょう
column4:
She's headed to the Detached Palace. 
She'll meet you there.

column3: 待っていたよ
column4: I've been waiting for you.

column3:
メガド離宮は、このすぐ先で
王子が目撃された場所は
離宮の最下層にある祭壇だということだ
column4:
The Megado Detached Palace is just down the 
road, and that place where the prince was seen 
is the altar at the lowest level 
of the Detached Palace.

column3:
だが、大地の衰えと共に離宮の中は
邪悪な魔物で満たされてしまっている
column4:
But as the land has decayed, 
the Detached Palace has been 
filled with foul fiends.

column3: 十分に気をつけて進んでくれ！
column4: Proceed with extreme caution!

column3: わたしもさっき着いたんだ
column4: I just got here too.

column3:
王子の気持ちに寄り添っていたつもりだけど
わたしの思い上がりだったのかな
column4:
I thought I was being attentive to the prince's 
feelings, but I guess I was just 
being presumptuous.

column3:
メイロワ将軍には王子の行き先の
心当たりがある――
column4:
General Meirova has an idea of 
where the prince is headed--

column3: んな感じだったな
column4: It was something like that.

column3:
耳を澄ますと笛の音が聞こえる――
なんてことは全然ないね
何も聞こえないや
column4:
If you strain your ears, 
you should hear a flute―― 
but no, nothing like that. 
I can't hear anything.

column3:
俺たちが当てずっぽうに動いても
王子にはたどり着けませんよね
column4: Our guesswork won't get us to the prince.

column3: 何か情報をもらわないと――
column4: We need to get some information--

column3:
笛を手に入れたのなら、おそらく
王子の行き先は火垂れ山
column4:
If he got the flute, 
then perhaps the prince's destination is 
Firefall Mountain.

column3:
火垂れ山は竜の住み処なのだが
道中はおそろしい魔物の巣窟だ
column4:
Firefall Mountain is the home of dragons, 
but along the way it's a lair of 
horrifying demons.

column3:
王子はおそらく、王家に伝わる抜け道を
使うだろうが、わしらは入り口さえ知らん
column4:
The prince will probably use the royal path, 
but we don't even know the entrance.

column3:
ここはいったん展望城に戻り
情報を集めようではないか
column4:
Let's go back to the Lookout Castle and 
gather some information.

column3:
こと、抜け道などに関しては
ベルタが何か知っているかも知れん――
column4:
Bertha may know something 
about the paths and so on.

column3: ――おっと、忘れるところであった
column4: --Oops, almost forgot!

column3:
この離宮を出たすぐその場所には、小さな礎が
あったはず
column4:
Just outside the palace, there must have 
been a small Portcrystal.

column3:
再度ここを通り抜けずとも良いように
礎を解放しておくと良いだろう
column4:
It would be good to attune so we don't have to go 
through here again.

column3:
さあ、礎を解放した後は、急ぎ城へ戻って
ベルタに聞こうではないか
column4:
Now, after doing so, 
let's hurry back to the castle and ask Bertha.

column3:
火垂れ山へ通じる王家の道がわかれば
しめたものだ
column4:
If we can find the royal road to 
Firefall Mountain, we'll be all right.

column3:
なんだって？
火垂れ山の行き方？
column4:
What's that?
How to get to Firefall Mountain?

column3:
そりゃ火垂れ山へ通じる
魔物がうじゃうじゃいる山の麓を辿って――
ああ、王家に伝わる、秘密の経路かい？
column4:
Well, you'd have to trace the demon-infested 
trail that leads up Firefall Mountain at the foot 
of the mountain--oh, the secret royal route?

column3:
北の土地に関する秘密の情報は
北の盗賊が、がっちり固めていてね
あたしらでもおいそれと嗅ぎまわるわけには
いかないのさ
column4:
The secret information about the lands in 
the north is firmly secured by 
the northern bandits.
Even we can't just go snooping around.

column3:
だけど、国が滅ぶかどうかの瀬戸際に
そんなこともいってられないね
column4:
But we can't afford to say that when our country 
is on the brink of destruction.

column3: そうさね――ちょっと時間をおくれよ
column4: I guess so -- just give me a minute.

column3:
北の盗賊の頭目にかけあってみよう
進展があったらすぐ連絡するからね
column4:
I'll talk to the head of the Northern Bandits.
I'll call you as soon as I make any progress.

column3:
ちょっと時間をくれと言っただろう？
年を取ると旅支度ひとつにも手間取っちまうものさ
column4:
I told you to give me some time, didn't I? 
As you get older, 
it takes time to get ready for a trip.

column3:
ベルタめ――
もったいぶっているわけではないだろうな
こうしているあいだにも王子は――
column4:
Bertha... you're not playing with us, are you? 
While we're here, the prince...

column3: 今のうちに休んでおくのもいいかもね
column4: Maybe it's a good idea to take a break now.

column3:
王子の気持ちはわかりませんけど
自分の子供の頃を思い出すと――
column4:
I don't know how the prince feels, 
but when I think back to my own childhood--

column3:
うまく説明できる自信がないから
何も言わないとか――
そんな感じではないでしょうか
column4:
I'm not sure I can explain it well, 
so I'm not going to say anything 
-something like that.

column3:
結局のところ、王子が逃げている理由なんて
どうでもいい――
そんな気がしてきたぜ
column4:
After all, it doesn't really matter why the 
prince is running away--
I'm starting to get that feeling.

column3: ガルドリンと話した？
column4: Did you talk to Gurdolin?

column3:
王子は目的に向かっているわけじゃなくて
わたしたちから逃げてるって言うんだよね
だとしたら――悲しくない？
column4:
The prince isn't pursuing a purpose, 
but rather running away from us, right? 
If so―― doesn't that sadden you?

column3:
一歩、いや、半歩前進というところかな
うーん、いや、考えようによっては後退か
column4:
A step, or perhaps half a step, forward... 
or perhaps, depending on your point of view, 
a step backward.

column3:
竜と覚者の関係は竜によって違う――
我が見識も役には立たないようだ
column4:
The relationship between Dragons and Arisen 
varies from Dragon to Dragon--
It seems my insight is of no use to you.

column3:
ふーむ――ネド王子はいったい
何を考えているのか――
column4:
Hmmm... what in the world is 
Prince Nedo thinking--

column3:
まさかとは思うが――
以前セシリーと一緒に来たロイグのように
悪しき者に心を奪われたりはしておらんか
column4:
I truly hope this isn't the case―― 
but like Loeg with Cecily before, 
has his heart been stolen by darkness?

column3:
となれば厄介だぞ？
もしも王子に剣を向けることになった時は
おまえたちは手を引け
column4:
If that happens, it'll be a big problem, okay?
If we have to turn our swords on the 
prince, you guys back off.

column3: 向こうからはまだ何も言ってこないのか？
column4: Still no word from the other side?

column3:
ベルタは悪い人間ではないらしいが
盗賊に王子の命運をゆだねることになるとは
これがレスタニアのことであれば耐え難い
column4:
Bertha is not a bad person, I hear.
But to put the fate of a prince in the hands of 
a bandit would be unbearable 
if this were Lestania.

column3:
うーむ――
ここでわたしが憤慨してもどうにもならん
column4:
Hmmm―― 
my indignation here won't help.

column3:
さあ、行ってくれ
もしかすると、すでに王子の行方に関する
情報が入っているかもしれないからな
column4:
Now go on.
Maybe you've already got some information on 
the prince's whereabouts.

column3:
わたしにできることは
ネド王子の無事を祈ることくらいだ
column4:
The only thing I can do is pray 
for Prince Nedo's safety.

column3:
近くにいれば王子に言ってやりたいことは
幾つもあるが――
column4:
There are a number of things I'd like to say 
to the prince if he were around--

column3:
今回の王子の行動はどんな理由があっても
褒められたことではないよね
column4:
I don't think the prince's behavior this time 
around is commendable for any reason.

column3:
でも、そんなことは王子自身も
わかっているはずだから――
となると、ますます理由が気になるよ
column4:
But I'm sure the prince himself knows that- 
which makes me even more curious as to why.

column3:
おお、来てくれたか
実はベルタからの連絡があってな
column4:
Oh, you're here.
I was actually contacted by Bertha.

column3:
他ならぬ、おぬしに北の盗賊の集落まで
来てほしいとのことだ
column4:
She wants you, of all people, 
to come to the bandit village in the north.

column3:
連中は定期的に移住しているのだが
今の集落はこの城より北へ北へと
行ったところらしい
column4:
They regularly migrate, but their current 
settlement is just north of this castle.

column3:
先に解放した礎から飛ぶと良い
そこから先の道程は地図で確認してくれ
column4:
You can go from the Portcrystal 
that we released earlier.
From there, check the map for directions.

column3:
わたしは盗賊とは相性が悪い
どうやらそう思われているみたい
column4:
I'm no good with bandits, 
or so they seem to think.

column3: 申し訳ないけれど、よろしく頼むね
column4: I'm sorry, I'll be counting on you.

column3:
留守の間に面倒なことになってるぜ隊長
メイロワ将軍と話したか？
column4:
You've been getting into a lot of trouble while 
I've been gone, Captain.
Have you spoken to General Meirova?

column3:
いつでも動けるように準備しておくから
隊長、しっかり！
column4:
I'll be ready to go at any time, 
Captain, so hang tight!

column3:
辺境の盗賊ともなると警戒心が強いですね
まあ、王家との過去を考えると
当然のことらしいですけど
column4:
When it comes to frontier bandits, I'm very wary.
Well, I guess that's to be expected, 
considering their past with the royal family.

column3:
よく来たな
覚えているか？
column4:
I'm glad you're here.
Remember me?

column3:
俺たちは一度メガドで会っている
この再会は縁としか言いようがないな
column4:
We met once at Megado. 
I'd say this reunion is fate.

column3:
覚えちゃいないだろうが
俺はお頭の孫のレイベンだ
イトコのスライと一緒に、ばあちゃんの護衛さ
column4:
You probably don't remember me, but I'm Raven, 
the Boss's grandson, 
and I'm here with Sly to guard Grandma.

column3:
火垂れ山への秘密の経路のことは
まだ何もわかっちゃいないんだ
column4:
As for the secret path to Firefall Mountain.
We still don't know anything about it.

column3:
でも、この近くを通った王子を偶然見かけた
盗賊がいたらしい
独自の判断で王子の追跡を
始めたらしいが――
column4:
But it seems some bandits happened to see the 
prince passing by this area.
They say they started tracking the prince on 
their own initiative, but--

column3:
そう、察しがいいね
その追跡に出た盗賊仲間が戻らない
というわけだ
column4:
Yeah, you guessed it.
Our bandit friends who went out in 
pursuit of him never returned.

column3:
ここから先は、ここの盗賊の頭目
セロから聞いとくれ
column4:
From here on out, you'll hear from Cyril, 
the boss here.

column3:
あんたを呼んだのは他でもない
メイロワたちと違って、盗賊との間に
面倒な過去を抱えていないからさ
頼りにしてるよ！
column4:
I called you here because, unlike Meirova and the 
others, you don't have a troublesome 
past with bandits.
We're counting on you!

column3:
孫たちがあたしを心配して
ついてきちまってね
column4:
My grandchildren followed me because they 
were worried about me.

column3:
戦うことは得意じゃないけど
ジッとしてはいられない
少しばかりやんちゃかもしれないけど
悪い子らじゃないからよろしく頼むよ
column4:
They're not good at fighting, 
but they won't sit still, and they may be a 
little mischievous, but they're not bad kids, 
so please take care of them.

column3:
ちゃんとした挨拶はまだだったな
俺はここの頭目、セロだ
column4:
We haven't had a chance to say hello properly yet.
I'm Cyril, the boss of this place.

column3: 先の王都メガドを取り戻す戦いは見事だった
column4:
The earlier battle to reclaim the 
Royal Capital of Megado was spectacular.

column3:
俺たちは悪しき竜率いる魔軍のせいで
本当に多くの仲間を失っていた
メガドの戦いはその弔い合戦でもあったのだ
column4:
We lost so many friends because of the 
Evil Dragon's army.
The battle of Megado was also 
a battle of mourning.

column3:
その戦いに勝利をもたらした
おまえのことは一目置いている
column4: You won that battle. I've got my eye on you.

column3: では本題に入ろう
column4: So let's get down to business.

column3:
我々はメガドを奪回ののち、離宮から
出てきた少年を見つけた
少年は明らかに人目をはばかりながら
北へ北へと進んでいた
column4:
After reclaiming Megado, we found a young boy 
coming out of the detached palace.
The boy was obviously going north, 
away from people.

column3:
あれは間違いなくネド王子――
そう判断した俺の部下が少年を
追い始めたのだ
column4:
That was definitely Prince Nedo ――
My man decided that was the case and 
started chasing the boy.

column3:
ところが、その部下からの連絡が
途絶えてしまった
column4: However, I lost contact with that subordinate.

column3:
そしてその部下が途絶えたと思わしき辺りから
複数のオークの足跡が見つかったのだ
column4:
And in the area where we think the man had been 
lost, we found multiple orc footprints.

column3:
展望城から姿を消した王子の情報は
既に魔軍にも掴まれていると考えていいだろう
column4:
It's safe to assume that the Demon Army already 
has information about the prince disappearing 
from the Lookout Castle.

column3:
今は動けるもの総出で、王子と部下の捜索に
当たっているところだ
column4:
Right now, 
all available men are searching for the Prince.

column3:
幸いなことに、ベルタの手の者も
協力してくれている
まずはその場所へ向かい、捜索の状況を
確認してくれ
column4:
Fortunately, Bertha's crew is cooperating with us.
First, head over to the location and check on the 
status of the search.

column3:
それから――
火垂れ山の麓から逃げてきた
エリアマスターのバシアスと話しておくと良い
column4:
Following that――
After escaping from the foot of Firefall Mountain,
it would be good to speak to Bacias,
the Area Master.

column3:
ベルタの手の者は、ここから東南にある
祠付近にいるはずだ
column4:
Bertha's crew should be near 
the shrine southeast of here.

column3: 場所は地図で確認してくれ
column4: You can check the location on the map.

column3: セロの話は聞いたか？
column4: Did you hear what Cyril said?

column3:
スライも王子を探しに行ったんだけど
何も連絡がない
column4:
Sly went looking for the prince too, 
but he hasn't found anything.

column3: 無事だと信じちゃいるが不安だよ
column4: I believe he's safe, but I'm worried.

column3:
わたしはエリアマスターのバシアス
火竜様とアッカー家の命により
火垂れ山の入口を守り続けるのが役目です
column4:
I am Basias, Area Master.
I am tasked by Lord Fire Dragon and the 
House of Acre to protect the entrance to 
the Firefall Mountain.

column3:
しかし悪しき竜の出現により、火垂れ山は
魔窟と化し、その道中もおぞましい魔物により
埋め尽くされてしまいました
column4:
Yet, since the emergence of the Evil Dragon, 
Firefall Mountain has become a den of evil, 
its paths now swarming with terrifying beasts.

column3:
今はこうして彼らの助けにより、この場所へ
逃れ命を繋いでいます
column4:
For now, thanks to their support, 
I've escaped to this place, 
keeping my life intact.

column3:
ここでこうしてあなたにお会い出来たのは
亡き火竜様のお導きかも知れません
column4:
It may be the guidance of the late 
Lord Fire Dragon that I have met you here.

column3:
この北の地を悪しき者の手から回復する
手伝いをお願いさせてください
column4:
Please, I ask for your assistance in reclaiming 
this northern land from the grasp of evil.

column3:
ここでの礎の解放をお忘れなきよう――
わたしたちの行く末に一筋の導きが
途絶えませぬように
column4:
Don't forget to attune to the portcrystal here―― 
lest the single thread of guidance to our future 
is severed.

column3:
あんた、新たな協力者か？
王子の捜索状況はどんな具合だ？
column4:
You're the new contact?
What's the status of the search for the prince?

column3:
ああ、それならこの洞窟を抜けるといい
その先で、ベルタの手の者が
捜索に当たってくれているはずだ
column4:
Yeah, you'll have to go through this cave, 
to where Bertha's crew should be 
searching the area.

column3:
よお――
おまえが派遣されてきたのか
お互い王子には手を焼かされる運命らしいな
column4:
Well―― 
so you're the one they sent. 
It seems we are both fated to be 
troubled by the prince.

column3:
セロが、どこまで話したか知らないが
王子を追っていた盗賊はセロの娘だ
column4:
I don't know how much Cyril told you, 
but the bandit who was following the prince 
was Cyril's daughter.

column3:
どうやら王子はここへ来たことは間違いないが
その先には足跡がない
本来のルートは断念したと考えていいだろう
column4:
The prince came here, no doubt.
But there are no footprints beyond that point.
It's safe to assume that he abandoned his 
original route.

column3:
王子を追跡していた彼女の足跡も
ここで途絶えている
見えるだろ？
辺り一面、オークの足跡だらけさ
column4:
She was tracking the prince, 
and her trail ends here.
See?
Orc tracks all over the place.

column3:
状況から察するに、彼女はオークに攫われ
てしまったと見ていいだろう
column4:
From the looks of things, 
I'd say she's been kidnapped by orcs.

column3:
すぐに殺されなかったことを考えると
彼女は何か、王子の行く先の手掛かりを握っている
のかも知れないな
であれば、王子を捕まえるまでは奴らも彼女を
殺さないはずだ
column4:
Given that she wasn't killed immediately, she 
may hold some clue as to where the prince 
is going. If that's the case, they won't kill her 
until they get the prince.

column3:
だが急いだほうが良い
王子失踪の情報が魔軍全体に広まってからでは
厄介だ
column4:
But we'd better hurry, because once word of the 
prince's disappearance spreads throughout the 
Demon Army, we'll be in trouble.

column3: オークの足跡は西の方角へ向かっている
column4: The orc's footprints are heading west.

column3:
お前は西南にあるこの地図の辺りへ向かってくれ
俺は西北から捜索する
column4:
You head to the area on this map in the 
southwest, and I'll search from the northwest.

column3: おまえの腕っ節を頼りにしてるよ
column4: I'm counting on your prowess.

column3:
俺は魔物に遭遇しないよう
辺りを探りながらいかせてもらうぜ
column4:
I'm going to scout the area to make sure I don't 
run into any monsters.

column3:
ああ、嫌な予感がしていたんだ！
頭目の娘のことさ！
アーシェはやはりオークに連れ去られたのか
column4:
Yeah, I was getting a bad feeling about this!
I mean that girl is the boss's daughter!
Ashe must have been taken by the orcs after all!

column3:
彼女はまだ若い、盗賊としては未熟だが
王子の情報を決して喋りなんかはしないだろう
column4:
She is still young and inexperienced as a bandit, 
but she would never give away information 
about the prince.

column3:
はやく助け出さないとまずいことになっちまう
俺はここより先の南を探すから
あんたはそのまま西の先へ向かってくれ
column4:
If we don't get her out of there soon, 
we're gonna have a problem.
I'll look south of here, 
you keep heading west.

column3:
このあたりにも無数の魔軍の足跡がある
なんにせよ急いだ方が良さそうだ
column4:
There are countless Demon Army footprints in 
this area, so whichever way we go, 
we'd better hurry.

column3:
ヤバかったよ、ありがとう！　
状況は聞いている
攫われた頭目の娘らしき人影を、スライと共に
追って来たんだがこの様だ
column4:
That was bad, thanks!　
I heard about the situation.
I've been tracking the boss's kidnapped daughter 
with Sly, and here we are.

column3:
彼女は隙を見て魔軍から逃げ出せたらしい
でも魔物に追われている！
スライが彼女を守りに行ったが
ああ、このすぐ先だ！
column4:
Apparently she was able to escape from the 
Demon Army when she saw an opening, 
but she was still being chased by fiends!
Sly went to protect her.
Yeah, it's just up ahead!

column3:
彼女から追手を引き離そうと、注意を引くつもり
だったが、追手が複数いたのは誤算だったよ
column4:
I was trying to get her attention and draw her 
pursuers away from her, but I miscalculated, 
there was more than one of them after her.

column3:
ああ、こっちだ
助かったよ
column4: Yeah, this way. Thanks for the help.

column3:
彼女が魔軍に攫われた王子の追跡者――
つまり、セロの娘に間違いない
column4:
She's the one who was kidnapped by the 
Demon Army while tracking the prince.
So, she must be Cyril's daughter.

column3:
さあ、連れて帰ろう
魔物に襲われて怪我をしている
言ってることも混乱気味だ
column4:
Come on, let's bring her home.
She's been attacked by a fiend, 
she's wounded and confused about what 
she's saying.

column3:
――誰！？
オークじゃないよね？
column4:
―― Who!?
You're not an orc, are you?

column3:
うっ――お願い
はやく――父さんに伝えなきゃ――
column4:
Ugh... please...
Quickly... we have to tell my dad--

column3: 王子を見つけたよ――
column4: I found the prince--

column3:
そして彼が最後に――消えた――
場所を――
column4: And the place where he last... disappeared...

column3: ごめん――父さん――
column4: I'm sorry―― Dad――

column3: すぐに王子だと気づけなくて――
column4: I didn't recognize the prince right away――

column3:
彼女の容態はかなり厳しい
一刻を争うかもしれないな
column4:
Her condition is pretty grim.
We may not have a moment to lose.

column3: よし、俺が背負って連れて行こう
column4: Okay, I'll carry her on my back.

column3:
セロとばあちゃんが待っている
アジトで会おうぜ
column4:
Let's meet at the
hideout where Cyril and Grandma are waiting.

column3:
ご苦労だったね
あの娘の一命はなんとか取り留めそうだよ
column4:
Thanks for your help.
I think we may have saved that girl's life.

column3: 追跡者が頭目の娘だったとはね
column4: I didn't realize the tracker was the boss's daughter.

column3:
今は別の安全な場所で眠ってるよ
スライが看病しているから、まかせようぜ
column4:
She's sleeping in a safe place now.
Sly is taking care of her, 
so let's leave it to him.

column3:
ありがとう
俺の部下を――
いや、娘を救い出してくれて感謝する
column4:
Thank you.
Thank you for rescuing my tracker――
No, thank you for rescuing my daughter.

column3:
状況は厳しいが、まだまだ若い
きっと危機を乗り越えてくれるだろう
column4:
The situation is tough, but she's still young.
I am sure she will overcome this crisis.

column3:
さて、肝心の、王子の足取りだが――
娘は出立からの出来事を
逐一暗号にして記録に残していた
column4:
Now, the important thing, the prince's trail...
My daughter kept a coded record of every single 
event from the time of her departure.

column3:
今、娘が記した記録を解読し、その足取りの
割り出しにかかっている
column4:
We're now trying to decipher the records written 
by my daughter and determine her route.

column3:
ほどなく王子の向かった秘密の経路のある場所も
割り出せるはずだ
column4:
Soon we should be able to locate the secret 
route the prince took.

column3:
内容がわかり次第、展望城へ
伝令を走らせよう
column4:
As soon as we know what's what, 
we'll send a message to the Lookout Castle.

column3: それまでは戻ってゆっくり休むといい
column4: Until then, go back and get some rest.

column3:
大丈夫、アーシェは持ちこたえるさ
ああ、大丈夫だとも
column4:
Don't worry. Ashe will hold up.
Yeah, I'm sure she'll be fine.

column3:
おかえり
話はだいたい聞いたよ
ごくろうさま
column4:
Welcome back. 
I've heard most of the story. 
Thank you for your hard work.

column3: その顔は――
column4: That look on your face--

column3:
うーん、わからない
状況は好転したのか悪化したのか――
ああっ、言わないでください！
column4:
Hmm, I don't know. 
Has the situation improved 
or worsened―― 
Ah, please don't say!

column3:
俺たちはここで待っていればいいのか？
このままじゃ足の裏にカビが生えるぜ
column4:
We're just supposed to wait here?
We're gonna grow roots standing still.

column3: おかえりなさい隊長
column4: Welcome back, Captain.

column3:
気づいてる？
城の中の空気が変わった気がしない？
中途半端というか、停滞というか――
これって良くない状況だよね
column4:
Have you noticed?
Do you feel a change in the 
atmosphere inside the castle?
It's like we're stuck somewhere, or stagnant.
This is not a good situation.

column3: ――そうか――まあ、そうだろうな
column4: --Well--well, I guess you're right.

column3:
いや、ごくろうだった
気が急いていたぶん、がっかりしたが
悪い報せがもたらされたわけではない
column4:
No, you did a great job.
I was in a hurry and was disappointed, 
but that doesn't mean the news was bad.

column3:
王子にまた一歩追いついた――
そう考えて朗報を待つことにしよう
column4:
We've made another step towards the prince...
Let's think so and wait for the good news.

column3: 今は気が急いてもどうにもならんな――
column4: I just can't help but feel on edge right now--

column3:
情報が届き次第、いつでも動けるよう
準備をしておこうではないか
column4:
Let's be ready to move 
as soon as the information is delivered.

column3:
盗賊の若い娘が子供と言ってもいい王子の
行方を追っていたと言うわけだね
column4:
So you say the young daughter of a bandit was 
tracking the whereabouts of a prince who 
could be considered a child.

column3:
本当に無事で良かったよ
ああ、自分が年老いてしまった気がするよ
column4:
I really am glad you're okay.
Yeah, I feel like I'm getting old.

column3: 話は聞いたぞ
column4: I heard the story.

column3:
状況としては一進一退と言ったところか
それにしてもネド王子はずいぶんと危険な
土地を進んでいるようだな
column4:
The situation is shifting back and forth, 
but then again, Prince Nedo seems to be moving 
through some very dangerous terrain.

column3:
それほどまでして行かねばならぬ
場所とはいったいどこなのか――
メイロワ将軍は本当に何も知らないのだろうか――
column4:
Where is this place that he has to go to such 
great lengths―― 
Does General Meirova really know nothing about it?

column3:
ここに至り、悪しき竜を倒せば終わるという
単純な話ではなくなってきたようだな
column4:
It seems that now that we're here, 
it's no longer as simple as just slaying the 
Evil Dragon to end the story.

column3: 黒い竜、悪しき竜、黒騎士――
column4: Black Dragon, Evil Dragon, Black Knight...

column3:
我々は傍観者ではいられない
隠し事の気配を感じた時は
多少強気で聞きだしてくれ
column4:
We cannot remain on the sidelines.
If you get a whiff of something being kept from 
us, you're going to have to be a little more 
forceful to get it out of them.

column3: 事情は向こうも理解してくれるだろう
column4: I'm sure they'll understand what's going on.

column3:
何事かを為す者は敵を作りやすい
古今東西、昔も今も、それは変わらんからな
column4:
Those who strive for something are 
apt to make enemies.
That's the way it's always been, 
and that's the way it's always going to be.

column3: 王子のところに急ぐのだ
column4: Hurry to the prince.

column3:
悪しき竜は竜の力を持つ魔物――
道理など期待してはいけない
column4:
The Evil Dragon is a demon with the power of a 
Dragon―― don't expect it to be reasonable.

column3:
もう、ネド王子に任せてみたらどうだろう
別に、悪しき竜についたわけじゃ
ないんだし――
column4:
Why don't we let Prince Nedo take care of it now?
It's not like he's joined the Evil Dragon...

column3: ――というか、ないんだよね？
column4: ――or perhaps not, right?

column3:
うーむ、状況は変わらず
――北の頭目からの連絡待ちだ
column4:
Hmmm, the situation remains the same.
--We're still waiting to hear from 
the Boss of the North.

column3:
静かだと思わない？
これが、嵐の前の静けさってやつかなあ
column4:
Quiet, don't you think? 
I guess this is the calm before the storm.

column3:
強行突破でいいじゃねえか
楽することより、急ぐことを考えようぜ
column4:
Why don't we just force our way through?
Let's think about speed instead of ease.

column3:
こうしている間にも王子はどんどん
先へ行っちゃうんだよね
column4:
And while we're doing this, 
the prince is getting further and further away.

column3:
みんな王子のことばかり話してますけど
火垂れ山に行ったら、悪しき竜が
いるってことですよね？
column4:
Everyone talks about the prince all the time, 
but if we go to Firefall Mountain, that means 
we're going to find the Evil Dragon, right?

column3: なんなら、決戦ってことですよね？
column4:
If you wanted, 
you could call it a decisive battle, right?

column3:
ああ、待たせたね
今しがた、北の頭目から使いが来たところさ
column4:
Oh, sorry to keep you waiting.
I just received a messenger 
from the Northern Boss.

column3:
王子の足取りは――案の定さ
本来の火垂れ山の麓を縫って進む
東の道じゃあなくて、反対の、西へ向かったようだ
column4:
The prince's footsteps, as I suspected, 
were not on the east path that winds through the 
foothills of the volcano, 
but on the opposite path, heading west.

column3:
王子を追跡していた頭目の娘、アーシェの手帳
から、算段したところ――
column4:
I've done the math from the notebook of the 
boss's daughter, Ashe, 
who was tracking the prince...

column3:
なんと王子は王家の墓を目指していることが
わかったんだ
column4:
To my surprise, I found out that the prince was 
heading for The Royal Family Mausoleum.

column3:
まさか王家の墓に火垂れ山へ通じる道が
隠されていたなんてね
墓場での神事が、こと密やかに
執り行われていたのも道理だね
column4:
I never thought that the royal tombs hid a path 
leading to Firefall Mountain.
No wonder the rites at the sepulcher were 
held in such secrecy.

column3:
さあ、王家の墓に行ってみな
探せば、火垂れ山への秘密の道が
見つかるはずだ
column4:
Now, go to The Royal Family Mausoleum. 
If you look hard enough, 
you'll find the secret path to Firefall Mountain.

column3:
もちろん、中に入るには王家の秘蹟が
必要だろうが、王子が先に通ったのなら
道は開けているだろうよ
column4:
Of course, you would need 
the royal sacrament to get in.
But if the prince got there first, 
the passage will be open.

column3:
さあ、そうと分かればぐずぐずしてられないよ
一刻も早くネド王子を無事に連れ帰っておくれ
column4:
Well, now that we know, we can't wait any longer. 
Bring Prince Nedo back safe and sound as 
soon as possible.

column3: ベルタから話は聞いた？
column4: Have you heard from Bertha?

column3:
とりあえず、王家の墓へ行く
向こうで会おう
column4:
For now, I'm going to The Royal Family Mausoleum.
Let's meet over there.

column3:
火垂れ山への道――
入り口を探すんだ
column4:
The path to Firefall Mountain--
Find the entrance.

column3: わしも行くぞ
column4: I'm coming with you.

column3:
王家の墓となれば、その末裔を守るために
英霊たちが我々を導いてくださるだろうよ
column4:
When it comes to the Royal Family Mausoleum, 
I'm sure the Heroic Spirits will guide us 
to protect their descendants!

column3:
王家の墓だとよ
さあ、行こうぜ
column4:
It's the Royal Family Mausoleum.
Come on. Let's go.

column3: 王家の墓――
column4: The Royal Family Mausoleum――

column3:
王子のご先祖たちが眠っているんだよね
ネド王子、どんな気持ちでいるのかな
column4:
The prince's ancestors are sleeping there.
How does Prince Nedo feel about 
that place, I wonder?

column3:
ネド王子には迷いがないんでしょうね
だから、俺たちの心配を知ってるのに
どんどん進むことができる
column4:
I'm sure Prince Nedo doesn't have any doubts, 
so he can move ahead despite knowing 
we're worried about him.

column3: ――厄介な状況ですよね
column4: --This is a tricky situation.

column3:
アーシェは――
娘はどうやらこのまま元気になりそうだ
column4:
Ashe--
My daughter is apparently going to be just fine.

column3:
おまえたちに借りができてしまったが
それはアーシェが持ち帰った情報で
返したということでいいな？
column4:
I owe you guys a debt, but I've repaid you with 
the information Ashe brought back, right?

column3:
貸し借り無しということで
心おきなく、おまえたちの無事を祈ろう
column4:
I'll just say we don't owe each other anything.
I wish you all the best.

column3:
あたしは頭目のセロの娘、アーシェだよ
あんたが助けてくれたんだろ？
column4:
I'm Ashe, daughter of Cyril, the boss.
You saved me, didn't you?

column3:
なんてお礼をしたらいいかわからないよ
こうして話せるし、立てるし――
column4:
I don't know how to thank you enough for giving 
me the ability to talk and stand up like this, and--

column3:
無理せず治せばまた盗賊稼業に戻れるってさ
本当にありがとう
column4:
They said if I take it easy and get better, 
I can go back to being a bandit. 
Thank you so much.

column3:
ここの連中は悪しき竜との戦いで
疲れ切ってるし、ケガ人も多い
盗賊は戦闘が得意なわけじゃあないからな
column4:
The people here are exhausted from fighting the 
Evil Dragon, and many of them are injured.
Thieves aren't exactly the best at fighting.

column3:
アーシェみたいな半人前も単独行動なんて
見ちゃいられないぜ
column4:
I can't stand to see a half-grown woman like 
Ashe acting alone, too.

column3:
だから俺はもう少しここに残ることにしたんだ
お宝の匂いを嗅ぎつけたんなんてことはないぞ？
column4:
That's why I decided to stay a little longer.
It's not like I smelled treasure, you know?

column3: さあ隊長、わしらも行こうか
column4: Come on Captain, let's get going.

column3:
この中のどこかに
火垂れ山へ通じる道があるらしい
column4:
Somewhere in here is a path leading 
to Firefall Mountain.

column3: キサマかっ！　展望城で受けた傷を返してやるわッ！
column4:
Bastard! 
I'll repay you for the wounds I received 
at the Lookout Castle!

column3: メイロワ、最後の願いだ
column4: Meirova, my final wish.

column3:
王子の決意が変わらないのであればせめて――
せめて、そのお姿を見届けたい
column4:
If the prince's resolve remains the same, 
at least - at least - I want to see him.

column3: わしを火垂れ山に連れていってくれ！
column4: Take me to Firefall Mountain!

column3:
麓の道は魔物は多いが、おぬしたちなら開ける
やもしれん
一度城へ戻って仕切り直しだ
column4:
There are many fiends on the road at the foot of 
the mountain, but you may be able to clear it.
一Let's go back to the castle and start over.

column3:
一度城に戻ろうではないか
厳しい道中を乗り切るには準備が必要だ
column4:
一Let's go back to the castle.
We need to be prepared for the hard road ahead.

column3:
王子を追うにも道は断たれてしまった――
山の麓を進むしかないってことか
column4:
The road to follow the prince has been cut off-- 
so we have no choice but to continue 
on through the foothills.

column3:
一度城に戻って準備を整えないと
このままじゃ無理だと思う
column4:
一We need to go back to the castle and get ready.
I don't think we can do it like this.

column3:
な？　結局、俺の言った通りだ
俺たちには強行突破が似合いだぜ
column4:
Right?　After all, I told you so.
We're gonna have to force our way in.

column3:
結局、魔物だらけの山麓を行くんだよね
もしかして王子に意地悪されちゃった！？
column4:
So, we're walking through these 
monster-laden mountains, right? 
Did the prince maybe play a cruel joke on us!?

column3:
王子は何やら立派なことを
言ってましたけど――
column4:
The prince was saying some 
very noble things, but--

column3: そう上手くは行かないですよねえ
column4: It doesn't work that way.

column3:
――おや、王子はどこだい？
王家の墓で会えたんじゃないのかい？
column4:
--Oh, where is the prince? 
Didn't you meet him at 
The Royal Family Mausoleum?

column3: ああ、また王子に先に行かれたんだね
column4: Ah, so the prince got there first again.

column3:
やっぱりどう考えても王子を
ひとりで行かせるわけにはいかないよ
column4:
After all, we can't let the prince go 
alone, no matter what we think.

column3: 俺たちは将軍と一緒に先に行く
column4: We'll go ahead with the general.

column3:
おまえは一度レスタニアに戻って
ジョゼフに伝えてやれ
column4: You go back to Lestania and tell Joseph.

column3:
王子は正気だったってな
まあ、どっちにしても、まだまだ子供だ
本気の子供ってのも厄介だぜ
column4:
I hear the prince was in his right mind.
Well, either way, he's still a kid, 
and real kids are tricky.

column3: わたしはジリアンたちと一緒に行くね
column4: I'll go with Gillian and the others.

column3:
しかしやっぱり王子の意図は
わかりませんよね――
column4:
But I still don't understand 
what the prince was trying to do――

column3:
まさかひとりで竜を倒せると
思っているわけじゃないでしょうし
column4:
It's not like he thinks he can slay 
the Dragon all by himself.

column3: わしは王子を信じることに決めたが――
column4: I've decided to trust in the prince――

column3:
しかしもし万が一――
王子が竜に敗れた時は――
おぬしらが第二の矢としてこの国を救ってくれ
column4:
But if by any chance--
If the prince is defeated by the Dragon...
You'll be the second in line to save this kingdom.

column3: ああ、おぬしらの存在が、なんと心強いことか
column4:
Oh, how reassuring it is to 
have you with us.

column3:
いや、おぬしらの存在なくして
ここまでは来られなかっただろう
ありがたいことだ
column4:
No, we wouldn't have made it this far without you. 
Thank you.

column3:
ゆっくり休んでくれよ
王子の後見人は、わしらよりも
おぬしの方が適任かもしれんな
column4:
Get some rest.
You might be more suitable to the guardianship of 
the prince than we are.

column3:
もう王子に任せたら？
なんて言ったけど、やっぱり不安だね
column4:
Why don't you just let the prince do it?
I know I said that, but I'm still worried.

column3:
だって、どう考えても
年端もいかない少年が竜を倒すなんて
想像がつかないよ
column4:
I mean, it's not like...
I can't imagine a little boy of not much 
age slaying a Dragon.

column3: まだ王子に振り回されているのか――
column4: You're still being pushed around by the prince--

column3:
竜の本拠に乗り込むというのに――
メイロワ将軍の心中、察するに余りあるな
column4:
We're about to ride into the Dragon's stronghold...
I can only imagine what 
General Meirova is going through.

column3: ネド王子の思惑はわからぬ
column4: I don't know what Prince Nedo's intentions are.

column3: しかし――
column4: But--

column3:
王子の考えがどうあれ、竜力の継承相手を
選ぶのは竜だ
column4:
Regardless of what the prince thinks, 
it is the Dragon that chooses who 
inherits the Dragon's power.

column3: 悪しき竜が王子を選ぶだろうか
column4: Would an Evil Dragon choose the prince?

column3: 光明は悪しき竜がまがいものの竜であること
column4:
The ray of hope is that the 
Evil Dragon is a fake Dragon.

column3: 笛の秘策がうまくいくことを祈ろう
column4: Let's hope the flute's mysterious power works.

column3: ひとつ、確認しておきたい
column4: One thing I want to make sure of.

column3:
おまえたちの目的はネド王子の――
謎めいた行動の後押しではない
column4:
Your purpose is not to back Prince Nedo's―― 
enigmatic behavior.

column3:
黒い竜の登場を発端とする悲劇が
このレスタニアに、これ以上及ばぬように
すること
column4:
Ensure that the tragedy that began with the 
appearance of the Black Dragon does not spread 
further, to Lestania.

column3: これに尽きるぞ
column4: It comes down to this.

column3:
利己的だというそしりは甘んじて受けよう
突き詰めると、わたしが守りたいのは
このレスタニアなのだ
column4:
I'll take the accusation of selfishness in stride.
When it comes down to it, 
it is Lestania that I want to protect.

column3:
悪しき竜は黒騎士と同じく
ただの器に過ぎないのかもしれない
column4:
The Evil Dragon, like the Black Knight, 
may be merely a vessel.

column3:
その意志は身体の中になく――
よって、竜力の継承も、自らの意志ではない
column4:
His will is not in his body--
Therefore, the inheritance of Dragon Force 
is not of his own volition.

column3:
我が身にも起こりうるのだろうか
理の外の理には、我が力も、知恵も及ばぬ――
column4:
Is such a fate possible for me? 
My might and insight fail to extend 
beyond the order of this world――

column3: ジョゼフ様の話は聞いたかい？
column4: Did you hear what Master Joseph said?

column3:
