Well, I tried to start cooking, 
but it's just not coming out 
with the right flavor.

column3:
それでさ、もっとおいしい料理を作るために
必要な器具の代わりとなる材料を
持ってきてくれないかな
column4:
So, would you be able to 
bring ingredients to act 
as substitutes for the 
things needed 
to make tastier meals?

column3:
うーんと、うん、まだ足りないかも
ここで戦う解放軍の人たちにも
素敵な料理、なんとか作ってあげたいしね！
column4:
Hmm, well, it seems I might 
still need more. I want 
to prepare some lovely 
meals for the liberation 
army fighting here!

column3:
あー！　これで材料が揃ったみたい！
よし！　ここからはアタシの腕の見せどころだね
column4:
Ah! Looks like I have all the 
ingredients now! Good! Now 
it's my chance to show my 
cooking skills!

column3:
元気が出るおいしーい料理を
山ほど作るぞお！
それで、みんなを笑顔にしてやるんだ！
column4:
I'll whip up a mountain of 
delicious, uplifting dishes! 
Then, I'll make sure everyone 
is smiling!

column3:
<NPC 581>が――
<SPOT 1031>に仕掛けた罠を
見に行くって出て行ったんだけれど
ほんとに大丈夫かな？
column4:
<NPC 581> headed out to check 
the trap placed at <SPOT 1031>. 
I can't help but worry if 
they'll be fine out there?

column3:
ちょっとほっておけないし――
一緒に様子を見に行ってくれないかな？
お願いします――
column4:
I can't just leave this be—
could you join me to see 
how things are going? Please!

column3:
ああ見えて真面目だし――
ちゃんと見に行けるか心配なんだ
<SPOT 1031>で落ち合おう
column4:
They may look laid-back, but they're serious— 
I worry if they'll truly go and see. 
Let's rendezvous at <SPOT 1031>.

column3:
村の人に聞いてみたけど
やっぱり―全然戻ってないみたい――
column4:
I inquired with the villagers, but it appears— 
they haven't come back at all—

column3:
心配であわてて――
アタシ何も持たずに来ちゃった
column4:
I rushed here in a panic,
and didn't bring anything with me.

column3:
罠のある場所を教えるから
探しに行ってくれないかな？
column4:
I'll point out the places with traps, 
so could you go investigate?

column3:
罠のある場所を教えるから
探しに行ってくれないかな？
column4:
I'll point out the places with traps, 
so could you go investigate?

column3:
心配であわてて――
アタシ何も持たずに来ちゃった
column4:
I rushed here in a panic,
and didn't bring anything with me.

column3:
ゴ！　――フグ！　フゴゴ！！
（どうやらパニックになっているようだ）
column4:
Gah! — Fu! Fugo fugo!! 
(It looks like they're in a panic.)

column3:
フガ！　――ゴゴ！！
（どうやら助かったので喜んでいるようだ）
column4:
Fuga! — Gogo!! 
(It appears they are happy to be saved.)

column3:
<NPC 581>が――
無事に見つかってよかった！
もう少しで敵に連れてかれる所だったんだね
column4:
<NPC 581> was found safe and sound! 
I'm glad you made it back! 
You were almost taken by 
the enemy, weren't you?

column3:
あとは自分で戻ってこれると
思うから、アタシ待ってます
手伝ってくれて、ほんとにありがとう！
column4:
I believe I can return by myself, 
so I will wait here. Truly, thank you 
for your assistance!

column3:
あ、隊長！
いいところに来たね！
column4:
Ah, Captain!
You've come to the right place!

column3:
実は、たった今いい作戦を思いついてね
城の兵たち何人かに頼みたいことがあるんだ
column4:
To be honest, I just had a brilliant idea. 
I need to ask a few of the castle guards 
for something.

column3:
でも、この展望城――
城の人間が迷うくらい広くて複雑だからね
人探しも大変なんだ
column4:
However, this Lookout Castle―― 
is so wide and intricate that even 
the castle's residents get lost, 
making it hard to find anyone.

column3:
ボクが作戦を忘れないうちに
急いで探したいんだけど
隊長も手伝ってくれないかな？
column4:
I want to search quickly before I forget the 
strategy; could the captain 
lend a hand as well?

column3:
ありがとう！
やはり、いつだって頼れるのは隊長だけさ！
column4:
Thank you!
After all, you can always count on the captain!

column3:
僕が探している兵たちは――
<STG 451>のどこかにいるはずさ
column4:
The soldiers I'm looking for-- 
they're somewhere in
<STG 451>

column3:
あぁ！　早くしないと
さっき思いついたばかりの作戦を
もう忘れてしまいそうだ！
column4:
Ah! I need to hurry, or I'll forget 
the strategy I just came up with!

column3: 急いで探す
column4: Hurry up and search

column3: ――少し待ってほしい
column4: ... Please wait a moment.

column3:
よし！　早速兵たちを探そう！
どこにいるか分からないから
周囲をよく見ながら探さないとね！
column4:
All right! 
Let's find the soldiers as soon as possible!
We don't know where they are, 
so we have to look around carefully!

column3: さぁ、時間との勝負だ！　隊長！
column4:
Let's go, it's a fight against the clock! 
Captain!

column3:
いやぁ、危うく全部忘れるところだったよ
あんな作戦、もう二度と思いつけないと思ったからね！
ありがとう隊長！
column4:
Wow, I nearly forgot it all! 
I thought I could never devise 
such a strategy again! Thanks, Captain!

column3:
あんな――あれ？
ええっと、確かなんか作戦が――あって
それが――どうとか――
column4:
Oh... what?
Well, there was some kind of a plan...
that... that... was...

column3: 隊長！
column4: Captain!

column3:
安心したら、きれいサッパリ忘れてしまったよ！
こいつはケッサクだね！
column4:
I felt at ease and completely lost it! 
This is quite the marvel, indeed!

column3: あっ
column4: Oh

column3: あっはっ
column4: Ah, ha.

column3: あっはっはっ
column4: Ahahaha!

column3: あっはっはっはっ！
column4: Ahahahaha!

column3:
あれ――隊長――
ボクたち、今なにしてるんだっけ？
column4:
Hey, Captain— 
what exactly are we doing now?

column3:
そもそも、なんで隊長がここに？
おかしいな、まったく思い出せないぞ
column4:
Why is the captain here in the first place?
It's crazy. I can't remember it at all.

column3:
しかたない、一旦キャンプに戻ろう
お気に入りのオブジェを眺めていれば
そのうちきっと思い出すさ！
column4:
It can't be helped; let's return to camp. 
If I admire my favorite object, 
I'll definitely remember it soon!

column3: 隊長！　忘れないうちに早く探そう！
column4:
Captain! 
Let's find them quickly before we forget!

column3: なんとか間に合ったよ！　ありがとう隊長！
column4:
I managed to make it in time! 
Thank you Captain!

column3: やばい――やばいぞ隊長！　記憶が薄れてきた！
column4:
Oh no - this is bad, Captain!　
My memory is fading!

column3: 隊長――どうやら、間に合わなかったようだ――
column4: Captain -- it seems we weren't in time --

column3:
よし、<STG 451>で待ち合わせをしよう！
ボクもすぐに行くよ！
column4:
Great, let's meet at <STG 451>! 
I'll be there shortly!
Ah--

column3:
隊長、ボクの記憶は
ちょっと待てなかったようだ！
column4:
Captain, it looks like my memory 
couldn't hold on for a moment!

column3:
すまないが、また思い出した頃に
よろしく頼んだよ！
column4:
I apologize, but when I remember, 
I'll ask for your help again!

column3:
探してる兵たちは、皆<STG 451>にいるが
どこにいるか分からないから
周囲をよく見ながら探さないとね！
column4:
The soldiers I'm searching for are in 
<STG 451>, but since their location is 
unknown, we need to search the area!

column3:
一歩進めば作戦を１つ忘れてしまいそうだ！
さ、急いで探しに行こう！
column4:
With every step, I feel like I'll forget 
another part of the strategy! 
Let's hurry up and search!

column3:
よし、<STG 451>で待ち合わせをしよう！
ボクもすぐに行くよ！
column4:
Great, let's meet at <STG 451>! 
I'll be there shortly!

column3:
はぁ――妙な作戦だが――
言いたいことはわかった
column4:
Well, it's an odd strategy, but I 
get what you mean.

column3:
まぁ任せとけよ
"見分け方"なら大丈夫だ
column4:
Well, don't worry; I can handle 
the "methods of identification."

column3:
俺たちにとって、大事なのは作戦の内容じゃない
"ソネル様が考えた作戦"っていう
事実だけなんだ
column4:
To us, the crucial part isn't the 
strategy's content, but simply the 
fact that it's "the plan from Ser 
Sonel."

column3:
その事実さえあれば――
俺たちがそれを実行することが
解放軍の勝利へ繋がるんだって
信じられるからな
column4:
If that fact is true— 
we can trust that by carrying it 
out, the Liberation Army will 
achieve victory.

column3:
これはまたすごい作戦ですね
さすがはソネル様！
column4:
This is an incredible plan, 
just as one would expect from Ser Sonel!

column3:
わかりました――
そこら中の、ありとあらゆる"わら"に潜って
かき集めてきます
column4:
Understood— 
I'll sift through all the "straw" 
around here and gather everything up!

column3:
"わら"がたくさんある場所は
いくつか心当たりがありますから
仲間をかき集めて探しますよ
column4:
I know a few spots with plenty of 
"straw," so I'll gather our allies and 
start searching!

column3:
ソネル様の作戦に疑問を持つ兵などおりません
そうやってここまで戦ってきたのですから
column4:
There are no soldiers who question Ser 
Sonel's strategy, for we have come this 
far by following it.

column3: 聞いただけで鳥肌が立ちそうな作戦ですね！
column4:
This plan sounds so intense it gives me 
goosebumps just listening to it!

column3:
ただ私、ちょっとあの見た目が苦手なんです――
でも、なんとかがんばって集めたいと思います！
column4:
I have to admit, that appearance makes me 
uncomfortable, but I'll try my best to collect 
them!

column3:
だだ、だいじょうぶです！
直接見ないようにすれば――
column4:
No, it's okay!
If you don't look directly at it--

column3:
でも、それじゃあ
さすがに危ないでしょうか――
column4:
But is that truly safe, I can't help but 
wonder――

column3: なにやらソネル様の様子が変なんだ
column4: There's something strange about Master Sonel.

column3:
理由を聞いても
「これ以上話すとキミのことから忘れそうだ」
とおっしゃるばかりで、俺にはどうにも――
column4:
I asked for a reason, but they just replied, 
"If I say any more, I may forget you."

column3:
すまないけど、ソネル様の様子を
見てきてもらえないか？
column4:
I apologize, but could you go check 
on Master Sonel's state for me?

column3:
なるほど、そういうことだったのか！
無事に事が済んで良かったよ
column4:
I see, so that's what happened!
I'm glad it all worked out.

column3:
まぁ、作戦については
指示を受けた兵たちがなんとかするだろう
column4:
Well, the soldiers instructed about 
the strategy will manage it somehow.

column3:
あ、隊長じゃないか
もしかして、自分の部屋に
くつろぎに来たのかな？
column4:
Ah, it's the captain! 
Are you perhaps here 
to unwind in your room?

column3:
そうそう――
フカフカの"わら"に飛び込む前に
ちょっと手伝って欲しいことがあるんだ
column4:
Yes, yes— 
before you jump into the 
soft "bed", I need some help.

column3:
"あること"を研究中でね
隊長にも協力してもらえると助かるよ！
column4:
I'm in the midst of researching 
"something." I'd appreciate 
the captain's assistance!

column3:
さすがは隊長だ！
ではさっそく始めたいんだけど
column4:
That's my captain!
Well, I'd like to get started right away.

column3:
ちょっと準備もあるから
先に<SPOT 1093>へ向かってくれないかな 
ボクもすぐに出発するよ！
column4:
I'm busy with some preparations, 
so please head to <SPOT 1093> 
first. I'll be on my way soon!

column3:
隊長！　こっちこっち！
わざわざこんな所まですまないね！
column4:
Captain! This way, this way! 
I apologize for bringing you 
all the way out to such a place!

column3:
実は、"ある計画"を考えてて――
それに使えそうなものを
研究してるんだけどさ
column4:
To tell the truth, I'm working 
on "a specific plan"—and I 
am researching things that 
could be helpful for it.

column3:
いろいろと実験してるうちに
手元にあるのがなくなってしまってね
column4:
As I was conducting several experiments, 
I found myself running out of what I 
had available at hand.

column3:
隊長にも、探すのを手伝って欲しいんだ
この実験が成功すれば
計画も軌道に乗せられる
column4:
I want you to help me look for it too, 
Captain. If this experiment works, the 
plan can get back on track.

column3: それじゃあ、よろしく頼んだよ！
column4: Well then, I'm counting on you!

column3:
う～ん、まだちょっと足りないかな―ー
すまないけど、もう少し探してきて
もらえると助かるよ
column4:
Hmm, I feel it's still not quite enough— 
I'm sorry, but I'd be grateful if you 
could help by searching a bit more.

column3:
よしよし、これだけあれば
なんとかなりそうだ！
column4:
Good, with this much, 
it looks like we should be fine!

column3:
さっそくキャンプに戻って
実験再開だ！
column4:
Let's return to camp right away 
and continue the experiment!

column3:
ありがとう隊長！
遠慮なく、"自分の部屋"で
モフモフしてくれたまえ！
column4:
Thank you, Captain! 
Don't hesitate to get 
cozy in your room!

column3:
あ、隊長！
今、テレパシーを送っていたところさ！
column4:
Ah, Captain!
I was just sending you a telepathic message!

column3:
ちょっと困ったことがあってね
<STG 1001>へ行こうと思うんだ
column4:
There's something troubling me, 
so I'm thinking of going to 
<STG 1001>.

column3:
事が事だからね
隊長にも一緒に来てほしい
column4:
Considering the circumstances, 
I want you to join me too, Captain.

column3:
"ある計画"に必要な情報があってね
それに関わる案件なんだ
<STG 1001> で待ってるよ
column4:
I possess information essential 
for "a certain plan." 
It's related to the matter at hand.
I'll be waiting at <STG 1001>.

column3:
やぁ、待ってたよ、隊長
実はね、ある情報の収集を頼んでいた
友人がいるんだが――
column4:
Hey. I've been waiting, Captain. 
The truth is, I asked a friend to 
gather some information for me—

column3:
彼が昨日から戻って来ないんだ
今まで何の連絡もなしに
予定より遅れることはなかった
column4:
He hasn't come back since yesterday. 
There has never been a delay without 
contacting me before.

column3:
途中で、何かに巻き込まれた可能性が高い――
最後に目撃されたのがこの辺りだと
いうことまでは掴んだんだけど
column4:
It's likely he was caught up in something—
I managed to gather that he was last seen
around this area, but that's about it.

column3:
もしもの時は――
ここで落ち合うことにしてるから
ボクはここに残らないといけない
column4:
If things go wrong, 
this is where we agreed to meet, 
so I must stay here.

column3:
すまないが、隊長は
最後に目撃された場所へ向かって欲しい
column4:
I'm sorry, but I need you to go 
to where the captain was last seen.

column3:
こんなことを頼めるのは隊長しかいないんだ
厄介をかけるけど、頼んだよ
column4:
You're the only one I can rely on for this. 
I know it's a bother, but I'm trusting you.

column3:
もしもの時は――
ここで落ち合うことにしてるから
ボクはここに残らないといけない
column4:
If things go wrong, 
this is where we agreed to meet, 
so I must stay here.

column3:
すまないが、隊長は
最後に目撃された場所へ向かって欲しい
column4:
I'm sorry, but I need you to go 
to where the captain was last seen.

column3:
こんなことを頼めるのは隊長しかいないんだ
厄介をかけるけど、頼んだよ
column4:
You're the only one I can rely on for this. 
I know it's a bother, but I'm trusting you.

column3:
あんたは――？
え、ソネル様の！
そうか、助かった
column4:
Who are you――? 
Oh, you're one of Sonel's! 
Got it, that's a great relief.

column3:
情報を手に入れたはいいが
敵に襲われてこのザマだ――
column4:
I got the information, 
but I was assaulted by enemies, 
and now I'm in this state――

column3:
追っ手が近くまで来ている
奴らをなんとかしてくれ！
column4:
The pursuers are getting close.
Do something about them!

column3:
あんた腕が立つんだな！
さすが、ソネル様が寄越しただけのことはある
驚いたよ
column4:
You're quite skilled!
As expected from someone
sent by Master Sonel; I'm impressed.

column3: 奴らさえなんとかなれば後は一人で大丈夫だ
column4:
If we can handle those foes,
I'll be fine on my own after that.

column3:
ソネル様に「"例の情報"が手に入った」
と伝えてくれ！
俺もすぐ戻る――ありがとよ！
column4:
Inform Master Sonel that "the info"
has been acquired! I'll be back shortly―― thanks!

column3:
そうか、敵の追っ手に――
奴らも相当必死ということか
隊長に頼んで正解だったよ
column4:
I see, the enemies are pursuing us――
they must be quite desperate.
It was wise to ask the captain.

column3:
よし！　彼が持ち帰った情報と
研究中の土が完成すれば
アレの"品種改良"が可能なはずさ
column4:
Alright! Now that we have the information
he brought back and the soil to study,
we should be able to "cultivate" that!

column3:
火薬の爆発に耐える固さと小型化が伴えば
《熟成爆弾カボチャ》を使った
"あの計画"がようやく実現できる！
column4:
Now with its miniaturized form and toughness
to endure explosive gunpowder,
we can finally implement "that plan"
using the "Ripened bomb pumpkin!"

column3:
いやぁ、ありがとう隊長！
おかげで助かったよ！
column4:
Well, thank you captain!
You've been a big help!

column3:
覚者、ちょうどいいところに来てくれた――
緊急の頼みがある
column4:
Arisen, you've come just in time--
I have an urgent favor to ask.

column3:
ついさっきのことだ
俺が留守にしていた時を狙ったのか
この屋敷に空き巣が入ったようだ――
<NPC 691>が目撃したらしい
column4:
It just occurred a little while ago. 
It seems they targeted this place while 
I was away, and a burglar broke in―― 
<NPC 691> reportedly saw it happen.

column3:
奴が言うには、犯人は複数犯らしい
侯爵家の宝なんてものならまだしも、万が一
<NPC 681>の罪の痕跡を持ち出されたら
とんでもないことになる
column4:
He mentioned that there are likely several culprits. 
If they only took the marquis' treasure, 
it wouldn't be as bad, but if they 
expose evidence of <NPC 681>'s wrongdoings, 
there will be severe consequences.

column3:
まだ遠くへは逃げていないはずだ
頼む、犯人捕獲に協力してくれ！
column4:
They should not be too far away yet. 
I beg you, assist me in capturing the 
criminals!

column3:
この<STG 474>に盗みに入るとは
世間知らずの間抜けな泥棒か
何らかの意図を持って犯行に及んだ組織犯か――
column4:
Breaking into <STG 474> means 
either a foolish, ignorant thief or 
an organized crime group acting with 
some ulterior motive.

column3:
とにかく、追わないことには始まらない
用意は良いか？
column4:
Regardless, we must pursue them to 
get started. Are you all set?

column3: はい
column4: Sim

column3: いいえ
column4: Não

column3:
泥棒どもはまだ
そう遠くには逃げていないはずだ
急いで捜索しよう
column4:
The thieves likely haven't 
escaped too far. Let's 
quickly begin the search!

column3:
<NPC 691>が言うには
忍び込んだ奴らは、鎧下姿だったらしい
つまり――今は
鎧を着込んで変装している可能性がある
column4:
<NPC 691> mentioned that the 
intruders were in their 
undergarments. So, they 
might be in armor to hide 
their identities now.

column3:
挙動不審な怪しい兵士が、おそらく犯人だ
逃げられる前に、全員捕まえてくれ――
頼んだぞ
column4:
The soldier acting suspiciously
is likely the one responsible. 
Apprehend them all before they can get away―― 
I trust you to handle it.

column3:
まさか、憲兵隊時代を忘れられない
憲兵どもの犯行だったとはな――
column4:
I never thought I'd still 
remember the Military Police days. 
So, it was their crime after all.

column3:
大方、<NPC 681>の証拠を隠滅して
もう一度返り咲かせるつもりだったのだろう
column4:
Most likely, they aimed to 
destroy the evidence of <NPC 681> 
and rise to power again.

column3:
その行動を<NPC 681>が知らない訳あるまい
全く――なんと抜け目のない狡猾な男なんだ！
牢の中から人を動かすとは――
column4:
It's impossible that <NPC 681> 
is unaware of that action. 
Really—what a sly and crafty man he is! 
To maneuver people from inside a 
prison is quite the feat.

column3:
だが今回は――お前のおかげで阻止できたな
協力、感謝するぜ
column4:
Still, this time—thanks to you, 
we were able to avert it. 
Your assistance is much appreciated.

column3: クソ、間に合わなかったか――
column4: Damn, it seems we were too late—

column3: 捜査は順調か？
column4: How is the investigation progressing?

column3: 間に合ったな――助かったぜ、相棒
column4: We arrived in time—much appreciated, cuz.

column3: まずい、もうあまり時間が無いぞ――
column4: Shit, we don't have much time --

column3: もうダメだ――手遅れだろう
column4: It's no use-- it's probably too late.

column3:
よし
それじゃあ、<STG 461>で落ち合おう
column4:
Okay,
I'll meet you at <STG 461> then.

column3:
そうか――
準備ができたら、声をかけてくれ
あまり時間は無いぞ
column4:
Well--
give me a shout when you're ready
We don't have much time.

column3:
泥棒どもはまだそう遠くへ行っていないはずだ
急いで捜索しよう
column4:
The thieves must not be far away. 
We should quickly start the search.

column3:
<NPC 691>が言うには
忍び込んだ奴らは、鎧下を着ていたらしい
つまり――
鎧を着込んで変装している可能性がある
column4:
<NPC 691> mentions that the intruders 
were wearing under armor. This means— 
they could be disguised in full armor.

column3:
挙動不審な怪しい兵士が、おそらく犯人だ
逃げられる前に、全員捕まえてくれ――
頼んだぞ
column4:
The soldier acting suspiciously
is likely the one responsible. 
Apprehend them all before they can get away―― 
I trust you to handle it.

column3:
泥棒はまだ、そう遠くは行っていないはずだ
<STG 461>を捜査しに行こう
column4:
The thieves shouldn't be too far away.
Let's go investigate <STG 461>.

column3: な、なんでしょうか――？
column4: What is it--?

column3:
ひぃぃぃぃっ！！
すみません、勘弁してください！
column4: Eek! I'm sorry, please spare me!

column3:
先輩に脅されてやったんですぅぅ！
命だけは、勘弁して――
column4:
I was forced to do it by my senior! 
Just spare my life, please!

column3:
ひぃぃぃぃっ！！
すみません、勘弁してください！
column4: Eek! I'm sorry, please spare me!

column3:
先輩に脅されてやったんですぅぅ！
命だけは、勘弁して――
column4:
I was forced to do it by my senior! 
Just spare my life, please!

column3:
<STG 474>？
――あぁ、見た見た
あっちに逃げて行ったよ
column4:
<STG 474>?
――Ah, yes, I saw them.
They ran off in that direction.

column3:
あー、くそ！
だから俺は盗賊の変装して
侵入しようって言ったんだ！
column4:
Ugh, damn it! 
That's why I said we should 
disguise ourselves as thieves!

column3: よりにもよって――覚者に見つかるなんてよぉ！
column4:
Of all things— 
to get caught by an Arisen!

column3:
くそ、だから俺は盗賊の変装して
侵入しようって言ったんだ！
よりにもよって――覚者に見つかるなんてよぉ！
column4:
Damn, that's why I suggested 
disguising as a thief to 
infiltrate! Of all things— 
to be found by an Arisen!

column3:
――――なぜ俺が
盗みに入った犯人だと分かった？
覚者――やはり只者ではなかったか
column4:
—How did you know I was the thief? 
Arisen—you are as remarkable as they say!

column3:
――――なぜ俺が
盗みに入った犯人だと分かった？
覚者――やはり只者ではなかったか
column4:
—How did you know I was the thief? 
Arisen—you are as remarkable as they say!

column3:
あ、あんた――覚者さぁん！！
良いところに来たな！
column4:
A-Arisen!! You!!
You've come to the right place!

column3:
大変なことがあってよぉ
この屋敷に――い、いいやとにかく
メフィスさんに聞いてくれ！
column4:
I've got a big problem.
In this mansion--ahh, well anyway,
Go ask Ser Mephis!

column3:
ホント、いいところに来てくれたよ！
危うく俺が駆り出されるところだっ――
column4:
You've really come to the right place!
I'm in danger of being dragged out...

column3:
――い、いいやとにかく
メフィスさんに聞いてくれ！
大変なことがあったんだよ！
column4:
Yeah, well, anyway.
Go ask Mephis!
I'm in a rough spot!

column3:
よぉ、相棒――
ちょうど良いところに来てくれた
column4:
Yo, cuz.
Just the place to be.

column3:
実は、<NPC 681>の部屋を改装しているんだが
ちょっとばかり、資材が足りなくてな
<STG 636>に質の良いのを手配しているから
取りに行こうと思ってる
column4:
Actually, I'm renovating a room for <NPC 681>
and I'm a little short on materials.
Since I've arranged for <STG 636>
to get some good quality stuff,
I'm going to go get it.

column3: よかったら、付き合ってくれないか？
column4: If you'd like, you can join me.

column3:
ありがとな
戦いでも諜報でもない、こんな雑務に
付き合ってくれて――
column4:
I appreciate you sticking with me 
through this tedious work, 
something that's neither combat nor spycraft――

column3:
それじゃあ、<STG 636>で落ち合おう
待ってるぞ
column4:
Alright then, let's meet at <STG 636>. 
I'll be waiting.

column3: 困ったな――
column4: What a predicament...

column3:
――おお、来たか相棒
迷わず来られたか？
column4:
――Oh, you made it, cuz.
Did you find your way without trouble?

column3:
――実はな
ちょうど資材の採取場辺りで
オークとの戦闘があったようで
搬入が遅れているらしい
column4:
――Actually, 
it seems there was a battle with orcs 
near the resource gathering site, 
so the deliveries are delayed.

column3:
だが――
あれが無いと、改装作業が進まないんだ
column4:
But-- without it,
I can't proceed with the renovations.

column3:
なぁ覚者、もし良かったらでいいんだが――
資材が余っていたら、分けてくれないか？
column4:
Hey, Arisen, if it's alright with you,
can you spare some of your excess supplies?

column3:
ちょうど資材の採取場辺りで
オークとの戦闘があったようで
搬入が遅れているらしい
column4:
It seems there was a battle with orcs 
near the resource gathering site, 
so the deliveries are delayed.

column3:
もし資材が余っていたら
分けてくれると助かるんだが――
column4:
If you have any surplus materials, 
I would appreciate it if you could share them.

column3:
おい、これ――
本当に良いのか？
column4:
Hey, is this--
really a good idea?

column3:
ははっ――これで改装作業が進むぞ
ありがとうな、相棒！
お前のおかげで<STG 474>は生まれ変わるぞ
column4:
Haha――
With this, the renovation work will progress.
Thanks, cuz!
Thanks to you, <STG 474> will be reborn.

column3:
と、言ってもいつになるかは分からんが――
気長に待っててくれよな
column4:
Though I can't say when it'll be―― 
please wait patiently.

column3:
相棒――良い所に来たな！
少し気になることがあってな
column4:
Cuz――We've arrived at a good spot! 
There's something I'm curious about.

column3:
実は、<STG 133>へ資材調達に行った
<NPC 691>の帰りが遅すぎるんだ
アイツのことだ
どこかで道草食っているんだろうが――
column4:
The truth is, someone went to <STG 133>
for materials, and <NPC 691> is really late.
Knowing them,
they must be goofing off somewhere――

column3:
万一のことがあっては困る
一緒に探しに行ってくれないか？
column4:
It would be troubling if something happened.
Could you go look for them with me?

column3: やっぱり、お前は頼りになるよ
column4: I knew I could count on you.

column3:
それじゃあ、出かける準備を済ませてくれ
<STG 461>の入口で落ち合おう
column4:
Well then, please get ready to head out.
Let's meet at the entrance of <STG 461>.

column3: ――来たか
column4: ――So, you have come.

column3:
近くに大きな危険はないはずだから
二手に分かれて捜索しよう
column4:
There shouldn't be any major dangers nearby, 
so let's split into two groups for the search.

column3:
俺はメガド内の<NPC 691>が
よく行く場所を当たってみる
お前は、街の周辺を探してみてくれ
column4:
I'll look for the places in Megado that <NPC 691>
frequents.
You can check the area around the city.

column3:
近くに大きな危険はないはずだから
二手に分かれて捜索しよう
column4:
There shouldn't be any major dangers nearby, 
so let's split into two groups for the search.

column3:
俺はメガド内の<NPC 691>が
よく行く場所を当たってみる
お前は、街の周辺を探してみてくれ
column4:
I'll look for the places in Megado that <NPC 691>
frequents.
You can check the area around the city.

column3: あ、あんたは――覚者さん！？
column4: Oh, you are... the Arisen!?

column3:
絶妙なタイミングで来てくれたな！
メガドの周りにオークの残党が潜んでたみたいで
散歩してたら、
うっかり鉢合わせちまったんだ！
column4:
Wow, you really came at the perfect time!
It seems that there were some leftover orcs
lurking around the area of Megado.
While I was taking a stroll,
I accidentally ran into them!

column3: で、今追いかけまわされてるってワケ――
column4: And now they're chasing after me...!

column3:
って、ホラ！
噂をすればまた来たぞ！
column4:
Look! 
Just like I said, here they come again!

column3:
いやー、助かった――
まさか覚者さん、あんたが来てくれるとはな
まさに、"ヒーロー！"って感じだったぜ
column4:
Wow, you really came to my rescue!
I didn't expect to see you, Arisen. It felt like
something straight out of a heroic tale!

column3: で、なんでここに？
column4: So, why are you here?

column3:
へ――メフィスが？
ひぇ！！
column4:
Huh? Mephis is here?
Whoa!!

column3:
お、俺はちゃんと資材集めてたって！
その――ちょっと足をくじいちまったんで
休んでたんだよ
な、メフィスにそう伝えてくれよ
column4:
Oh, I was actually gathering materials!
But, umm, I twisted my foot...
So I was resting.
C-Can you please tell that to Mephis?

column3: 頼むぜ！
column4: I'm counting on you!

column3:
メガドにはいないようだった――
そっちはどうだ？
column4:
It seems they weren't in Megado...
How about over there?

column3:
なっ――
足をくじいただと？
あのバカ！
column4:
Oh...
Did you sprain your ankle?
You idiot!

column3:
全く、手のかかる奴だな――
だが無事なことは分かって良かったな
column4:
Oh, you are quite a handful...
But I'm glad you're safe.

column3:
手伝ってくれて、助かった
――これに懲りず、また訪ねてくれよ
column4:
Thanks for your help and for your assistance.
--Don't let this stop you from visiting us again!

column3:
北部のオークどもに動きがあったようだ――
お前も戦に備えて準備してくれ
column4:
It seems the Orcs in the north are on the move――
You should prepare for battle as well.

column3:
オークとの戦争がはじまったなら
再度、私の元に訪れてエントリー
しにきてくれ
column4:
If the war with the Orcs has begun,
visit me once again and come to enlist.
I await your arrival.

column3:
グリッテン砦にて戦争が始まるみたいです
レスタニアニュースで確認くださいね
column4:
It looks like the war is starting at Fort Gritten.
Check it out on Lestania News!

column3:
詳しい情報は《中央広場》にいる白衛騎士団の
アランさんをお訪ねください
column4:
For more information, please visit Knight Alan
of the White Guard at the Central Plaza.

column3:
グリッテン砦で戦争が始まるらしいですわ
弟は大丈夫かしら、心配だわ
column4:
I've heard there's a war going on at Fort Gritten.
I hope my brother is ok, I'm worried about him.

column3:
まもなく砦で戦がはじまるって本当ですか！？
あー私も覚者さまのようになって
戦場を駆け抜けてみたいな
column4:
Is it true that a battle will soon
take place at the fortress?
Oh, I want to be like you, Arisen,
and charge into the fray!

column3:
もうすぐグリッテンで戦がはじまるそうだ
戦場ではとにかく気を抜くなよ
column4:
They say the battle will start soon in Gritten.
Don't get distracted on the battlefield.

column3:
オークの奴らめ
何度攻め入ろうとも無駄なこと
次も返り討ちにしてくれる
column4:
Those damned orcs!
No matter how many times they try to invade,
I'll beat them back again.

column3:
ヒルデ姉さんには無理するなといわれているけれど
次の戦で戦果を上げて昇進したいと思っているんだ
column4:
I know sister Hilde told me not to push myself
too hard, but I still want to excel in the next
battle and get promoted.

column3:
戦は稼ぎ時でもあるんだ――
思い切って投資すれば
それだけ得られるものも大きいぞ
column4:
War is a great time to make money...
If you take a risk and invest, you can get a lot
in return.

column3:
グリッテン砦の防衛は
バートランド平原でも重要な任務だ
column4:
The defense of Fort Gritten is also an important
mission in the Betland Plains.

column3:
優秀な戦果を収めたものには
それに応じた報酬も与えられるので
ぜひ防衛隊に参加してくれ
column4:
Those who achieve outstanding results 
will receive appropriate rewards,
so please join the defense force.

column3:
オークどもがついにグリッテン砦に攻めてきたぞ！
覚者は防衛隊に参加し砦を守ってくれ
column4:
Orcs have finally attacked Fort Gritten!
Arisen, join the defenders and protect the fort!

column3:
挑める準備ができてるなら
さっそくミッションエントリーしてみてくれ
column4:
If you're ready to take on the challenge,
participate in the mission right away.

column3:
また自分の成果がどの程度なのかは
神殿内の各所にあるランキングボードを
確認するといい
column4:
You can also check the ranking boards located
throughout the temple to see how well you did.

column3:
ついに開戦したみたいです
気を付けて立派に戦ってきてください
column4:
It looks like the war has finally started.
Take care and go fight honorably!

column3:
詳しい情報はレスタニアニュースを
確認の上、《中央広場》にいる覚者隊の
アランさんをお訪ねください
column4:
For more information, please check
the Lestania News and visit Ser Alan
of the Arisen Corps in the "Central Plaza"!

column3:
覚者さま、弟を戦場で見かけた時は
どうか、そのお力でお守りくださいませ
column4:
Arisen, when you see my brother
out on the battlefield, please, 
use your strength to protect him.

column3:
覚者さま、ついに戦が始まったって聞きました
ご武運をお祈りしていますね！
column4:
Master Arisen, 
I've heard that the battle has finally begun. 
I pray for your good fortune!

column3:
グリッテンの戦況はよく確認して向かうのだ
そうすれば色々見えてくるものもあるだろう
活躍を期待しているぞ
column4:
Make sure to assess the conditions
in Gritten before you go.
It will provide you with valuable insights. 
I expect great things from you.

column3:
オーク相手に情けは無用だ
魔物もろとも斬り捨ててくれる
column4:
Show no mercy to the orcs.
Cut them down along with the monsters.

column3:
君、強そうだね
僕の隊で一緒に戦ってくれよ
column4:
You seem strong.
Fight alongside me in my squad.

column3:
凶悪な魔物は討伐評価も高くなる
倒せる自信があるなら
強敵との遭遇は幸運と捉えるべきだな
column4:
Powerful demons have a higher subjugation rate.
If you're confident you can defeat them,
look upon the encounter with those
formidable foes as a stroke of good luck.

column3:
この戦いで戦果をあげることによって
バートランド平原のエリアポイントも
得ることができる
column4:
By securing victories in this fight, 
you'll also obtain area points for 
the Betland Plains.

column3: 頑張って奮戦してくれ
column4: Please fight bravely and do your best.

column3:
何とか砦を守り切れたな
今は各位の戦果を確認中だ
column4:
We were somehow able to defend the fort.
We are currently confirming each person's
contribution.

column3:
報酬は後に与えられる
確認が終わるまで待っていてくれ
column4:
The rewards will be given later.
Please wait until the confirmation is complete.

column3: オーク軍を退けることができたみたいですね
column4: It seems that we were able to repel the Orc army.

column3:
グリッテンの戦も落ち着いたようですわね
弟も無事でなによりです
column4:
It seems that the battle in Gritten
has also settled down. It is a relief
that my younger brother is safe.

column3:
お怪我はありませんか！？
覚者さまやみんなのおかげで敵を撃退できたこと
すごくうれしく思います――
column4:
Are you injured!?
Thanks to the Arisen and everyone's efforts,
we were able to repel the enemy.
I am ever grateful――

column3:
敵を撃退できて何よりだ
戦場を共にに切り抜けた仲間と
肩を並べて飲む一杯は格別だ！
column4:
I'm glad we were able to fight off the enemy!
It's a special thing to drink a cup of wine
shoulder-to-shoulder with new friends
who've made it through the battlefield together!

column3:
よく頑張ってくれた
皆のおかげで撃退できたのだ
感謝する
column4:
You did well and worked hard.
We were able to repel the enemy
thanks to everyone.
I am grateful.

column3:
はぁーなんとか無事だったけれど
活躍どころじゃなかったよ
column4:
Ah, I managed to make it through safely,
but I didn't really have a chance to shine.

column3:
俺がコツコツ稼いだところで
強い奴等は一度の戦いで
1年分は稼いでいっちまうんだ
column4:
Even if I diligently earn little by little,
the strong ones can earn a year's worth
in just one battle.

column3:
どうだ、戦果は期待できそうか？
俺の活躍も副隊長の目にとまってくれていると
いいんだが――
column4:
What do you think?
I hope my successes have also caught
the attention of the Vice Captain.

column3:
グリッテン砦防衛の功績に対し報酬が出ているぞ
各位、保管ボックスより受け取ってくれ
column4:
A reward is available for your achievements
in defending Fort Gritten.
Please collect it from the Storage Box.

column3:
防衛隊に参加してくれたものだな
こたびの協力に感謝する――
報酬を受け取ってくれ
column4:
It seems you joined the defense force.
We appreciate your assistance this time.
Please accept your rewards.

column3:
戦果に応じた報酬が出ているみたいです
レスタニアニュースにて確認くださいね
column4:
It looks like rewards are provided 
according to the battle results. 
Check Lestania News for details.

column3:
先の戦いで功績のあった方には報酬が
出たそうですわ――
column4:
I heard that there was a reward for those
who made a difference in the last battle!

column3:
でも私にとっては弟の元気な姿が
何よりの報酬です
column4:
But for me, the best reward is to see
my brother in good health.

column3:
戦場で活躍したみんなに報酬が
出たみたいですね
column4:
It seems that everyone who performed well
on the battlefield received a reward!

column3:
私もいつか、みなさんの隣りで
活躍できたらなって思うんです
column4:
I dream of being able to contribute
alongside everyone one day.

column3:
先の戦いで手柄に応じた報酬が出た
という話だ
column4:
I heard that rewards were given for your
achievements in the previous battle.

column3:
教官である今の俺にとっては、お前の活躍と
全身に刻み込まれた古傷が一番の誇りよ
column4:
For me, as your mentor, your success
is most important to me.
Furthermore, the litany of ancient scars
on one's body brings me great pride.

column3:
こたびの戦いの戦果に応じた報酬を配布中だ
防衛に参加してくれた全ての者は受け取ってくれ
column4:
We are currently distributing rewards based on
the results of the battle.
Please make sure to claim your rewards if you
participated in the defense.

column3:
報酬は出たけれど、これじゃぁまだ姉さんに
報告するわけにはいかないなぁ
column4:
I got the reward, but this isn't enough 
to report back to my sister yet.

column3:
いくら稼いだんだ？
俺にも少しくらい分けてくれよ
column4:
How much did you earn?
You gotta share some of that with me.

column3:
報酬はもう受け取ったのか？
お前の活躍、嬉しいんだけど副隊長の注目が
集まると思うと複雑なんだよなぁ――
column4:
Have you already received your rewards?
I'm happy about your achievements,
but I can't help feeling conflicted when

column3:
今回もまた船が派手に壊れちゃったなぁ
さっそく修理に必要な見積もりを出さなくちゃ
column4:
Once again, the ship has been spectacularly
destroyed. I need to promptly request an estimate
for repairs.

column3:
船が無事に帰ってきてうれしいです
いったいどんな冒険が繰り広げられたのでしょうか？
column4:
I am glad the ship returned safely.
I wonder what kind of adventure unfolded there?

column3:
ああ、今回の取り分は送っておいたぞ！
保管ボックスから確認してくれ
column4:
Ah, I've already sent your share for this time!
Please check it from the Storage Box.

column3:
あそこはとんでもなく危険なのにまた行きたくなる
そうだろう？　覚者よ！
column4:
It's a terribly dangerous place there, isn't it?
Yet you still want to go there, Arisen?

column3:
また次の航海を思い描けば船の修理にも
自ずと精が出るというものだ！
がはははは！
column4:
Just imagining the next voyage brings vigor to
the ship repairs as well!
It's natural for spirits to rise, isn't it?
Hahaha!

column3:
おぅ、丁度、戦果の集計がついたとこだ
これはあんたの報酬だ、受け取りな
column4:
Oh, just in time. The results of the battle have
been tallied. This is your reward. Take it.

column3: 覚者さまのお名前も載っていると良いですね
column4:
It would be nice to have the name of the Arisen
included as well.

column3:
ゼルキンさんからのお知らせが
レスタニアニュースに載っています
column4:
There is an announcement from Zerkin in the
Lestania News.

column3:
あんた、ドラゴンや魔物はどうだった！？
今度一杯ご馳走するから
ゆっくり話を聞かせてくれよな
column4:
How were the dragons and monsters?!
I'll treat you to a drink next time, so take your
time and tell me your story.

column3:
船長は手に入れた報酬を
毎回、次の航海の資金にしている
column4:
The captain uses the rewards obtained
each time as funds for the next voyage.

column3:
ほんとあきれるけど
その情熱には感服するよ
column4: It's truly astounding, but I admire that passion.

column3: 海と冒険と竜との戦い、ロマンですよね――
column4:
The sea, adventure, and battles with dragons,
it's all so romantic, isn't it?

column3: 勇敢なる覚者よ、竜族を狙うのだ！
column4: Brave Arisen, aim for the Dragonkin!

column3: さすれば大物、エルダードラゴンをおびき出せるはずだ！
column4:
If we do that, we should be able to lure out a
formidable creature, the Elder Dragon!

column3: 《時番》を発見したら優先的に討伐するのだ！
column4:
When you find a "Time Bonus" enemy, prioritize
defeating it!

column3: 奴らを倒せば残り時間が延長されるぞ
column4: Defeating them will extend the remaining time!

column3: おお！　ついにエルダードラゴンのお出ましだ！
column4:
Oh! The Elder Dragon has finally made an
appearance!

column3: 覚者たちよ、戦果を目指すなら討伐だ！
column4:
Arisen, if you aim for achievements in battle,
focus on defeating it!

column3: 勇敢なる覚者よ、竜族を狙うのだ！
column4: Brave Arisen, aim for the Dragonkin!

column3: さすれば大物、エルダードラゴンをおびき出せるはずだ！
column4:
If we do that, we should be able to lure out a
formidable creature, the Elder Dragon!

column3: 《時番》を発見したら優先的に討伐するのだ！
column4:
When you find a "Time Bonus" enemy, prioritize
defeating it!

column3: 奴らを倒せば残り時間が延長されるぞ
column4: Defeating them will extend the remaining time!

column3: おお！　ついにエルダードラゴンのお出ましだ！
column4:
Oh! The Elder Dragon has finally made an
appearance!

column3: 覚者たちよ、戦果を目指すなら討伐だ！
column4:
Arisen, if you aim for achievements in battle,
focus on defeating it!

column3: 3種の宝石を集めると、より強大な竜が現れるという噂だ
column4:
Rumor has it that when you collect three types of
Gems, a more powerful dragon will appear.

column3: さらなる大物を狙うならば、挑戦するがいい！
column4: If you want to go even bigger, go for it!

column3:
噂の大物が現れたぞ！
《エルダードラゴン・ブレイズ》のおでましだ！
column4:
The rumored big fish has appeared! It's the Elder
Dragon Blaze!

column3: 討伐できれば戦功をはずむぞ！
column4: If we can subdue them, it will earn us War Merit!

column3: 勇敢なる覚者よ、竜族を狙うのだ！
column4: Brave Arisen, aim for the Dragonkin!

column3: さすれば大物、エルダードラゴンをおびき出せるはずだ！
column4:
If we do that, we should be able to lure out a
formidable creature, the Elder Dragon!

column3: 《時番》を発見したら優先的に討伐するのだ！
column4:
When you find a "Time Bonus" enemy, prioritize
defeating it!

column3: 奴らを倒せば残り時間が延長されるぞ
column4: Defeating them will extend the remaining time!

column3: おお！　ついにエルダードラゴンのお出ましだ！
column4:
Oh! The Elder Dragon has finally made an
appearance!

column3: 覚者たちよ、戦果を目指すなら討伐だ！
column4:
Arisen, if you aim for achievements in battle,
focus on defeating it!

column3:
南の森で恐ろしい魔物を見たという
噂が広がっている
column4:
People have been talking about seeing a terrible
monster in the southern forests.

column3:
まもなく討伐が開始されるだろう――
おまえも参加するならば
準備しておくといい――
column4:
The hunt will begin shortly.
If you're joining in too, be prepared...

column3:
討伐が開始されたなら
再度、私の元に訪れてエントリー
しにきてくれ
column4:
If the hunt has begun, visit me once again and
come to enlist.
I await your arrival.

column3:
ローガンさんが討伐準備をしている魔物は
異界を渡る力を持つそうです
column4:
The monster that ser Logan is preparing to subdue
seems to have the power to travel through
different realms.

column3:
多くの覚者さまの力が必要になるため
是非協力してあげて下さいね
column4:
We will need the power of many Arisen for this,
so please lend us your assistance.

column3:
詳しい情報は
《商店区》にある白衛騎士団の詰所にいる
ローガンさんをお訪ねください
column4:
For more information, please visit Ser Logan at
the White Knights' Headquarters in the Shopping
District.

column3:
そういえば、《古の祭祀場》に
強い竜力の淀みが発生していることは
知っている？
column4:
By the way, do you know that there is Dragon
Force accumulating in the "Ancient Place of
Rituals"?

column3:
オールドグロウエントか、それより
もっと恐ろしい何かか――
column4:
Old Grove Ent?
Or something even more terrifying?

column3:
白衛騎士団も確認に動いているそうよ
神殿の騎士団本部にも
情報を取りに行ってみて
column4:
The White Knights are also working to confirm
this.
You can also go to the Knights Headquarters in
the Temple to get more information.

column3:
対峙した者の話によれば
相手はケタ違いの化け物らしい
column4:
According to those who have confronted it, the
opponent is a monster of a totally different
level.

column3:
命を落とすことのないよう
十分気をつけて戦ってくれ
column4:
Please fight with utmost care, so that you do not
lose your life.

column3:
挑める準備ができてるなら
さっそくミッションエントリーしてみてくれ
column4:
If you're ready to take on the challenge,
participate in the mission right away.

column3:
また自分の成果がどの程度なのかは
神殿内の各所にあるランキングボードを
確認するといい
column4:
You can also check the ranking boards located
throughout the temple to see how well you did.

column3:
ローガンさんが討伐隊を
動かし始めたみたいです
column4:
It seems that Ser Logan has started preparing for
a hunt.

column3:
詳しい情報はレスタニアニュースを確認の上
《商店区》にある白衛騎士団の詰所にいる
ローガンさんをお訪ねください
column4:
For more information, please check the Lestania
News and visit Ser Logan at the White Knights'
Headquarters in the "Shopping District".

column3:
《古の祭祀場》に、恐ろしい魔物が
姿を現したの！
いつものエントなど比較にならない
強大な魔物よ
column4:
A terrible monster has appeared in the Ancient
Place of Rituals!
It's a mighty monster that can't be compared to
the usual Ent...

column3:
今、神殿の騎士団本部が中心となって
討伐隊を組織しているわ
column4:
Right now the headquarters of the Temple Knight
Order is leading the way in organizing a hunting
party.

column3:
貴方もぜひ力を貸して！
このミスリウのためにも――
column4:
Please lend your strength as well!
For the sake of Mysree, too...

column3:
討伐に参加してくれた
多くの勇気ある戦士達のおかげで
あの化け物を退けることができた
column4:
Thanks to the brave soldiers who participated in
the subjugation, we were able to repel that
monster.

column3: 心から礼を言わせてもらうよ
column4: I want to thank you from the bottom of my heart.

column3:
森に現れた魔物を
退けることができたそうです
column4:
We hear that they were able to repel the monster
that appeared in the forest.

column3:
レスタニアニュースでも
取り上げられていますよ
column4: It has also been featured in Lestania News.

column3:
先の森の
魔物討伐における報酬を支給している
column4:
The reward for the forest monsters hunt is
currently being distributed.

column3:
まだのものは
保管ボックスから受け取ってくれ
column4:
Please retrieve the items that are still in the
storage box.

column3:
先の戦闘評価が終わっている――
報酬を支給するので受け取ってくれ
column4:
The previous combat evaluation has ended. Please
collect the reward.

column3: 先の魔物討伐の戦果が発表されています
column4:
The outcome of the previous enemy subjugation has
been announced.

column3:
報酬も支給されていますので
レスタニアニュースにて確認くださいね
column4:
Rewards are also being paid, so please check it
out on Lestania News!

column3: 永遠不変をうそぶく厚顔なる白竜と覚者よ――
column4:
Oh, the arrogant white dragon, who claims to be
eternal—, and you, Arisen――

column3:
永遠なるは我が輝き、不変なるは我が志し――
思い知るがよい――
column4:
My radiance is eternal, my determination
unwavering. You shall come to know this.

column3:
うつろう世にしがみつく
哀れなる白竜と覚者よ――
column4:
Oh pitiful White Dragon and Arisen, clinging to
this fleeting world...

column3:
白がくすみ人が絶えても我が輝きは不滅――
この黄金こそが永遠の象徴――
column4:
Even if the white fades and people disappear, my
brilliance is everlasting.
This gold is a symbol of eternity.

column3: 世界は我が物と信じて疑わぬ白竜と覚者よ――
column4:
O, white dragon who believes the world is theirs
without doubt, and you, Arisen――

column3:
教えてやろう
貴様らが信じる理のもろさを――
column4:
Allow me to show you the fragility of the world
order you believe in.

column3:
伝説で語り継がれた黄金に輝く竜が
空で待っているそうだ
column4:
It is said that a legendary dragon, shining with
golden light, awaits in the sky.

column3:
相手は想像を絶する化け物だ
今から準備をはじめておくといい――
column4:
The enemy is an unimaginable monster.
It's best to start preparing now--

column3:
討伐が開始されたなら
再度、私の元に訪れてエントリー
しにきてくれ
column4:
If the hunt has begun, visit me once again and
come to enlist.
I await your arrival.

column3: 黄金の竜の討伐準備が進んでいます
column4:
Preparations for the defeat of the Golden Dragon
are underway.

column3:
一匹の魔物の討伐とは思えない
大部隊による長期戦になるそうです
column4:
It doesn't seem it'll be like defeating a single
monster.
It appears it will be a long-term battle waged by
a large force.

column3:
それでも――
伝説の竜を打ち倒すことなんて
できるのでしょうか
column4:
Even so...
Is it possible to strike down the legendary
dragon?

column3:
詳しい情報は《商店区》の
海辺の見える竜の礎前にいる
ハンコックさんをお訪ねください
column4:
For more information, please visit Mr. Hancock in
the Shopping District near the Dragon's Portcrystal
with a view of the seashore.

column3: いよいよ生ける伝説、黄金竜との決戦だ
column4:
It's finally the decisive battle with the living
legend, the Golden Dragon.

column3:
この戦いは奴が倒れるまで戦いは引き継がれる
最後まであきらるな
column4:
This battle will not be over until they are
defeated.
We must not give up, no matter how long it takes.

column3:
挑める準備ができてるなら
さっそくミッションエントリーしてみてくれ
column4:
If you're ready to take on the challenge,
participate in the mission right away.

column3:
また自分の成果がどの程度なのかは
神殿内の各所にあるランキングボードを
確認するといい
column4:
You can also check the ranking boards located
throughout the temple to see how well you did.

column3:
黄金の竜の討伐遠征が
始まっています
column4:
The expedition to defeat the Golden Dragon has
begun.

column3:
詳しい情報はレスタニアニュースを確認の上
《商店区》の海辺の見える竜の礎前にいる
ハンコックさんをお訪ねください
column4:
For more information, please check Lestania News
and visit ser Hancock in the Shopping District
near the Dragon's Portcrystal with a view of the
seashore.

column3: 戦果の報告をまとめているところだ
column4:
I'm in the process of summarizing the results of
the battle.

column3:
報酬はその後支給するので
待っていてくれ
column4:
The reward will be distributed afterwards, please
wait.

column3: 遠征が終わったようですね
column4: It seems that the expedition has come to an end.

column3: 本当にあの黄金の竜を倒せたのでしょうか――
column4: Did we really manage to defeat the Golden Dragon?

column3:
先の黄金竜討伐に対する
報酬を支給中だ
column4:
Rewards for the recent defeat of the Golden
Dragon are now being distributed.

column3: 保管ボックスより受け取ってくれ
column4: Please retrieve it from the Storage Box.

column3:
黄金竜討伐の戦果に対する
報酬を支給する
column4:
The reward for the successful elimination of the
Golden Dragon.

column3: 協力に感謝する――ありがとう
column4: We appreciate your cooperation. Thank you.

column3:
先の遠征における戦果が
発表されています
column4:
The results of the recent expedition have been
published.

column3:
報酬も支給されていますので
レスタニアニュースより確認くださいね
column4:
Rewards are being paid, so please check it out in
Lestania News!

column3: 完全なる者たちは何処に――
column4: Where are the perfect ones...

column3:
我に完全を与える主よ――
ここにはいないのか――
column4:
O Lord, grant me perfection—
Is it not here—

column3:
戦いは永遠を知る方便――
空しさなど覚えるものか――
column4:
Battle is the means to know eternity――
Why remember emptiness――

column3:
私の予感だが、ほどなくレスタニアに
暗雲が立ち込めようとしている
column4:
I have a feeling that soon, a dark cloud will
loom over Lestania.

column3:
これは凶悪な魔物があらわれる前兆だ
気をつけるといい
column4:
This is an omen of the coming of a vicious demon.
Be careful.

column3:
魔物が姿を現したならば
再度、私の元を訪れて
討伐隊への参加を期待しているぞ
column4:
If the monsters show themselves, I hope you'll
visit me again and join the hunt team!

column3:
レスタニアで恐ろしい気配を感じたという
噂が流れています
column4:
Rumors are circulating of a frightening presence
in Lestania.

column3:
詳しい情報は
《商店区》にいるコーネリアさんを
お訪ねください
column4:
For more information, please visit ser Cornelia
in the "Shopping District"

column3:
つい最近、レスタニアで
恐ろしい魔物の気配を感じたという
報告が舞い込んできたのだ
column4:
We have recently received reports of a terrifying
demonic presence in Lestania.

column3:
恐るべき魔力の息吹を持つという噂もある
十分に気を付けるといい
column4:
There are rumors that it possesses a breath of
fearsome magical power. It would be wise to be
extremely cautious.

column3:
挑める準備と覚悟ができたなら
さっそく討伐隊に参加してくれ
ファビオ様は重大な用ゆえ
私が窓口を任されている
column4:
If you are prepared and ready for the challenge,
please join the hunting party right away.
Lord Fabio has urgent matters to attend to, so I
have been entrusted with handling the
arrangements.

column3:
また自分の成果がどれほどなのかは
神殿内の各所にあるランキングボードを
確認するといい
column4:
Also, you should check the ranking boards located
throughout the Temple to see how well you did.

column3:
恐るべき異界の魔物の気配が
確認されているそうです
column4:
It seems that the presence of fearsome enemy
creatures from the Other World has been confirmed.

column3:
詳しい情報はレスタニアニュースを確認の上
《商店区》にいるコーネリアさんを
お訪ねください
column4:
For detailed information, please check Lestania
News, then visit Ms. Cornelia in the Commercial
District.

column3:
何とか退けることができたようだな
さすがだ、覚者よ
column4:
It seems that you were able to somehow fend it
off. Truly impressive, Arisen.

column3:
戦果を集計しているところだ
報酬支給はもう少し時間をくれ
column4:
We are currently tallying the results of the
battle. Please give us a little more time for
reward distribution.

column3:
ただいま魔物と交戦した方々の戦果を
集計しています
column4:
We are currently calculating the results of those
who have fought monsters just now.

column3: 発表まで今しばらくお待ちください
column4:
Please wait a little longer until the
announcement.

column3:
魔物討伐の報酬が支給されている
保管ボックスより受け取ってくれ
column4:
The reward for defeating the enemies has been
paid. Please accept it from the Storage Box.

column3:
先の戦闘評価が終わっている
報酬を支給するので受け取ってくれ
column4:
The previous combat evaluation has ended. Please
collect the reward.

column3: 先の魔物討伐の戦果が発表されています
column4:
The outcome of the previous enemy subjugation has
been announced.

column3:
報酬も支給されていますので、
レスタニアニュースにて確認くださいね
column4:
Rewards are also being paid, so please check it
out on Lestania News!

column3: オマイラ――覚えとけよ！
column4: You all―― remember this!

column3: おいおい――調子にのるなって
column4: Hey hey, don't get carried away.

column3: 腐ってもやっぱり覚者か！？
column4:
Even if you're rotten, you're still an Arisen,
huh!?

column3:
２つ以上のミッションには
エントリーできないぞ
column4: You can't enter more than one mission!

column3:
先にエントリーしている方のミッションを
終わらせるか、エントリーを取り消して
再度こちらに来るんだ
column4:
Either finish the mission you've already entered,
or cancel your entry, then come back again.

column3:
ボルド大坑道へ調査にいったゲルト団長から
緊急指令が届いているんだ
column4:
I've got an urgent order from Commander Gerd, who
went to the Volden Large Tunnels to investigate.

column3:
準備を整えたら、ミッションエントリーをしてくれ
俺も共に向かうぞ
column4:
Once you're ready, please enter the mission.
I will also join you.

column3:
――先のミッションで物凄い戦果を
挙げたそうだな
column4:
I heard you achieved an amazing victory in the
previous mission.

column3:
特別なアビリティを与えるよう言われている
ふん――役に立つと良いがな
column4:
I've been told to give you a special Augment.
Well, I hope it proves useful.

column3:
ボルド大坑道でのミッション、ご苦労だったな
――助かった、礼をいう
column4:
Thank you for your hard work on the Volden Large
Tunnels mission. I am grateful for your help.

column3:
戦果についての確認が終わり次第
保管ボックスにて報酬を受け取れるようになる
受け取りを忘れるなよ
column4:
After the results have been confirmed, you will
be able to receive your reward in the Storage Box.
Don't forget to pick it up.

column3: 魔赤島にアルタード・ズールが現れた
column4: An Altered Zuhl has appeared on Bloodbane Isle.

column3:
こんなことを覚者に頼むのも癪だが――
かなり切迫した状況だ
column4:
Even though it pains me to have to burden the
Arisen with this, it's a very desperate situation.

column3:
駐屯地が危険にさらされている――
すぐに準備を整え、ミッションエントリーを
して欲しい
――食い止めてくれ
column4:
The garrison is in danger!
Get ready immediately and register for the
mission.
Stop the enemy!

column3:
――貴君は他のミッションの元に
パーティを組んでいるな
column4: You are part of a party for another mission.

column3:
先にそちらのミッションの参加予定を
取り消し、あらためてここに来てくれ
column4:
Please cancel your participation in the mission
over there first, and then come here again.

column3:
今回も何とか魔物を退けたな
――我々への協力、感謝する
column4:
Once again, we managed to drive away the monsters.
Thank you for your cooperation.

column3:
ミッションの戦果が発表された者から
保管ボックスより順次報酬を渡すぞ
column4:
We'll distribute rewards sequentially from the
storage box to those whose mission achievements
have been announced.

column3:
先の戦いについて
多くの戦果を挙げた貴君に対して
特別なアビリティが送られることになった
column4:
As a reward for your many accomplishments in the
previous battle, you will receive special
Augments.

column3: ぜひ受け取ってくれ――
column4: Please accept it with gratitude--

column3:
"シェドレアン大神殿"での問題を
解決してくれたみたいね！
アデルドナハからも、礼をいっておいてくれと
言われたよ――
column4:
It seems like you solved the problem at the
Shadolean Great Temple!
Adair Donnchadh told me to thank you...

column3:
今は戦果の分析中だから
もうしばらく待っていてちょうだい
column4:
I'm in the process of analyzing the war results,
so you'll have to wait a while longer.

column3:
今回のミッションでは物凄いはたらきを
してくれたみたいね！
column4: You did a tremendous job on this mission!

column3:
戦果の報酬として、シークレットアビリティが
付与されるよ
受け取ってちょうだい
column4:
As a reward for your battle results, you will
receive a Secret Augment.
Please take it!

column3:
ダクレイム砦でのウォーミッションは終了した
現在、各個人の戦果を確認しているところだ
column4:
The war mission at Dacreim Fortress has ended.
We are currently checking each individual's
achievements.

column3: 集計が終わるまで、しばらくの間待っていてほしい
column4:
I hope you'll wait a while for the tally to be
completed.

column3:
あんたの持っているDPと引き換えに
品物を提供しよう
ラインナップを確認してみてくれ
column4:
In exchange for the DP you possess, I shall offer
you goods.
Please take a look at the lineup.

column3:
一部のアイテムには、条件を満たした者にしか
与えられない特別なアイテムが存在する
column4:
There are special items that can only be given to
those who meet the requirements.

column3:
戦いにおいて、どれだけの成果を達成したかにより
提供できるアイテムも変わってくるぞ
column4:
The items that can be obtained through battle
depend on the achievements made.

結婚を約束していた彼女が姿を消してからもう半年
僕の心はまだ癒えず、思い出の場所であるあの草原に
昨日も出向いてたんです
そしたらふと、丘の向こうから何か声が聞こえて――
あれは魔物の唸り声だったのか、それとも――
いえ、僕の妄想だってことぐらいわかっているんです
column4:
Já se passaram seis meses desde que ela,
com quem eu havia prometido me casar, desapareceu.
Meu coração ainda não está curado,
então fui àquela campina, um lugar de lembranças.
Ontem, fui lá novamente,
E então, de repente,
ouvi uma voz vindo de além da colina--

Era o rosnado de um monstro, ou...
Não, eu sei que é apenas minha imaginação.

多くを望まず、日々祈りを欠かさず――
それなのに、この３日だけで６回ですよ！
魔物の影に追われ、声に怯え、気配に身を竦ませ――
いったい私たちがどんな罪を犯したのですか！
もうこの地に留まる事はできません
column4:
Até agora, toda a família viveu humildemente,
sem desejar muito e sem deixar de orar diariamente.
Mas, só nestes três dias, seis vezes!
Perseguidos pelas sombras dos monstros,
aterrorizados pelos sons, tremendo a cada presença—
que pecado cometemos?
Não podemos mais ficar neste lugar.

Toda vez que é minha vez, vejo sombras estranhas
ou ouço ruídos estranhos no caminho de volta.
Outro dia,
disseram que um viajante foi atacado por monstros.
Esse tipo de trabalho deveria ser feito
por alguém mais forte.

深く立ち入らなければ安全だろうと思っていたら
奥の方から唸り声みたいなものが聞こえて――
だんだん近づいて来たんだ
驚いて、思わず外へ飛び出しちまったよ
column4:

tive que me abrigar no subsolo.
Pensei que estaria seguro se não fosse muito fundo,
mas ouvi um rosnado vindo de dentro――
foi se aproximando cada vez mais.
Assustado, acabei correndo para fora.

私ほどの音楽家となると
曲作りのインスピレーションを求める貪欲さが違う
魔物たちの咆哮こそ、創作の糧としてふさわしい
生命のうねり、暴虐のこだま、絶望の響き！
さあ、今日もあの魔窟へ出かけるとしよう
妙なる調べのためなら、この命捧げようとも！
column4:
Para um músico como eu,
a fome por inspiração para compor é diferente.
Os rugidos dos monstros são a matéria-prima perfeita
para a criação.
O pulsar da vida, o eco da violência, o som do desespero!
Hoje, partirei novamente para aquela caverna maldita.
Pela melodia divina, entregaria minha vida!

数十年騎士をやっていれば、目や耳よりも
はっきりと解る
だがその精度も、ここのところめっきり落ちた
いまもやつらを近くに感じているが、これを信用して

column4:
A dor nas antigas feridas é sinal
de que eles estão se aproximando.
Após décadas como cavaleiro,
consigo sentir isso melhor que olhos ou ouvidos.
Mas ultimamente essa sensibilidade tem caído.
Sinto que estão perto, mas será que posso confiar nisso?
Talvez seja hora de considerar a aposentadoria.

column4:

à beira-mar e resolvi falar com ela.

ser atacada por verdadeiros bandidos.

やむなく海岸にある廃船で休もうとしたんです

「そこに入るな、危ないぞ！」って――
何か大切なものでも隠してるんですかね？
それともまだあの船、使うつもりなんでしょうか
column4:
Fiquei sem dinheiro e não pude
me hospedar, então tentei descansar
num navio abandonado na costa.
Mas um homem desesperado veio
e gritou: “Não entre aí, é perigoso!”...
Será que esconde algo valioso?
Ou ainda pretende usar aquele navio?

Se eu não estivesse ferido,

teve sorte.

Lugares assim, prefiro ter só para mim.

a serviço do Dragão Branco.

見わたしたりと落ち着きがない様子でな
いったいあれは、何をしておったんじゃろうの
column4:
Perto da costa, cruzei com uma mulher.
Ia chamá-la, mas parecia procurar algo,
olhando ao redor dos pés
e depois para além do horizonte.
Parecia inquieta... o que será
que estava fazendo?

いや、なんでもない
北の方にアイツらが来るわけがないよな
きっと気のせいだよ、うん
column4:
Na praia sul, dizem que há um monte
de monstros ferozes, certo?
Até os cavaleiros evitam enfrentá-los...
Não, deixa pra lá.
Não há chance de virem para o norte.
Deve ser só impressão minha.

子供ふたりを連れてさ、貝でも拾ってやろうかって
海岸近くまで行ったのよ
そしたら茂みの中か、岩場の影か――とにかく物影
から、なにかがじーっと見つめてるのよ
あたしゃ気味が悪くてねえ、とっとと帰ったってわけ
column4:
Pois é, escuta só!
Levei meus dois filhos até perto da costa
pra pegarmos umas conchas.
Mas então, seja no mato ou na sombra
das rochas — não sei —
tinha algo nos observando fixamente.
Fiquei arrepiada e voltei correndo pra casa.

Agora há pouco, nos arredores
da Costa de Bria,
encontrei rastros de monstros...
Mas fiquei com medo e recuei.
É vergonhoso que, mesmo querendo
superar minha covardia tornando-me Arisen,
eu ainda seja assim tão medroso.

私らは二人して腰を痛めておるもんで
多少なりと気候の安定したこの海の見える地に

驚いて腰を抜かして、ほうほうの体で逃げてきたよ
こりゃ、おちおち静養してられんわい
column4:
Nós dois machucamos as costas
e viemos morar aqui, onde o clima
é mais estável e se vê o mar.
Mas nunca pensei que veria algo
tão assustador.
O choque foi tanto que saímos
correndo, trêmulos de medo.
Assim não tem como descansar em paz.

testar seu poder, então procuro

Graças a isso, hoje consegui detectar a  
presença que acredito ser dos monstros!

as providências!

that apparently hoards a bit of cash.

if a monster is saving up money.

barracks is my only pleasure―― 
Oh, but that's not really a tip!

if I can't see that person!

and my comrades were all lying down.
In the next moment, I found myself suddenly
engulfed in a bizarre light,
and my consciousness slipped away―― 
At that moment, my wife's face flashed in my mind.
I bit down and ran, managing to get back somehow.

mission while napping here!

shattered against the weight of life.

mountains—exposed ore and seasoned scaffolding—

beloved spot of mine. 
What a hassle! Can't it be removed quickly?

and before you know it, you're surrounded

column4: Guerreiro Antigo

column3:
レスタニアの地に災いを為す存在、魔物たち――
やつらの勢力が強まる背景には、何があるのか？
《古の祭祀場》に襲い来る、異界を渡るとされる
強敵の存在がその疑問への答えになるかも知れない
白竜の子らよ、畏れを忘れず脅威に立ち向かえ
やつらの進撃をこれ以上許してはならない
column4:
Na terra de Lestania, existem as criaturas que
trazem calamidade - os inimigos, os monstros. 
O que
está por trás de seu poder crescente? A resposta 
pode estar na presença formidável que cruza
do "Antigo Local de Rituais", disse que
conecta-se a um reino diferente. Filhos e filhas
do Dragão Branco, confrontem a ameaça sem
esquecer de temê-la. Não podemos permitir mais
o avanço dessas criaturas.

詳しい状況は何も分かっていない

攻撃に油断は禁物だ

Parece ser uma força misteriosa que não é o
exército orc, mas não conhecemos a verdadeira
identidade do inimigo ou a situação exata.
Mesmo Arisen habilidosos não devem subestimar o
ataques dessas criaturas desconhecidas.

大船長ゼルキンとともにやつらの寝床に乗り込め！
極上の冒険が待ってるぞ！
column4:

fizeram dele seu covil.
Agora, bravos guerreiros que não temem a morte,
Assim que o navio movido a vapor estiver pronto,
Embarque em seu local de descanso com o Capitão Zerkin!
Uma aventura extraordinária aguarda!

いまこそ神殿に集いし覚者たちの総力を束ねるときだ
その一撃が、その執念が、黄金竜を確実に追い詰める
白竜の座すこの世界をともに護るのだ
column4:
A ameaça do Dragão Dourado é iminente.
Embora suas verdadeiras intenções ainda sejam desconhecidas, se
ignorarmos sua aproximação, a terra de Lestania
estará condenada. Agora é a hora de os Arisen
se reunirem no templo e unirem sua coletividade
força. Com um único golpe e determinação
inabalável, certamente encurralaremos e superaremos
o Dragão Dourado. Juntos, protegeremos este
mundo, a sede do Dragão Branco.

forças ainda mais.
Elimine todos os grupos de invocadores e desafie
o Dragão da Putrefação que espreita na parte mais profunda.

跋扈しはじめた――魔物は神殿全域を蝕んでいるため
討伐隊メンバーを２手に分けて一気に殲滅する作戦を
遂行中とのことだ
侵食が極度に進行した魔物も確認されているようで
侵食魔への対策は怠らぬよう厳命が下っている
column4:

começou a se espalhar pelo Grande Templo Shadolean.

os membros do esquadrão de extermínio
se dividiram em dois grupos, realizando um
ataque coordenado para aniquilá-los todos de
uma vez. Foi relatado que algumas das
criaturas foram severamente corrompidas. Ordens
urgentes foram dadas para garantir que
as contramedidas contra a corrupção não sejam
negligenciadas.

column4:
It seems that the evil Dragon Army has conquered
the Dacreim Fortress. The area is occupied by orcs
and large monsters, turning it into a battlefield
where cannonballs rain mercilessly. First, we need
to devise a plan to infiltrate the fortress and
turn the tide of the battle. Suppress the evil
Dragon Army's counterattack and weaken their
forces, then defeat the Beast Master lurking in
the depths of the fortress to reclaim it.

敵を大きくのけぞらせる

column4:
Dispara várias flechas em rápida sucessão.
Atordoa grandes inimigos.
<COL ffdc78>A cada Nv: Aumenta o dano.
No Nv.6: Aumenta o número de flechas disparadas (3 → 5).</COL>

column3:
複数の矢を同時に扇状に放つ
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で矢の発射数増加（３→５）</COL>
column4:
Dispara três flechas em um padrão de cunha.
<COL ffdc78>A cada Nv: Aumenta o dano.
No Nv.6: Aumenta o número de flechas disparadas (3 → 5).</COL>

column3:
敵のガードを崩す爆音火薬を巻いた矢を放つ
爆音に巻き込むことで周囲の敵をも怯ませる
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に吹き飛ばし力の上昇
LV.６で攻撃範囲拡大</COL>
column4:
Dispara uma flecha envolvida em pólvora explosiva
que produz um estrondo ensurdecedor ao impacto, 
quebrando a guarda inimiga.
Envolverá os inimigos próximos na explosão
para fazê-los recuar.
<COL ffdc78>A cada Nv: Aumenta o poder de arremesso.
No Nv.6: Aumenta o alcance do efeito.</COL>

column3:
渾身の力で弓を引き、高威力の矢を放つ
溜め満了の瞬間に矢を放つと威力が
大幅に上昇する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で溜め段階拡張（１→２）</COL>
column4:
Puxe o arco com toda a força do usuário
e dispare uma flecha de alto poder.
O poder aumenta muito se a flecha for liberada
no momento em que a carga máxima é alcançada.
<COL ffdc78>A cada Nv: Aumenta o poder de ataque.
No Nv.6: Aumenta as fases de carregamento totais (1 → 2).</COL>

column3:
矢筒内のすべての矢を直上に放ち、
敵の頭上に降らせる
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で攻撃ヒット数増加</COL>
column4:
Envia uma parede de flechas para o céu
para cair sobre uma área ampla.
<COL ffdc78>A cada Nv: Aumenta o poder de ataque.
No Nv.6: Aumenta o número de acertos.</COL>

column3:
貫通力のある矢を放つ
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で貫通時のヒット間隔が短縮し
連続ヒットしやすくなる</COL>
column4:
Dispara uma flecha capaz de perfurar vários alvos.
<COL ffdc78>A cada Nv: Aumenta o poder de ataque.
No Nv.6: Encurta o intervalo entre os acertos
ao perfurar, aumentando a probabilidade
de atingir mais vezes.</COL>

column3:
着弾時に回転し多段攻撃を加える矢を放つ
特に状態異常矢の使用時に効果的
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で攻撃ヒット数増加</COL>
column4:
Libera uma flecha giratória que causa
uma enxurrada de golpes em uma área.
Especialmente eficaz com flechas de status.
<COL ffdc78>A cada Nv: Aumenta o dano.
No Nv.6: Aumenta o número de acertos.</COL>

column3:
装填中のすべての矢に気絶効果のある火薬を
巻きつけ強化する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で攻撃範囲拡大</COL>
column4:
Aplica um efeito de atordoamento explosivo
a todas as flechas carregadas, fortalecendo-as.
<COL ffdc78>A cada Nv: Aumenta o poder de ataque.
No Nv.6: Aumenta o alcance do efeito.</COL>

column3:
火薬を巻きつけた複数の矢を、
渾身の力で空に放ち、敵の頭上に降らせる
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で矢の発射数増加（３→５）</COL>
column4:
Envolve várias flechas em pólvora e as envia
para o céu com toda a força, para chover
sobre uma área ampla.
<COL ffdc78>A cada Nv: Aumenta o poder de ataque.
No Nv.6: Aumenta o número de flechas disparadas (3 → 5).</COL>

column3:
ボタンの連打で射撃回数が増加する
また、射撃回数が増えるにつれ
敵を怯ませやすくなる
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で攻撃速度上昇</COL>
column4:
Dispare continuamente várias flechas
enquanto você pressiona o botão.
À medida que você dispara mais flechas,
fica mais fácil atordoar os inimigos.
<COL ffdc78>A cada Nv: Aumenta o dano.
No Nv.6: Aumenta a velocidade de ataque.</COL>

column3:
素早く後方に移動する
敵との間合いを素早く離す
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎にスタミナ消費減少／発動中の耐久力上昇
LV.６でモーション変化／すり抜け時間延長</COL>
column4:
Desvie rapidamente para trás,
criando distância entre você e seus inimigos.
<COL ffdc78>A cada Nv: Diminui o custo de Stamina.
Aumenta a resistência durante o uso.
No Nv.6: A mudança de movimento. Aumenta o tempo
de invulnerabilidade.</COL>

column3:
絶大な威力の矢を放つ。溜め満了の瞬間に放つと

効果が高い
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で溜め時間短縮</COL>
column4:
Dispara uma flecha de poder imenso.
Ao soltar na carga máxima, o dano aumenta
e é ainda maior em inimigos com pouca vida.
<COL ffdc78>A cada Nível: Aumenta o dano.
Nível 6: Reduz o tempo de caregamento.</COL>

column3:
連鎖的に爆発する火薬を巻きつけた矢を

射撃時にボタン長押しで起爆高度が上昇
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇
LV.６で爆発回数増加</COL>
column4:
Solte uma flecha envolvida com pólvora explosiva
no céu. A altitude de detonação aumenta
quanto mais tempo o botão é
mantido pressionado durante o disparo.
<COL ffdc78>A cada Nv: Aumenta o dano da habilidade.
No Nv.6: Aumenta o número de explosões.</COL>

column3:
敵に密着し、複数の矢を番えて渾身の力で放つ
しがみつき状態からでも可能
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に攻撃威力の上昇

Una firmemente todas as flechas na aljava, 
e liberte-as com toda a força do seu corpo.
Pode ser ativado ao escalar um inimigo.
<COL ffdc78>A cada Nv: Aumenta o dano da habilidade.
No Nv.6: Aumenta a carga máxima (2 → 3) e reduz
o número de pressionamentos de botão necessários
 para avançar para o próximo nível de carga.</COL>
